exercises.name: «Гусеница»
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet, bending the knees slightly if you need to.
Walk your hands forward one at a time, keeping your legs as straight as you comfortably can, until your body is in a straight line close to the floor.
Bend your elbows so your chest hovers just above the floor, as at the bottom of a push-up, and pause briefly with your trunk braced.
Walk your hands back toward your feet in small steps, raising your hips, until you are back in the forward fold.
Stand up, or go straight into the next repetition.
tips: Keep the knees as straight as you can so the hamstrings and calves get the stretch; a slight bend is fine if your hands do not reach the floor.
Brace the trunk in the low plank so the hips do not sag or pike up. For an easier version, stop in a straight-arm plank and skip the lowering.
Take small, controlled steps; walking out too far, too fast makes you collapse onto the floor.

exercises.name: «Дворники» лёжа на спине
instructions: Lie on your back with the arms out to the sides and the knees bent over the hips.
Brace the trunk so the lower back does not lift off the floor.
Lower both legs together towards one side as far as the shoulders stay down.
Bring them back through the centre and lower to the other side.
Keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Both shoulders stay on the floor; the range is defined by them, not by the legs.
Keep the knees together so the pelvis moves as one unit.
Straighten the legs for a much harder version once the control is there.

exercises.name: «Кокон»
instructions: Лягте на спину, руки вытянуты за головой, ноги вытянуты и чуть приподняты над полом.
Одновременно подтяните колени к груди и выведите руки вперёд в скручивание.
Вверху постарайтесь коснуться руками голеней.
Плавно вернитесь, вытягивая руки и ноги обратно над полом.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Стопы и руки не касаются пола между повторами — в этом весь смысл.
Резко выдыхайте в верхней точке.

exercises.name: «Кошка-корова»
instructions: Встаньте на четвереньки: кисти под плечами, колени под тазом.
На выдохе округлите спину к потолку, подкрутите копчик, голова опускается.
На вдохе наоборот: живот опускается, грудь и копчик поднимаются, взгляд чуть вперёд.
Медленно переходите между положениями, одно дыхание на положение.
Закончите в нейтральном положении и сядьте на пятки.
tips: Пусть дыхание задаёт темп, не спешите между положениями.
Давите на ладони равномерно, чтобы плечи не проваливались к полу.
Двигайте всем позвоночником, включая шею, а не только поясницей.

exercises.name: «Мельница» с гантелью
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell overhead in one hand, arm locked.
Turn your feet slightly away from the dumbbell side, keeping the arm straight and eyes on the weight.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them out to the side of the dumbbell, and slowly lower your torso towards the floor.
Keep your back straight and the dumbbell arm vertical as you reach your free hand towards your foot or the floor.
Reverse the motion by driving through your hips and obliques to return to the starting position.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch and repeat for the other side.
tips: Maintain a tight core throughout the movement to protect your spine and enhance stability.
Keep your eyes fixed on the dumbbell overhead to help maintain balance and a straight arm.
Focus on hinging at the hips, not rounding your back, to engage the hamstrings and glutes.
Start with a light weight to master the form before progressing to heavier loads.

exercises.name: «Мельница» с гирей
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell locked out overhead in one hand.
Turn your feet about 45 degrees away from the working arm.
Keeping the kettlebell up, hinge at the hips sideways.
Reach your opposite hand down toward your foot.
Drive your hips back to stand up tall.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your eyes on the kettlebell throughout the movement.
Push your hips out to the side instead of rounding your spine.
Start light until the hinge pattern feels stable and controlled.

exercises.name: «Мёртвый жук»
instructions: Лягте на спину, руки вытянуты к потолку, колени согнуты под 90°.
Опускайте правую руку и левую ногу к полу, прижимая поясницу.
Вернитесь в исходное положение.
Повторите на другую сторону.
Чередуйте.
tips: Поясница всё время прижата к полу.
Двигайтесь медленно.

exercises.name: «Нимб» с гирей
instructions: Stand tall, core braced, holding a light kettlebell by the horns (upside down) at chest height.
Raise the bell to one side of your head and pass it around the back in a smooth circle.
Bring it back to the starting position in front of your face.
Reverse direction every few reps.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions or time.
tips: Light weight only — this is mobility, not strength.
Keep the head stationary; the bell goes around, not the head.
If the bell drifts wide, shrink the circle — tight orbit, close to the skull.

exercises.name: «Нить в иголку»
instructions: Start on all fours with the hands under the shoulders and the knees under the hips.
Slide one arm underneath the body, palm facing up, until the shoulder and the side of the head rest on the mat.
Keep the hips stacked over the knees and walk the top hand forward or wrap it behind the back.
Hold the twist for the prescribed time, breathing into the upper back.
Press the top hand into the floor to come up and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep the hips high over the knees; dropping them turns the rotation into a side bend.
Rest the head on a block if the shoulder cannot reach the floor comfortably.
Let the shoulder settle with the breath instead of pushing the twist deeper by force.

exercises.name: «Нить в иголку» в потоке
instructions: Start on all fours with the hands under the shoulders and the knees under the hips.
Slide one arm under the body until the shoulder approaches the mat.
Reverse the motion and open that arm up towards the ceiling, following the hand with the eyes.
Return through the centre and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Change sides and repeat.
tips: Keep the hips over the knees so the rotation stays in the upper back.
Move at an even tempo instead of throwing the arm open.
Let the head follow the hand rather than leading the movement.

exercises.name: «Ножницы»
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your glutes.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Alternate crossing one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Maintain a steady rhythm throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor throughout.
Keep your legs straight and close to the ground.
Move with control rather than speed.

exercises.name: «Ножницы» вверх-вниз
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Alternate kicking your legs up and down in a small range.
Keep your core braced and lower back pressed down.
Continue for the desired duration or reps.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor for the whole set.
Keep the kicks small and steady rather than big and wild.
Raise your legs higher if you feel your lower back arching.

exercises.name: «Паучьи» сгибания с гантелями
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip.
Keep your upper arms vertical as you curl the weights up.
Squeeze the biceps hard at the top.
Lower the dumbbells under control to full extension.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your chest glued to the pad for the whole set.
Squeeze at the top without letting the elbows drift backward.
Use the full range — the stretch at the bottom is half the value.

exercises.name: «Паучьи» сгибания с EZ-грифом
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding an EZ bar with underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight down from your shoulders.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Let your arms hang straight down and keep the upper arms fixed.
Curl with the biceps only — the bench removes any excuse to swing.
Lower to a full stretch before starting the next rep.

exercises.name: «Птица-собака»
instructions: Встаньте на четвереньки, позвоночник нейтральный.
Одновременно вытяните правую руку вперёд и левую ногу назад.
Задержитесь на мгновение и вернитесь.
Повторите на другую сторону.
Чередуйте.
tips: Двигайтесь медленно и подконтрольно.
Таз ровный всё время.

exercises.name: «Ракушка»
instructions: Лягте на бок, колени согнуты и лежат друг на друге.
Стопы вместе, таз ровно.
Раскрывайте верхнее колено к потолку, не поворачивая таз.
Сожмите наружную часть ягодицы вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите. Сделайте повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Положите ладонь на верхнюю часть таза, чтобы почувствовать нежелательный завал.
Движение небольшое и подконтрольное, не поднимайте колено силой.
Положите голову на нижнюю руку, чтобы позвоночник был нейтрален.

exercises.name: «Ракушка» с мини-лентой
instructions: Лягте на бок, таз и колени согнуты примерно на 45°, стопы одна на другой.
Наденьте мини-ленту на обе ноги выше колен.
Стопы прижаты друг к другу, таз неподвижен — не заваливайтесь назад.
Раскрывайте верхнее колено вверх против ленты, как створку ракушки, пока не почувствуете работу ягодицы.
Сделайте короткую паузу вверху и подконтрольно опустите колено.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Таз стоит ровно — как только начинаете заваливаться назад, ягодица выключается.
Медленный подконтрольный темп важнее тугой ленты: это упражнение на стабильность, не на рекорд.
Если сводит сбоку бедра — это та самая мышца. Сократите подход.

exercises.name: «Скалолаз»
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs, driving the other knee forward.
Continue alternating at a brisk pace.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your hips level and low rather than piking upward.
Keep your shoulders stacked directly over your wrists.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm as the pace increases.

exercises.name: «Супермен»
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower under control.
Repeat.
tips: Squeeze glutes as you lift.
Avoid jerking movements.

exercises.name: Австралийские подтягивания
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie underneath and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended, heels on the floor, body straight from head to ankles.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself under control until arms are fully extended.
Repeat.
tips: Keep the core braced — no hip sag.
To make it harder, elevate your feet; to make it easier, walk your feet in toward the bar.
Pause briefly at the top with the chest against the bar.

exercises.name: Австралийские подтягивания на кольцах
instructions: Set the rings just above hip height.
Lie under the rings and grip them with palms facing each other.
Walk the feet forward so the body forms a straight line.
Pull the chest toward the rings, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower under control to a full-arm extension.
tips: Keep the body in a straight line — heels through head.
Squeeze the glutes and core to prevent sagging.
Elevate the feet on a box for a harder version.

exercises.name: Армейский жим
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bar at collarbone level.
Brace your core and press the bar overhead.
Lock out at the top with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to collarbone height.
Repeat.
tips: Do not lean back excessively.
Squeeze your glutes for stability.

exercises.name: Армейский жим с паузой
instructions: Set up with a barbell racked at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart, and the core braced.
Press the bar straight overhead until the elbows are fully locked out.
Lower the bar under control back down to the front of the shoulders.
Hold a full one-second pause at the shoulders, keeping tension and eliminating any bounce.
Press back up from the dead stop without using leg drive.
tips: Keep the pause strict -- no rebounding the bar off the shoulders.
Brace hard and keep the bar path vertical over the mid-foot.
Use a weight you can control through the dead-stop start.

exercises.name: Бабочка (пек-дек)
instructions: Sit in the pec deck machine and place your forearms against the pads.
Adjust the seat so pads align with mid-chest height.
Squeeze the pads together in front of your chest.
Hold the contraction briefly at the center.
Return under control to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your shoulders down and back against the seat.
Avoid letting the pads fly back past a comfortable stretch.
Focus on squeezing your chest rather than pressing with your arms.

exercises.name: Бег
instructions: Start from an easy jog and build into your pace over the first few minutes rather than setting off at target speed.
Land with your foot under your hips, not out in front, and keep the contact with the ground short and quiet.
Run tall through the hips with a slight forward lean from the ankles, not a fold at the waist.
Bend your elbows to about ninety degrees and drive your arms forward and back, keeping them off your chest.
Breathe rhythmically and keep your shoulders, jaw and hands loose.
Hold the pace for the desired time or distance, then jog and walk for a few minutes to finish.
tips: Build weekly distance gradually. Almost every running injury comes from adding volume faster than the tendons and bones adapt, not from a single hard run.
Most of your running should be easy enough to talk in. Running every session at a middling hard pace is the fastest way to plateau.
Shorten your stride and let your cadence rise if you feel yourself thudding — reaching for a longer stride puts the brakes on with every footfall.

exercises.name: Бег на беговой дорожке
instructions: Step onto the treadmill with a foot on each side rail, start the belt at a walking speed and step on once it is moving.
Build up to your running pace, landing under your hips rather than reaching out in front of you.
Run tall with your shoulders relaxed, your elbows bent at about ninety degrees and your arms swinging forward and back, not across your body.
Keep your eyes forward and stay in the middle of the belt instead of drifting back toward the rear roller.
Hold the pace for the desired time or distance, then slow the belt and walk for a few minutes before stepping off.
tips: Clip the safety key to your waistband — it is the only thing that stops the belt if you lose your footing.
Do not hold the handrails while running. Leaning on them shortens your stride, twists your posture and hides how hard you are actually working.
A one to two percent incline makes indoor running feel closer to running outdoors, where you have to push through air resistance.

exercises.name: Бег с высоким подниманием бедра
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up toward the chest while pumping the opposite arm.
Quickly switch legs, mirroring the arm action.
Continue alternating at a fast pace.
Continue for the prescribed work interval.
tips: Drive the knees up to at least hip height.
Stay light on the balls of the feet.
Keep the torso upright — do not lean back.

exercises.name: Бёрпи
instructions: Встаньте, стопы на ширине плеч.
Присядьте и поставьте руки на пол перед собой.
Прыжком или шагом уведите ноги назад в планку и отожмитесь.
Прыжком или шагом подведите стопы к рукам.
Встаньте и мощно выпрыгните вверх, руки над головой.
tips: В планке спина ровная — таз не провисает.
Приземляйтесь мягко.
Для облегчения уводите ноги шагом, а не прыжком.

exercises.name: Боковая планка
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position, keeping your core tight.
Breathe steadily.
Repeat on both sides.
tips: Don't let your top shoulder roll forward during the hold.
Push the floor away through the forearm rather than sinking into the shoulder.
Keep your head in line with your spine.

exercises.name: Боковая планка с подъёмом ноги
instructions: Lie on your side with the forearm on the floor, elbow under the shoulder.
Stack the feet and lift the hips into a side plank.
From this stable side plank, raise the top leg straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower the leg back down with control without dropping the hips.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep the hips lifted the entire set — do not let them sag.
Lead the leg lift with the heel, not the toes.
Keep the body in one straight line from head to bottom foot.

exercises.name: Боковая планка с удержанием поднятой ноги
instructions: Set up in a side plank on the forearm with the elbow under the shoulder and the feet stacked.
Lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from the ankles to the head.
Raise the top leg to roughly hip height, keeping the toes pointing forward.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, keeping the hips high and the supporting shoulder stacked over the elbow.
Lower the leg and the hips under control and repeat on the other side.
tips: Push the supporting shoulder away from the ear so the chest does not collapse towards the floor.
Stop the set when the hips start to drop, not when the leg gets tired.
Bend the bottom knee to the floor for an easier version that keeps the leg lift intact.

exercises.name: Боковой наклон стоя
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width and reach both arms overhead.
Clasp your hands and lengthen up tall.
Bend smoothly to one side in a long curve.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep both feet planted and hips steady.
Reach up and over rather than just leaning down.

exercises.name: Боковые выпады
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands at your chest.
Step one leg wide to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Bend the stepping knee and push your hips back into a lateral squat.
Keep your chest up and the working heel planted.
Drive through the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Push your hips back as you bend the stepping knee.
Keep your trailing leg straight and both heels planted.
Keep your chest up rather than rounding forward.

exercises.name: Боковые наклоны стоя в потоке
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and reach both arms overhead.
Bend the trunk to one side, keeping both feet planted and the hips level.
Return through the centre with the ribs stacked over the pelvis.
Bend to the other side in the same way.
Keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Bend sideways only: letting the chest rotate turns it into a twist.
Keep both heels down so the movement stays in the trunk.
Move with the breath rather than bouncing at the end of the range.

exercises.name: Болгарские выпады в Смите
instructions: Set up a bench behind the Smith machine. Rest the bar on your traps.
Place the rear foot on the bench and front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front heel to return.
Repeat on both sides.
tips: The Smith machine guides the bar path.
Focus on keeping front knee tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Болгарские выпады с гантелями
instructions: Встаньте перед скамьёй и положите одну стопу назад на скамью.
Держите гантели в опущенных руках.
Опускайтесь, пока переднее бедро не станет параллельно полу.
Встаньте, упираясь передней пяткой.
Повторите на обе стороны.
tips: Основной вес на передней ноге.
Переднее колено идёт над носком, не заваливается внутрь.
Таз смотрит вперёд, не разворачивайтесь к скамье.

exercises.name: Болгарские выпады с гирей
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench, placing one foot on it behind you, laces down. Hold a kettlebell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Maintain an upright torso and engage your core.
Lower your body by bending both knees, allowing your front knee to track over your toes.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor or slightly below, keeping your rear knee close to the ground.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees.
Complete all reps per side before switching.
tips: Ensure your front foot is far enough from the bench to allow a full range of motion without discomfort.
Keep your torso upright throughout the movement to maximize glute and quad engagement.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase to build strength and stability.
Experiment with holding the kettlebell in the same hand as the working leg (ipsilateral) or the opposite hand (contralateral) for different challenges.

exercises.name: Болгарские выпады со штангой
instructions: Положите штангу на верх спины и встаньте примерно в 60 см перед скамьёй спиной к ней.
Поставьте подъём одной стопы на скамью сзади; передняя стопа достаточно впереди, чтобы при опускании голень была почти вертикальна.
Напрягите корпус и опускайте заднее колено к полу, сгибая переднюю ногу в тазобедренном и колене.
Опускайтесь, пока переднее бедро не станет примерно параллельно полу, грудь поднята.
Вернитесь в исходное положение, упираясь серединой передней стопы.
Сделайте все повторы на одну ногу, затем смените.
tips: Основной вес на передней ноге; задняя стопа — только для равновесия.
Переднее колено идёт над носком, корпус вертикально.
Берите вес легче, чем в приседе со штангой, и заранее продумайте, как безопасно сбросить штангу.

exercises.name: Бросок медбола в пол
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a slam ball in front of your hips.
Lift the ball overhead by extending the hips and reaching tall.
Forcefully slam the ball into the floor between your feet, crunching through the core.
Catch the ball on the bounce or pick it up from the floor.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Use a dead-bounce slam ball, not a traditional medicine ball — regular balls will bounce back into your face.
Finish with the whole body — it is a full swing, not just an arm throw.

exercises.name: Велосипед
instructions: Лягте на спину, руки за головой, ноги подняты.
Подтяните одно колено к груди, разворачивая корпус навстречу противоположным локтем.
Выпрямите эту ногу и подтяните другое колено.
Продолжайте чередовать, как будто крутите педали.
Повторите.
tips: Не тяните шею руками.
Ведите поворот плечом, а не локтем.
Двигайтесь медленно и осознанно, не гонитесь за скоростью.

exercises.name: Велотренажёр
instructions: Set the saddle height so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke, then sit down and place the balls of your feet on the pedals.
Take the handlebars with a relaxed grip and sit tall, with your back neutral and your shoulders down.
Push one pedal down and forward while the other rises, keeping the effort in your legs rather than pulling on the bars.
Keep pedalling in a smooth, even circle at a steady cadence, breathing in rhythm with the stroke.
Adjust the resistance to hold your target effort, and continue for the desired time or distance.
tips: Set the saddle before you start: too low grinds the knees, too high rocks your hips side to side at the bottom of every stroke.
Drive with the legs and keep the upper body quiet — gripping and hauling on the bars adds nothing but neck and shoulder tension.
Raise the resistance rather than spinning the pedals loose and fast; a light flywheel at high cadence feels hard on the lungs but does little for the legs.

exercises.name: Велотренажёр Air Bike
instructions: Сядьте на аэробайк и возьмитесь за подвижные рукояти.
Поставьте ноги на педали и напрягите корпус.
Толкайте и тяните рукояти, крутя педали в ровном темпе.
Работайте и руками, и ногами, чтобы держать мощность.
Продолжайте нужное время или дистанцию.
tips: Держите корпус прямо, не наваливайтесь на рукояти.
Дышите ритмично, чтобы выдерживать длинные интервалы.
Тяните рукояти спиной, а не только руками.

exercises.name: Вертикальный шпагат стоя
instructions: From a forward fold, place both hands on the floor or on blocks beside the standing foot.
Shift the weight onto one leg and lift the other leg behind you.
Keep the standing leg straight and the hips as level as the lift allows.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, drawing the chest towards the standing shin.
Lower the lifted foot down and repeat on the other side.
tips: Level the hips first and accept a lower lift; an open hip turns this into a different pose.
Use blocks under the hands so the spine can stay long.
Hold the standing ankle with one hand only when the balance is already steady.

exercises.name: Взятие гантелей на грудь и жим
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand, hanging at your sides.
Hinge at the hips and bend the knees slightly to lower the dumbbells to just below the knees.
Explosively extend the hips and knees and shrug to pull the dumbbells up to the shoulders, catching them with the elbows forward.
Dip slightly at the knees and drive the dumbbells straight overhead until the arms are locked out.
Lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders, then to your sides, under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Let the legs and hips produce the power; the arms only guide the dumbbells.
Keep the dumbbells close to the body on the way up.
Finish each press with the ribs down and the glutes tight.

exercises.name: Взятие гири на грудь со свинга
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with one hand.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to pull the kettlebell up to your shoulder.
Catch the kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep the kettlebell close to your body on the way up.
Let the kettlebell roll around your wrist rather than flipping over it.
Relax your grip slightly at the top for a soft catch.

exercises.name: Взятие двух гирь на грудь
instructions: Встаньте, две гири на полу между стопами, дужки чуть повёрнуты внутрь.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, возьмитесь за дужки и заведите гири назад между ног.
Мощно разогните таз, посылая гири вверх вдоль тела.
На уровне груди проведите кисти сквозь дужки и примите гири в стойку на плечах.
Опустите гири в вис, наклоняясь в тазобедренных и направляя их между ног.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Проводите кисти сквозь дужки — не давайте гирям переворачиваться и бить по запястьям.
Работайте тазом; руки лишь направляют траекторию.

exercises.name: Взятие двух гирь на грудь и жим
instructions: Встаньте, две гири на полу между стопами, стопы на ширине таза; наклонитесь и возьмите по дужке в каждую руку.
Мощно оттолкнитесь ногами и разогните таз, поднимая обе гири; подведите локти под них и примите гири в стойку у плеч.
Напрягите корпус и выжмите обе гири над головой до полного выпрямления рук.
Опустите гири в стойку, затем подконтрольно на пол.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Во взятии гири близко к телу; принимая их, проводите кисти сквозь дужки, чтобы гири мягко легли на предплечья, а не ударили.
Начинайте жим с небольшого подседа ногами и тазом и заканчивайте плечами; корпус напряжён, не отклоняйтесь назад.
В конце запястья прямые, гири над локтями и плечами, голова возвращается в нейтраль между гирями.

exercises.name: Взятие двух гирь на грудь с пола
instructions: Поставьте две гири на пол между стопами.
Наклонитесь и возьмитесь за обе дужки.
Мощно оттолкнитесь ногами и тазом.
Поднимите гири и переведите их в стойку на плечах.
Опустите их на пол и повторите.
tips: Ведите гири близко к телу на подъёме.
Запястья прямые, когда гири ложатся в стойку.
Перед каждым повтором заново принимайте плотный наклон.

exercises.name: Взятие на грудь
instructions: Встаньте над нагруженной штангой, стопы на ширине таза.
Возьмитесь за гриф хватом сверху чуть шире колен.
Мощно оттолкнитесь ногами и разогните таз.
Подсядьте под штангу и примите её на передние дельты.
Полностью выпрямитесь, завершая движение.
tips: Штанга идёт вверх близко к телу.
Полностью завершите толчок ногами, прежде чем подседать под штангу.
Принимайте штангу с высоко поднятыми локтями, чтобы она лежала на плечах.

exercises.name: Взятие на грудь в полуприсед с виса
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a barbell at your thighs.
Hinge at the hips to lower the bar to just above the knees.
Drive through your hips and legs explosively.
Pull the bar up and catch it on your front shoulders in a partial squat.
Stand tall with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to the hang position.
tips: Drive through your hips and legs before the arms pull.
Receive the bar with your thighs above parallel.
Keep your back flat as you hinge to the start position.

exercises.name: Взятие на грудь с виса
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip at your thighs.
Hinge at the hips to lower the bar just above your knees.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles.
Shrug your shoulders and pull the bar up.
Catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then return to the hang position.
tips: Hinge to just above the knees before exploding upward.
Shrug and pull the bar up close to your body.
Catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat.

exercises.name: Вис на кольцах
instructions: Grip a pair of gymnastic rings with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended and feet off the ground.
Let the rings rotate naturally; do not fight the grip.
Keep your shoulders engaged (no shrug to the ears) and core lightly braced.
Hold for the desired duration.
tips: Breathe steadily rather than holding your breath.
Build hold duration gradually as your grip strengthens.
Step down under control before your grip fails completely.

exercises.name: Вис на согнутых руках
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with the palms facing away, a little wider than shoulder-width, or facing you for an easier version.
Pull yourself up, or step up on a box, until the chin is above the bar.
Keep the elbows bent and pointing down, with the shoulders pulled away from the ears.
Hold the position without swinging, keeping the legs together and the trunk tight.
Lower slowly to a full hang when the chin begins to drop.
tips: Keep the chin clearly above the bar; once it drops below, the hold is over.
Squeeze the bar and pull the shoulder blades down and back.
Step up to the top position rather than jumping if you cannot yet pull up.

exercises.name: Вис на турнике
instructions: Возьмитесь за перекладину на ширине плеч, ладони от себя.
Повисните на полностью выпрямленных руках, ноги не касаются пола.
Расслабьте плечи и дайте телу висеть.
Корпус слегка напряжён.
Держите нужное время.
tips: Увеличивайте время виса постепенно от занятия к занятию.
Дышите ровно, не задерживайте дыхание.
Отпуская перекладину, приземляйтесь мягко на согнутые колени.

exercises.name: Воин I
instructions: Step one foot back and turn it out about forty-five degrees, planting the whole sole.
Bend the front knee until it stacks over the ankle and keep the back leg straight.
Draw both hip points towards the front of the mat and lift the arms overhead.
Hold the position for the prescribed time with the ribs down and the chest lifted.
Step the feet together and repeat on the other side.
tips: Widen the stance sideways so both hips can face forward without straining the back knee.
Press the outer edge of the back foot down to keep the base stable.
Take the arms shoulder-width apart if bringing the palms together arches the lower back.

exercises.name: Воин II
instructions: Stand wide with the front foot turned out ninety degrees and the back foot slightly in.
Bend the front knee until it stacks over the ankle and tracks towards the middle toes.
Open the hips and chest to the side and extend the arms parallel to the floor.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, gazing over the front hand.
Straighten the front leg and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep the front knee from drifting inwards; press it towards the little-toe side.
Stack the shoulders over the hips rather than leaning towards the front leg.
Shorten the stance if the front thigh cannot get close to parallel.

exercises.name: Воин III
instructions: Stand on one leg with the knee soft and the hips level.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg lifts behind you.
Continue until the torso and the lifted leg are roughly parallel to the floor.
Reach the arms forward, back along the body or out to the sides, and hold for the prescribed time.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep the lifted hip from opening upwards; both hip points face the floor.
Flex the lifted foot and press the heel back to keep the leg active.
Rest the hands on blocks or a wall while you are building the balance.

exercises.name: Выпад с жимом гири
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at shoulder height with one arm.
Step forward into a lunge with the opposite leg.
As you lunge, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lock out the arm at the top of the press.
Step back to standing while lowering the kettlebell.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Brace your core to resist leaning toward the loaded side.
Keep your front knee tracking in line with your toes.
Avoid arching your back as you lock out overhead.

exercises.name: Выпад с поворотом корпуса и гирей
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Step to one side into a lateral lunge.
Rotate your torso toward the lunging leg.
Bring the kettlebell down toward the bent knee.
Push off the lunging leg to return to center.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Sit your hips back as you step into the lateral lunge.
Rotate from your torso and hips, not your knees.
Keep your back flat as you reach the kettlebell down.

exercises.name: Выпады
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees form 90-degree angles.
Drive through your front heel to return to standing.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Take a stride long enough for both knees to reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and eyes forward.
Push through the front heel to return in one strong motion.

exercises.name: Выпады в ходьбе
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on hips.
Step one foot forward into a long lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel and step the back foot forward.
Continue alternating legs as you walk forward.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright as you step.
Drive through your front heel to step forward smoothly.

exercises.name: Выпады с гантелями
instructions: Встаньте с гантелями в опущенных руках.
Шагните вперёд одной ногой и опустите заднее колено к полу.
Оттолкнитесь передней стопой и вернитесь.
Чередуйте ноги.
Повторите.
tips: Корпус вертикально.
Переднее колено идёт над носком.

exercises.name: Выпады с гирей у груди
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by its horns at chest height, elbows tucked, in the goblet position.
Take a controlled step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Ensure your front knee is stacked over your ankle and your rear knee hovers just above the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position, maintaining balance and core tension.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching, or alternate legs per set.
tips: Keep your chest upright and core braced throughout the movement to protect your spine and maintain stability.
Focus on a controlled descent and a powerful drive up, engaging your glutes and quads.
Avoid letting your front knee collapse inward; keep it aligned with your toes.

exercises.name: Выпады с прыжком
instructions: Start in a forward lunge with one foot ahead of the other.
Drop into a deep lunge with the back knee almost touching the floor.
Drive both feet off the floor, switching legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Continue alternating without pausing.
tips: Land softly with bent knees to absorb impact.
Switch the leg position fully — do not just hop in place.
Keep the torso upright — do not pitch forward.

exercises.name: Выпады со штангой
instructions: Положите штангу на верх спины и встаньте прямо.
Сделайте длинный шаг вперёд одной ногой.
Опускайте заднее колено к полу, пока переднее бедро не станет параллельно полу.
Вернитесь в стойку, упираясь пяткой передней ноги.
Сделайте повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Шаг достаточно длинный, чтобы переднее колено было над лодыжкой.
Корпус вертикально, пресс напряжён под штангой.
Отталкивайтесь передней пяткой, а не носком.

exercises.name: Высокий выпад «полумесяц»
instructions: Шагните одной ногой вперёд в длинную стойку, задняя пятка поднята, пальцы смотрят вперёд.
Согните переднее колено примерно до 90°, колено над лодыжкой.
Подайте заднее бедро вперёд, чтобы таз смотрел вперёд, и поднимите руки над головой.
Удерживайте заданное время: рёбра опущены, задняя нога прямая.
Приставьте стопы и повторите на другую сторону.
tips: Если мешает равновесие, немного расширьте стойку в стороны.
Тянитесь задней пяткой к стене позади, чтобы задняя нога работала.
Опустите руки на таз, если подъём рук прогибает поясницу.

exercises.name: Высокий выпад со скручиванием
instructions: Step into a high lunge with the front knee over the ankle and the back heel lifted.
Bring the palms together at the chest and square both hips towards the front of the mat.
Rotate the chest towards the front leg and hook the opposite elbow outside the thigh.
Hold the twist for the prescribed time, pressing the back heel towards the wall behind you.
Unwind and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep the back leg straight and long; it is what stops the twist collapsing into the hips.
Drop the back knee to the floor for an easier version with the same rotation.
Lengthen the spine first, then rotate — twisting a rounded back gets you nowhere.

exercises.name: Выход силой на кольцах
instructions: Hang from the rings with a false grip, palms facing each other.
Pull explosively, driving the chest up to the rings.
Transition the elbows over the rings as the chest rises.
Press to full arm extension at the top.
Lower under control through the transition back to the hang.
tips: A false grip is essential for the transition.
Drive the elbows down hard during the transition.
Build the strength with negatives and band-assisted reps first.

exercises.name: Выход силой на перекладине
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false grip.
Pull yourself up explosively toward the bar.
As your chest reaches the bar, rotate your elbows over and transition into a dip.
Press your body up until your arms are fully extended above the bar.
Lower back down with control through the same path.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Use a false grip so your wrists are already over the bar for the transition.
Pull explosively toward your sternum, not just your chin.
Drill the transition on low rings or with bands before full reps.

exercises.name: Гакк-приседания
instructions: Load the hack squat machine and step on, positioning your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place your feet shoulder-width on the platform with toes turned out slightly.
Unlock the safety handles and lower the sled by bending at the knees and hips.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Drive through your heels to extend the legs and push the sled back to the start.
Re-engage the safety handles after your final rep.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the pad throughout the movement.
Placing the feet higher on the platform shifts emphasis to the glutes and hamstrings.
Control the descent; do not bounce out of the bottom position.

exercises.name: Гиперэкстензия
instructions: Лягте лицом вниз на скамью для гиперэкстензии, таз у края валика.
Опустите корпус к полу.
Поднимите корпус, пока тело не выпрямится.
Повторите.
tips: Двигайтесь подконтрольно.
Не переразгибайтесь дальше нейтрального положения спины.

exercises.name: Гоблет-приседания
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at chest height with both hands.
Squat down keeping the weight close to your chest.
Drive back up.
Repeat.
tips: The goblet position naturally encourages an upright torso.
Push knees out at the bottom.

exercises.name: Горизонтальный жим ногами
instructions: Sit in a horizontal leg press machine and place feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and lower the platform toward your chest.
Press the platform back to the start.
Repeat.
tips: Do not let your lower back lift off the seat.
Avoid locking out the knees completely.

exercises.name: Гребной тренажёр
instructions: Sit on the rower, strap your feet into the footplates and take the handle with an overhand grip.
Slide forward into the catch: shins vertical, torso leaning slightly ahead of the hips, arms straight out toward the flywheel.
Drive through your legs first, pushing the seat back until your knees are almost straight.
Swing your torso back past vertical, then pull the handle in to your lower ribs with your elbows travelling past your sides.
Reverse the order on the recovery — arms away, torso forward, then bend the knees — and slide back to the catch for the next stroke.
Continue for the desired time, distance or number of strokes.
tips: Keep the order: legs, then body, then arms on the drive, and arms, body, legs on the recovery. Breaking the arms early wastes the strongest part of the stroke.
Row with a flat back and a braced core — rounding the lower back at the catch is what turns rowing into a back ache instead of conditioning.
Let the handle travel in a straight, level line to the lower ribs, and make the recovery about twice as slow as the drive rather than rushing back to the catch.

exercises.name: Грудной мост
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing back.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips off the floor.
Continue pressing until your chest opens and your arms are extended.
Drop your head back and hold the position.
Breathe steadily while maintaining the bridge.
Lower back down under control.
tips: Drive the hips high and squeeze the glutes to protect the lower back.
Keep the feet flat and the weight even between hands and feet.

exercises.name: Жим Арнольда
instructions: Держите гантели на уровне плеч, ладони к себе.
Выжимайте гантели вверх, разворачивая ладони вперёд.
Вверху полностью выпрямите руки, не блокируя локти.
Выполните движение в обратном порядке, разворачивая ладони обратно.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Разворачивайте ладони равномерно по ходу жима, а не разом.
Не прогибайте поясницу, когда вес уходит над головой.
Берите вес легче, чем в обычном жиме, чтобы контролировать разворот.

exercises.name: Жим в лендмайне одной рукой
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine attachment and load the free end.
Kneel on one knee or stand and grip the sleeve end at shoulder height with one hand.
Press the bar upward and forward along its arc until the arm is fully extended.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height under control.
Complete all reps before switching sides.
tips: Engage your core to prevent the torso from rotating toward the working arm.
The arc motion is more joint-friendly than a vertical overhead press.
Kneeling on the knee on the same side as the pressing arm, with the other foot planted in front, increases the core's anti-rotation demand.

exercises.name: Жим в Смите на наклонной скамье
instructions: Set an incline bench at 30-45 degrees inside a Smith machine.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack and lower the bar to your upper chest.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Press the bar back up until your arms are extended.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Position the bench so the bar lands on the upper chest, not the throat.
Stack your wrists directly above your elbows.
Avoid driving your head forward off the bench as you press.

exercises.name: Жим в Смите на скамье с отрицательным наклоном
instructions: Set a decline bench in the machine so the bar lines up with your lower chest when you lie down, and hook your legs under the pads.
Lie back with your head at the low end, take an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar under control until it touches your lower chest, keeping your elbows at roughly forty-five degrees from your torso.
Press the bar back up until your arms are extended, without locking the elbows out hard.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then rack the bar before releasing your legs.
tips: Line the bench up before you load it. The bar only moves in one plane, so if the bench is a few centimetres out the bar will meet your throat or your stomach instead of your lower chest.
Secure your legs under the pads first. Head-down and unsecured, you slide toward the low end of the bench on the first hard rep.
Come down and sit up slowly between sets. Long sets with the head below the heart make people light-headed, and this variation is where it happens.

exercises.name: Жим вверх в тренажёре
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles at shoulder level.
Press the handles overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower with control to the starting position.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the pad without overarching.
Keep your wrists stacked directly over your elbows as you press.

exercises.name: Жим вверх одной рукой в тренажёре
instructions: Adjust the seat so the working handle starts around shoulder height and sit with your back firmly against the pad.
Grip one handle with the wrist straight and keep the free hand on the support or resting comfortably.
Press the handle upward without leaning away from the back pad or rotating the torso.
Lower the handle under control until the elbow is just below the starting line, then repeat.
Complete the repetitions on one side, adjust the seat if needed, and train the other side.
tips: Start with the weaker arm and let it set the weight and repetitions for both sides.
Keep the ribs down and the back against the pad instead of leaning away from the working arm.
Stop short of a painful shoulder position; the machine path should feel controlled from bottom to top.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей лёжа
instructions: Лягте на горизонтальную скамью, гантели в руках на уровне груди.
Выжмите гантели вверх до полного выпрямления рук.
Медленно опустите их в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Запястья нейтральны всё время.
Сожмите грудь в верхней точке.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей лёжа на полу
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells upward until arms are extended.
Lower under control until elbows touch the floor.
Repeat.
tips: The floor limits shoulder strain at the bottom.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей лёжа узким хватом
instructions: Лягте на горизонтальную скамью, гантели вместе над грудью.
Опустите их к груди, локти близко к телу.
Выжмите вверх.
Повторите.
tips: Сжимайте гантели друг с другом всё движение.
Локти прижаты.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей на наклонной скамье
instructions: Set bench to 30-degree incline and sit back with dumbbells at shoulder level.
Press dumbbells up and together until arms are fully extended.
Lower dumbbells back to shoulder level with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked directly over your elbows.
Press up without banging the dumbbells together at the top.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back against the bench.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей на скамье с отрицательным наклоном
instructions: Установите скамью с отрицательным наклоном. Лягте и зафиксируйте ноги.
Держите гантели над грудью, затем опустите их к бокам нижней части груди.
Выжмите гантели в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Спина прижата к скамье.
С тяжёлыми весами работайте со страхующим.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей сидя
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back against the pad instead of arching excessively.
Avoid clanging the dumbbells together at the top.
Keep your forearms vertical under the dumbbells throughout the press.

exercises.name: Жим гантелей стоя
instructions: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells overhead until arms are fully extended.
Keep your core braced and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower the dumbbells under control back to shoulder height.
Do not let the dumbbells drift behind your head.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Stack your wrists directly over your elbows throughout the press.
Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower.
Keep your elbows slightly in front of your shoulders rather than flared wide.

exercises.name: Жим гантели одной рукой лёжа
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with the feet planted on the floor and a dumbbell held at chest level in one hand.
Rest the free hand on your stomach or hold it out to the side for balance.
Press the dumbbell up over the chest until the arm is straight.
Pause briefly at the top without letting the body roll toward the pressing arm.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the side of the chest.
Complete the repetitions on one side, then switch arms.
tips: Squeeze the glutes and keep the shoulder blades pinned to the bench to resist rotation.
Lower to the side of the chest, with the elbow about 45 degrees from the body.
Use a weight you can hold level without twisting; add load only when both sides match.

exercises.name: Жим гантели одной рукой стоя
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at one shoulder with the palm facing forward.
Brace the abdominals and keep the free arm relaxed at your side.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until the arm is fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the upper arm next to the ear.
Lower the dumbbell back to the shoulder under control.
Complete the repetitions on one arm, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the ribs down and the glutes tight; do not lean sideways to push the weight up.
Press in a straight line close to the head, not out in front.
Start lighter than you would with two dumbbells; the trunk has to stabilise the load.

exercises.name: Жим гири дном вверх одной рукой
instructions: Clean a light kettlebell to the rack position, then tilt it so the bell points up and the handle is at the palm.
Grip the handle hard; wrist absolutely straight and vertical.
Brace the core and press the bell straight up without letting it tip.
Lock out overhead with the bell still perfectly upright.
Lower slowly back to the rack position keeping the bell vertical the entire descent.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
tips: If the bell tips, the set is over — do not fight it down.
Start with a very light weight; this is a skill and stability lift, not a heavy press.
Grip hard throughout — any loosening and the bell falls.

exercises.name: Жим гири лёжа на полу узким хватом
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with the knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a single kettlebell by the handle with both hands, close together, the bell resting on the chest with elbows tucked tight to the ribs.
Brace the core and press the kettlebell straight up until the arms are fully extended.
Lower under control until the upper arms touch the floor and pause briefly.
Press back up to lockout.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the elbows tucked at roughly 30–45 degrees from the torso — wide elbows turn it into a chest press.
The brief pause when the elbows touch the floor kills the bounce and forces a clean concentric.
Pick a bell you can control with two hands; the narrow grip is unforgiving if it tips.

exercises.name: Жим гири одной рукой в ягодичном мосте
exercises.nameEn: One Arm Kettlebell Floor Glute Bridge Press
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand at your shoulder.
Drive your hips up into a glute bridge.
Press the kettlebell straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower the kettlebell and your hips with control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Hold the bridge steady at the top while pressing.
Keep your wrist straight and stacked under the kettlebell.
Extend your free arm along the floor for extra stability.

exercises.name: Жим гири одной рукой лёжа на полу
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with knees bent.
Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand.
Press the kettlebell straight up until your arm is fully extended.
Lower the kettlebell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Keep your core braced throughout.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your forearm vertical throughout the press.
Tuck your elbow to roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Let your upper arm touch down gently rather than bouncing off the floor.

exercises.name: Жим гири одной рукой стоя
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the racked position at one shoulder.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Keep your core tight throughout.
Lower the kettlebell back to the rack position with control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Avoid leaning away from the kettlebell as it travels overhead.
Finish with your biceps close to your ear at lockout.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your ribs from flaring.

exercises.name: Жим гирь лёжа на полу
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at the chest, bells resting on the outer forearms.
Press both kettlebells straight up until the arms are fully extended.
Lower under control until the triceps touch the floor — do not bounce.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Elbows stay about 45 degrees from the torso; do not flare.
The grip matters: keep the bells stable against the outside of the forearms.
The floor limits ROM by design — this is the feature, not the bug.

exercises.name: Жим двух гирь над головой
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position at your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Press both kettlebells straight overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower back to the rack position and repeat.
tips: Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs before each press.
Keep your forearms vertical as you drive the bells up.
Avoid flaring your ribs or arching your lower back at lockout.

exercises.name: Жим лёжа в Смите
instructions: Lie on a flat bench set inside a Smith machine.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest.
Pause briefly without bouncing.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Align the bench so the bar lands at mid-chest, not the neck.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down against the bench.
Keep your feet planted and your glutes on the bench.

exercises.name: Жим лёжа с паузой
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your chest.
Pause on your chest for 1-2 seconds.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Control the descent on every rep.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Stay tight during the pause instead of letting the bar sink.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.
Touch the bar to the same spot on your chest every rep.

exercises.name: Жим на наклонной скамье с паузой
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Pause on your chest for 1-2 seconds.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your shoulder blades retracted throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows during the pause.
Maintain full-body tension while the bar rests on your chest.
Avoid bouncing the bar off your chest after the pause.

exercises.name: Жим над головой без веса
instructions: Встаньте прямо, стопы на ширине таза, кисти в свободных кулаках на уровне плеч, ладони вперёд, локти под запястьями.
Напрягите корпус и ягодицы, чтобы рёбра не выпирали.
Выжмите обе руки строго вверх до полного выпрямления, плечи у ушей.
Подконтрольно опустите кисти к плечам.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: В конце кисти прямо над плечами, а не перед лицом.
Не отклоняйтесь назад и не прогибайте поясницу, чтобы поднять руки выше.
Когда движение станет чистым, добавьте лёгкие гантели или резину.

exercises.name: Жим ногами
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform by bending your knees.
Push the platform back up until legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back and hips pressed into the seat.
Lower only as far as you can without your hips tucking under.
Drive evenly through your whole foot, not just your toes.

exercises.name: Жим ногами с высокой постановкой стоп
instructions: Set the back pad and seat so your lower back stays supported and your knees can bend without your pelvis rolling under.
Place both feet high on the platform at about shoulder width, with the toes tracking in the same direction as the knees.
Lower the sled by bending the hips and knees until you reach a comfortable depth without the lower back lifting from the pad.
Press through the whole foot and extend the hips and knees without locking the knees aggressively.
Lower the sled under control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the pelvis heavy against the pad; a high foot position does not justify rounding the lower back at the bottom.
Keep the heels and the whole foot planted rather than letting the toes carry the sled.
Use a depth that preserves pelvic position instead of chasing a deeper range with a tucked pelvis.

exercises.name: Жим ногами узкой постановкой
instructions: Отрегулируйте сиденье и спинку, чтобы поясница была с опорой весь повтор.
Поставьте стопы близко друг к другу около середины платформы, носки и колени смотрят в одну сторону.
Опускайте платформу, сгибая колени и таз; стопы плоско, колени над носками.
Выжмите платформу всей стопой до выпрямления ног, не защёлкивая колени.
Подконтрольно вернитесь и повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Ставьте стопы настолько узко, насколько колени комфортно идут над носками.
Пятки на платформе, колени не заваливаются внутрь при опускании.
Не жертвуйте положением таза ради глубины: остановитесь, пока поясница не начала отрываться и округляться.

exercises.name: Жим ногами широкой постановкой
instructions: Set the back pad and seat so your lower back remains supported at the bottom of the repetition.
Place your feet wide on the platform with the toes turned out only as far as the knees can follow comfortably.
Lower the sled by bending the hips and knees while keeping the knees aligned with the toes and the feet flat.
Press through the whole foot and extend the hips and knees without forcing the knees into lockout.
Lower the sled under control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a width and toe angle that your hips can control; wider is not automatically better.
Keep the knees moving in the same direction as the toes rather than letting them collapse inward.
Stop the descent before the pelvis rolls under and the lower back loses contact with the pad.

exercises.name: Жим одной ногой
instructions: Sit in a leg press machine with one foot placed on the platform.
Keep the other leg off the platform, resting to the side.
Release the safeties and lower the platform by bending your knee.
Stop when your knee is near a 90-degree angle.
Drive through the heel to press the platform back up.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your foot flat and centered on the platform.
Avoid letting your knee cave inward.
Don't lock out the knee forcefully at the top.

exercises.name: Жим от груди в кроссовере
instructions: Установите блоки на уровне груди и встаньте спиной к тренажёру.
Возьмите по рукояти в каждую руку и шагните вперёд в разножку.
Выжмите рукояти вперёд до выпрямления рук.
Сожмите грудь в конечной точке.
Подконтрольно вернитесь и повторите.
tips: Жмите обе рукояти равномерно, чтобы не скручивать корпус.
Напрягите корпус против тяги блоков назад.
Отойдите достаточно далеко, чтобы тросы были натянуты весь повтор.

exercises.name: Жим от груди в тренажёре
instructions: Сядьте в тренажёр, спина прижата к спинке.
Возьмитесь за рукояти на уровне груди.
Выжмите рукояти вперёд до полного выпрямления рук.
Медленно вернитесь в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Отрегулируйте сиденье, чтобы рукояти были на уровне середины груди.
Лопатки сведены и прижаты к спинке во время жима.
Выпрямляйте руки полностью, но не блокируйте локти с силой.

exercises.name: Жим Паллофа на блоке
instructions: Установите блок на уровне груди и возьмите рукоять обеими руками, стоя боком к тренажёру.
Отойдите, пока трос не натянется: стопы на ширине плеч, колени мягко согнуты.
Подведите рукоять к центру груди, напрягите корпус и ягодицы.
Выжмите рукоять прямо перед собой до выпрямления рук, сопротивляясь тяге, разворачивающей вас к тренажёру.
Задержитесь в вытянутом положении, затем подконтрольно верните рукоять к груди.
Сделайте нужное число повторов, развернитесь и повторите в другую сторону.
tips: Ничего не должно поворачиваться. Если плечи разворачиваются к блоку при жиме, уменьшите вес — смысл именно в вращении, которого не происходит.
Чем дальше от тренажёра, тем длиннее рычаг и тяжелее упражнение — сложность меняется без смены веса.
Руки на уровне груди, плечи опущены; если рукоять уходит вверх, получается подъём перед собой.

exercises.name: Жим Свенда с блином
instructions: Stand upright holding a single weight plate (or two pressed together) between your palms at chest height.
Squeeze the plates hard to generate tension through the pecs.
Press the plates straight out in front of you until the arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the squeeze, then return the plates to the chest.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: The harder you squeeze the plates, the more chest activation you get.
Keep the plates at sternum height throughout — do not let them drop toward the hips.

exercises.name: Жим Свенда с гантелью
instructions: Встаньте и сожмите две гантели горизонтально друг с другом на уровне груди.
Сжимайте гантели внутрь всё упражнение.
Выжмите гантели вперёд почти до выпрямления рук.
Подконтрольно верните их к груди.
Повторите заданное число раз.
tips: Суть упражнения в сжатии гантелей — не давайте им разойтись.
Вес лёгкий — цель включить грудь, а не поднять тяжёлое.
В конечной точке локти слегка согнуты.

exercises.name: Жим Свенда с гирей
instructions: Stand and press two kettlebells together by squeezing the bells at chest height.
Hold the kettlebells horizontal — bells touching, handles outward.
Press the kettlebells forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pull them back to the chest under control.
Repeat for the prescribed reps.
tips: The squeeze on the bells is what makes the exercise.
Use very light kettlebells — the awkward grip dictates the load.
Keep the elbows slightly bent at the lockout.

exercises.name: Жим Свенда с одной гантелью
instructions: Stand tall and hold a single dumbbell upright in front of your sternum, the handle running vertically between your flat palms.
Squeeze your palms hard into the dumbbell so the chest takes the tension and the weight cannot slip.
Press the dumbbell straight forward until your arms are almost straight, keeping it at chest height the whole way out.
Pause briefly without letting the squeeze go, then draw the dumbbell back to your chest under control.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: The squeeze on the dumbbell is what makes the exercise. If you are gripping the handle instead of crushing the weight between flat palms, the chest is not working.
Use a light dumbbell. Your palms hold it up on friction alone, so the grip sets the ceiling long before the chest does.
Keep the elbows slightly bent at the lockout and the dumbbell at sternum height throughout; letting it sag toward the hips takes the pecs out of it.

exercises.name: Жим сидя в Смите
instructions: Position a bench inside a Smith machine.
Sit facing forward with the bar at shoulder height.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack and press the bar straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Align the bench so the bar tracks just in front of your nose.
Brace your core to keep the lower back from over-arching.
Plant your feet firmly on the floor for a stable base.

exercises.name: Жим Спото
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar until it is one inch above your chest.
Pause there for a full second without touching the chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are extended.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and pinned to the bench.
Hold the bar motionless during the pause instead of letting it drift.
Use a lighter load than your standard bench press.

exercises.name: Жим стоя в Смите
instructions: Sit on a bench positioned inside a Smith machine.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width at shoulder level.
Unrack the bar and press it overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower the bar back to shoulder level under control.
Keep your core tight throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Sit directly under the bar path before unracking.
Tilt your head back slightly as the bar passes your face.
Avoid flaring your ribs as the bar travels overhead.

exercises.name: Жим штанги в лендмайне
instructions: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment and load the other end with a plate.
Stand in a staggered or square stance and cup the sleeve end of the barbell in both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and press the bar forward and upward along its natural arc.
Fully extend your arms without locking the elbows, then lower the bar back under control.
Keep both hands on the bar throughout and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning excessively into the press.
The angled path makes it more shoulder-friendly than a strict overhead press.
Use a push-press leg drive for heavier loads.

exercises.name: Жим штанги из-за головы
instructions: Сядьте или встаньте, штанга лежит на верхних трапециях за шеей.
Возьмите гриф шире плеч.
Выжмите штангу строго вверх до выпрямления рук.
Подконтрольно опустите штангу в исходное положение.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Опускайте штангу только насколько комфортно позволяют плечи.
Предплечья вертикальны под грифом весь жим.
Напрягите корпус, чтобы не прогибать поясницу в верхней точке.

exercises.name: Жим штанги лёжа
instructions: Лягте на скамью, глаза под грифом.
Возьмите гриф чуть шире плеч.
Снимите штангу со стоек и опустите к середине груди.
Выжмите штангу до полного выпрямления рук.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Стопы плотно на полу.
Сохраняйте небольшой прогиб в пояснице.
Упирайтесь ногами для устойчивости.

exercises.name: Жим штанги лёжа на полу
instructions: Lie on the floor and position yourself under a barbell in a rack.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your chest until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up to lockout.
Repeat.
tips: Elbows touching the floor provides a natural stopping point.
Useful for addressing lockout weakness.

exercises.name: Жим штанги лёжа узким хватом
instructions: Лягте на горизонтальную скамью и возьмитесь за штангу на ширине плеч.
Опустите штангу к низу груди, локти близко к бокам.
Выжмите до полного выпрямления рук.
Повторите.
tips: Локти прижаты — так сильнее работает трицепс.
Не берите слишком узко, чтобы не перегружать запястья.

exercises.name: Жим штанги лёжа широким хватом
instructions: Lie on a flat bench. Grip the barbell wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press back up to full extension.
Repeat.
tips: A wider grip reduces triceps involvement.
Avoid excessive wrist bending.

exercises.name: Жим штанги на наклонной скамье
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up to full extension.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pinched together against the bench.
Lower the bar without bouncing it off your chest.
Keep your feet planted and your glutes on the bench.

exercises.name: Жим штанги на наклонной скамье узким хватом
instructions: Установите наклон скамьи. Возьмите штангу на ширине плеч или уже.
Опустите штангу к верху груди.
Выжмите вверх.
Повторите.
tips: Наклон усиливает растяжение длинной головки трицепса.
Локти прижаты, чтобы нагрузка оставалась на трицепсе.

exercises.name: Жим штанги на скамье с отрицательным наклоном
instructions: Установите скамью с отрицательным наклоном. Лягте и зафиксируйте ноги.
Возьмите гриф чуть шире плеч.
Опустите штангу к низу груди и выжмите вверх.
Повторите.
tips: Контролируйте опускание.
Локти примерно под 45° к корпусу.

exercises.name: Жим штанги сидя
instructions: Set an upright bench inside a rack with the pins at about shoulder height when seated.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and unrack the barbell at the front of the shoulders.
Press the bar overhead until the arms are fully extended, tucking the head through at the top.
Lower the bar back to the collarbones under control.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the ribs down and glutes tight; do not lean back into a bench press.
Drive the bar straight up, not forward.

exercises.name: Жим EZ-грифа лёжа
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet planted on the floor, gripping the EZ bar's angled bends over your chest.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar under control toward your lower chest.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor and maintain a slight arch in your lower back for a stable base.
The EZ bar's angled grip is easier on the wrists than a straight barbell.
Lower the bar to your lower chest and keep your elbows tucked at roughly 45 degrees to protect the shoulders.

exercises.name: Жим EZ-грифа лёжа на полу
instructions: Lie on the floor holding an EZ-bar over your chest.
Lower the bar until your elbows touch the floor.
Press back up to full extension.
Repeat.
tips: The EZ-bar reduces wrist strain vs. a straight bar.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Жим EZ-грифа лёжа узким хватом
instructions: Лягте на горизонтальную скамью и возьмитесь за внутренние изгибы EZ-грифа.
Опустите гриф к груди, локти прижаты.
Выжмите до полного выпрямления рук.
Повторите.
tips: EZ-гриф снижает дискомфорт в запястьях.
Двигайтесь подконтрольно.

exercises.name: Жим EZ-грифа на наклонной скамье
instructions: Set bench to 30–45 degrees. Grip the EZ-bar with hands on the angled sections.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press back up to full extension.
Repeat.
tips: The incline shifts emphasis to the upper pectorals.
Control the descent to avoid shoulder strain.

exercises.name: Жим EZ-грифа на скамье с отрицательным наклоном
instructions: Установите скамью с отрицательным наклоном. Зафиксируйте ноги и возьмитесь за EZ-гриф.
Опустите гриф к низу груди.
Мощно выжмите вверх.
Повторите.
tips: Изогнутый хват снижает нагрузку на запястья.
Корпус напряжён.

exercises.name: Задний вис
instructions: Повисните на перекладине прямым хватом и проверните тело назад через руки до перевёрнутого положения.
Опустите тело вперёд и вниз до горизонтали, лицом к полу.
Руки прямые, всё тело — одна жёсткая линия от головы до пяток.
Напрягите корпус и ягодицы, чтобы таз и плечи не провисали.
Удерживайте положение заданное время, затем подконтрольно вернитесь вверх.
tips: Начинайте с группировки и варианта на одной ноге, прежде чем делать полный вис.
Опустите и сведите лопатки, чтобы беречь плечи.
Держите тело жёстким: любой излом в тазу или прогиб разрушает удержание.

exercises.name: Запрыгивания на тумбу
instructions: Встаньте в 30 см перед устойчивой тумбой, стопы на ширине плеч.
Опуститесь в четверть приседа и отведите руки назад.
Взмахните руками вверх и мощно выпрыгните на тумбу.
Приземлитесь мягко на обе стопы, колени согнуты.
Сойдите вниз шагом — не спрыгивайте — и подготовьтесь заново.
tips: Всегда сходите шагом — частые спрыгивания перегружают ахиллово сухожилие.
Приземляйтесь мягко на всю стопу, колени над носками.
Берите высоту, которую берёте чисто, без подтягивания таза.

exercises.name: Захлёст голени
instructions: Stand tall with the feet under the hips and the arms bent as for running.
Begin jogging lightly in place.
Flick one heel up towards the same-side glute without driving the knee forward.
Switch feet quickly and continue alternating at an even rhythm.
Stay light on the forefeet and keep the torso upright for the full interval.
tips: Aim for quick relaxed contacts rather than forcing the heel into the glute.
Keep the knees pointing down instead of lifting them like high knees.
Start slowly and increase cadence only after the rhythm feels smooth.

exercises.name: Зашагивания на платформу
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box surface.
Drive through that heel to lift your body onto the box.
Bring your trailing foot up to stand fully on the box.
Step back down leading with the same foot.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side before switching.
tips: Push through the lead heel rather than springing off the back leg.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Control the descent instead of dropping off the box.

exercises.name: Из низкого выпада в полушпагат
instructions: Start in a low lunge with the back knee on the floor and the front knee over the ankle.
Press the hands into the floor or onto blocks either side of the front foot.
Shift the hips back over the back knee and straighten the front leg, flexing that foot.
Hold the half split briefly, then glide the hips forward into the low lunge again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions and change sides.
tips: Keep the back of the front leg long: bend the knee slightly rather than rounding the spine to reach.
Move the hips, not the front foot; the foot stays where it started.
Pad the back knee and use blocks under the hands if the floor is out of reach.

exercises.name: Из собаки мордой вниз в низкий выпад
instructions: Start in downward dog with the hands shoulder-width apart.
Shift the weight forward and step one foot up between the hands.
Lower the back knee to the floor and sink the hips into a low lunge.
Press back through the hands, lift the back knee and step the front foot back to downward dog.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.
tips: Step the foot all the way to the hands rather than landing short and shuffling.
Pad the back knee with a folded mat if the floor is hard.
Keep the front knee above the ankle when the hips sink.

exercises.name: Из собаки мордой вниз в планку
instructions: Set up in downward dog with the hips high and the hands shoulder-width apart.
Shift the weight forward and lower the hips until the body forms a straight line in a high plank.
Hold the plank for a moment with the ribs down and the glutes engaged.
Press the floor away and lift the hips back up into downward dog.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move the hips, not the hands; the palms stay in the same place the whole set.
Keep the shoulders pushing away from the ears in both positions.
Slow the transition down if the lower back sags on the way into the plank.

exercises.name: Из собаки мордой вниз в собаку мордой вверх
instructions: Start in downward dog with the hips high and the hands shoulder-width apart.
Shift forward through plank and lower slightly, then press the chest through into upward dog with the thighs off the floor.
Draw the shoulders back and down and keep the neck long.
Tuck the toes, press the floor away and lift the hips back into downward dog.
Continue moving between the two positions for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move the hips, not the hands; the palms stay planted the whole set.
Press the tops of the feet down in upward dog so the thighs actually lift.
Slow down through the middle of the transition rather than swinging between the ends.

exercises.name: Казачьи приседания
instructions: Встаньте в широкую стойку, носки слегка наружу.
Перенесите вес на одну сторону, сгибая это колено и опускаясь в глубокий присед.
Другая нога прямая, пятка на полу, носок вверх.
Опускайтесь настолько, насколько позволяет подвижность, грудь поднята.
Оттолкнитесь согнутой ногой в центр и повторите в другую сторону.
tips: Пятка рабочей ноги на полу — не уходите на носок.
Носок прямой ноги смотрит вверх, держа напряжение в приводящих.
При необходимости держите лёгкий вес у груди как противовес.

exercises.name: Канаты
instructions: Закрепите канаты за неподвижную опору и возьмите по концу в каждую руку.
Отойдите, чтобы канаты умеренно провисали.
Встаньте в четверть приседа, стопы на ширине плеч.
Быстро поднимайте и опускайте руки поочерёдно, посылая волны по канатам.
Продолжайте заданный рабочий интервал.
tips: Держите четверть приседа весь интервал.
Создавайте усилие ногами и тазом, а не только руками.
Волны ровные и плотные.

exercises.name: Касания пяток лёжа
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart.
Lift the head and shoulders slightly off the floor and reach the arms down along your sides.
Crunch to one side and reach that hand toward the heel on the same side.
Return to the center and reach toward the opposite heel.
Keep alternating sides in a smooth rhythm while the lower back stays on the floor.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the neck long and the chin off the chest; lead with the ribcage, not the head.
Keep each reach small and controlled; the shoulder blades only just clear the floor.
Keep the feet planted and the lower back pressed into the floor throughout.

exercises.name: Концентрированный подъём гири на бицепс
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh, letting the kettlebell hang.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder, keeping the elbow pinned against your leg.
