Squeeze the bicep at the top, then lower slowly under control.
Finish all reps on one side, then switch arms.
tips: Keep the upper arm braced and still -- only the forearm moves.
Rotate the wrist slightly as you curl for a stronger peak contraction.
Use a lighter weight than a standard curl -- strict form matters more here.

exercises.name: Концентрированный подъём на бицепс
instructions: Сядьте на скамью, ноги врозь, гантель в одной руке.
Упритесь локтем во внутреннюю сторону бедра.
Поднимите гантель к плечу.
Подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите на обе стороны.
tips: Плечо вертикально, двигается только предплечье.
Не раскачивайте корпус, помогая весу.
Делайте одинаковое число повторов на каждую руку, чтобы избежать дисбаланса.

exercises.name: Косые скручивания к противоположному колену
instructions: Лягте на спину, колени согнуты, кисти слегка за ушами.
Скручивайтесь с поворотом, ведя правый локоть к левому колену, колено подтягивается навстречу.
Подконтрольно вернитесь в исходное положение.
Повторите на другую сторону, чередуя каждый повтор.
tips: Скручивайтесь грудной клеткой, а не руками; локти следуют за плечами.
Поясница на полу всё время.

exercises.name: Лазание по канату
instructions: Grip the rope as high as you can with both hands.
Either wrap the rope around one foot (S-hook or J-hook) or pinch it between both feet.
Pull with your arms and bring your knees up, then clamp the rope with your feet and stand up on the foot lock.
Reach higher with one hand, then the other, release the feet, and clamp the rope again higher up.
Repeat until you reach the top of the rope.
Descend hand-under-hand with the feet controlling the speed — never slide.
tips: Learn the foot lock before attempting longer climbs; it doubles your work capacity.
Never drop from the top; controlled descent is part of the exercise.

exercises.name: Лёгкая поза
instructions: Sit on the floor and cross the shins comfortably, each foot under the opposite knee.
Sit up on a folded blanket or cushion until the knees rest below the level of the hips.
Stack the ribs over the pelvis and let the hands rest on the thighs.
Hold the seat for the prescribed time, breathing slowly and evenly.
Switch which shin is in front on the next round so both sides get equal time.
tips: If the knees float high, raise the seat rather than forcing them down.
Let the chin stay level so the neck follows the line of the spine.
Support the knees on cushions when a long sit gets uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Лопаточные подтягивания
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended.
Keep your arms straight throughout the movement.
Depress and retract your shoulder blades to lift your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Return to a fully hanging position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Think of pulling your shoulder blades down into your back pockets.
Avoid swinging or kipping to keep the movement strict.
Focus on small, precise movement quality rather than maximum height.

exercises.name: Лыжный тренажёр
instructions: Stand facing the SkiErg with the handles overhead and the feet about hip-width apart.
Brace the trunk and drive the handles down by pulling with the lats while hinging slightly at the hips.
Finish with the hands beside the thighs and the knees softly bent.
Let the cords retract as you return the arms overhead and stand tall.
Repeat smoothly while keeping the heels planted and the torso controlled.
tips: Lead the pull with the lats instead of turning it into an arm-only movement.
Keep the hinge compact; do not collapse into a deep squat.
Allow the handles to return under control so the cords stay taut.

exercises.name: Махи гантелью одной рукой
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell on the floor slightly in front of you.
Hinge at your hips, keeping a flat back, and grasp the dumbbell with one hand.
Hike the dumbbell back between your legs, then explosively drive your hips forward.
Swing the dumbbell up to chest height, keeping your arm relaxed and straight.
Allow the dumbbell to swing back down, hinging at the hips as it descends.
Repeat for desired reps per side, maintaining control.
tips: Focus on driving with your hips, not pulling with your arm.
Keep your core braced throughout the movement for stability.
Maintain a neutral spine; avoid rounding your back.
Control the eccentric phase as the dumbbell swings down.

exercises.name: Махи гирей
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips, grip the kettlebell, and hike it back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height.
Let the kettlebell swing back between your legs.
Repeat in a fluid motion.
tips: Power the swing with your hips, not your arms or shoulders.
Treat it as a hinge, not a squat, with minimal knee bend.
Finish each rep standing tall with glutes squeezed and core tight.

exercises.name: Махи гирей одной рукой
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the kettlebell with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height.
Let gravity bring the kettlebell back between your legs.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your shoulders square as the offset load tries to rotate you.
Power the movement with your hips, not by lifting with your arm.
Hinge with a flat back rather than squatting the swing.

exercises.name: Махи ногой в сторону
instructions: Stand tall and brace the trunk, using a stable support if needed.
Shift the weight onto one leg and lift the other foot slightly from the floor.
Swing the free leg across the front of the body.
Reverse the motion and swing it out to the side through a comfortable range.
Continue smoothly, then change legs.
tips: Keep the pelvis facing forward instead of rotating with the swinging leg.
Use a range you can control without leaning the torso.
Let the movement grow gradually rather than forcing the first repetition.

exercises.name: Махи ногой вперёд-назад
instructions: Stand tall beside a stable support and shift the weight onto the inside leg.
Brace the trunk and lift the outside foot slightly from the floor.
Swing the free leg forwards through a comfortable range.
Let it travel back behind the body without arching the lower back.
Continue smoothly, then repeat with the other leg.
tips: Keep the torso tall and let the movement come from the hip.
Use a small range first and increase it as the hip warms up.
Keep the standing foot planted and the pelvis facing forward.

exercises.name: Медвежья ходьба
instructions: Встаньте на четвереньки: кисти под плечами, колени под тазом.
Упритесь носками и приподнимите колени на несколько сантиметров от пола.
Сохраняя ровную спину и низкий таз, шагните вперёд правой рукой и левой ногой одновременно.
Затем левой рукой и правой ногой — ползите вперёд в ровном ритме.
Корпус напряжён, таз не раскачивается из стороны в сторону.
tips: Двигайте разноимённые руку и ногу вместе, как в преувеличенном ползании.
Колени низко, таз ровно — не подбрасывайте и не раскачивайте его.

exercises.name: Молотковое сгибание одной рукой
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and hold one dumbbell at your side with the palm facing inward.
Brace your trunk and keep the working upper arm beside your ribs as the arm hangs straight.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder without rotating the palm or swinging the torso.
Squeeze the elbow flexors at the top, then lower the dumbbell under control until the arm is straight.
Complete the repetitions on one side, then switch arms and repeat.
tips: Let the weaker arm set the repetitions and weight so both sides receive the same work.
Keep the wrist neutral and the shoulder quiet; the movement should come from bending the elbow.
Use a controlled lowering phase instead of dropping the dumbbell from the top.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания к противоположному плечу
instructions: Встаньте прямо, гантели в руках нейтральным хватом.
Поднимите одну гантель поперёк тела к противоположному плечу.
Локоть неподвижен у бока.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите другой рукой.
Чередуйте нужное число раз.
tips: Локоть прижат к боку весь подъём.
Не раскачивайте корпус, помогая весу.
Опускайте подконтрольно, не роняйте гантель.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания на наклонной скамье
instructions: Sit on an incline bench holding dumbbells with a neutral grip.
Allow arms to hang straight.
Curl the dumbbells up in a hammer motion.
Lower slowly.
Repeat.
tips: The incline provides a greater stretch.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания на скамье Скотта
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with palms facing each other.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your wrists neutral.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your upper arms flat against the pad.
Avoid locking out the elbows completely at the bottom.
Control the lowering phase rather than dropping the weight.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания с гантелями
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other.
Curl the weights up while keeping your palms facing inward.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout.
Keep your wrists straight and rigid throughout the curl.
Avoid leaning back or swinging the weights up.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания с гирей
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand, gripping the handle in a neutral position (palm facing the body).
The bell rests on or beside the forearm.
Keep the elbow tucked to the side and curl the bell up toward the shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Control the offset mass — the bell wants to rotate at the bottom of the ROM.
Elbow stays still; only the forearm moves.
Light load — this biases brachialis, not peak bicep size.

exercises.name: Молотковые сгибания с канатом на блоке
instructions: Закрепите канат на нижнем блоке и встаньте лицом к тренажёру.
Возьмите канат нейтральным хватом, ладони друг к другу.
Поднимите канат к плечам, локти прижаты к бокам.
Сожмите вверху, затем медленно опустите до полного выпрямления.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Локти неподвижны всё движение.
Вверху слегка разводите концы каната для сильнее сокращения.
Не раскачивайте корпус.

exercises.name: Наклон вперёд ноги врозь
instructions: Stand with the feet wide apart and the outer edges parallel.
Place the hands on the hips, lift the chest and hinge forward from the hip joints.
Bring the hands to the floor under the shoulders and let the head hang.
Hold the fold for the prescribed time, shifting the weight slightly into the balls of the feet.
Bring the hands back to the hips and come up with a flat back.
tips: Micro-bend the knees so the fold comes from the hips rather than the lower back.
Keep the feet parallel; turning them out takes the stretch out of the inner thighs.
Rest the hands on blocks when the floor is out of reach.

exercises.name: Наклон вперёд сидя
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs straight out in front.
Keep your back long and hinge forward from the hips.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
tips: Lead with your chest, not your head, to keep the back long.
Stretch to mild tension, never to pain.

exercises.name: Наклон вперёд стоя
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and legs straight.
Hinge at your hips and fold your torso down toward the floor.
Let your hands and head hang toward your feet.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
tips: Bend your knees slightly if your hamstrings feel tight.
Ease into the stretch slowly — never bounce.

exercises.name: Наклон вперёд стоя с полуподъёмом
exercises.nameEn: Standing Forward Fold to Half Lift
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and fold forward from the hips.
Rest the hands on the shins, the floor or blocks.
Slide the hands up the shins and lift the chest until the back is flat and the spine is long.
Fold back down, letting the head and neck release.
Continue alternating between the two for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep a soft bend in the knees so the movement comes from the hips.
Lift to a flat back rather than looking up; the neck follows the spine.
Draw the shoulders away from the ears in the lifted position.

exercises.name: Наклон к колену сидя
instructions: Sit with one leg straight in front of you and the other knee bent out to the side, that foot at the inner thigh.
Turn the chest towards the straight leg so the navel lines up with the thigh.
Hinge from the hips and reach forward along the straight leg with a long spine.
Hold the fold for the prescribed time, breathing into the back of the leg.
Come up with a flat back and repeat on the other side.
tips: Sit on a folded blanket so the pelvis can tip forward instead of the back rounding.
Keep the toes of the straight leg pointing up rather than rolling out.
Use a strap around the foot when the hands do not reach it comfortably.

exercises.name: Наклоны «гуд морнинг» без веса
instructions: Встаньте, стопы на ширине таза, руки за головой.
Колени слегка согнуты, корпус напряжён.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, опуская корпус к параллели с полом.
Подайте таз вперёд и выпрямитесь.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Отводите таз назад, как будто закрываете дверь позади себя.
Позвоночник нейтральный от головы до копчика всё время.
Остановитесь, когда задняя поверхность бедра растянута до предела.

exercises.name: Наклоны «гуд морнинг» в Смите
instructions: Set the bar at upper-back height, step under it and settle it across your traps, then unrack it with your feet about hip-width apart.
Soften your knees slightly and keep them there -- this is a hinge, not a squat.
Push your hips straight back and let your torso tip forward, keeping your back flat and your head in line with your spine.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, with your torso somewhere near parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing the glutes at the top, and repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Use much less weight than you would for a squat. The bar is a long way from your hips at the bottom, and that lever, not the number on the bar, is what the exercise costs you.
Hips back, not chest down. If your torso drops without your hips travelling backwards you are bending your spine instead of hinging at the hip.
Let the range of motion end where your back would start to round. Depth on a good morning is set by your hamstrings, and the machine will happily take you past that point.

exercises.name: Наклоны «гуд морнинг» с резиной
instructions: Встаньте обеими стопами на мини-ленту и заведите её за шею.
Стопы на ширине таза, колени слегка согнуты.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, отводя таз назад, спина ровная.
Опускайтесь до растяжения задней поверхности бедра.
Подайте таз вперёд и выпрямитесь.
tips: Движение идёт из таза, а не из поясницы.
Грудь поднята, спина ровная всё время.
Берите ленту такой силы, чтобы проходить полную амплитуду.

exercises.name: Наклоны в сторону с гантелью
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep the opposite hand on your hip or behind your head.
Bend laterally toward the dumbbell side, lowering it along your thigh.
Return to upright, then bend to the opposite side using only your obliques.
Complete all reps per side.
tips: Avoid leaning forward or backward — move strictly sideways.
Use a controlled tempo in both directions.
Keep the weight close to your leg throughout.

exercises.name: Наклоны со штангой «гуд морнинг»
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while keeping your back flat.
Lower your torso until it's nearly parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Repeat.
tips: Start with a light bar and master the hinge first.
Keep a soft bend in your knees throughout.
Stop the descent if your lower back starts to round.

exercises.name: Наматывание груза на ролик
instructions: Grip the wrist roller handle with arms extended in front at shoulder height.
Let the weight hang from the cord.
Roll the handle forward with alternating wrist movements to wind the weight up.
Keep your arms straight throughout.
Once fully wound, reverse the rotation to lower the weight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Use full wrist rotations rather than small partial turns.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging as you roll.
Control the unwinding phase instead of letting the weight drop.

exercises.name: Наружная ротация плеча на блоке
instructions: Установите блок на уровне локтя и возьмитесь за рукоять.
Встаньте боком к тренажёру, рабочий локоть согнут на 90°.
Прижмите локоть к боку и поворачивайте предплечье наружу.
Задержитесь в конце движения.
Подконтрольно вернитесь. Сделайте повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Берите лёгкий вес, чтобы вращение было строгим и подконтрольным.
Запястье прямое, на одной линии с предплечьем.
Не поднимайте плечо и не скручивайте корпус.

exercises.name: Негативные подтягивания
instructions: Use a box or jump to position yourself at the top of a pull-up.
Grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Hold your chin above the bar briefly.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds with control.
Fully extend your arms at the bottom.
Reset and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Fight for control during the final third of the descent.
Keep your shoulder blades engaged instead of hanging passively.
Stop the set once you can no longer lower slowly.

exercises.name: Низкий выпад
instructions: From kneeling, step one foot forward so the knee stacks over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck that foot.
Tuck the tailbone slightly and press the hips forward until you feel the front of the back thigh lengthen.
Lift the chest, raise the arms if it feels good, and hold for the prescribed time.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
tips: Pad the back knee with a folded mat if the floor is hard.
Squeeze the back glute to deepen the stretch without arching the lower back.
Keep the front knee above the ankle rather than letting it slide forward.

exercises.name: Ноги на стене
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall with one hip touching it.
Swing the legs up the wall as you lie back, so the hips end close to the base of the wall.
Let the legs rest against the wall with the feet relaxed and the arms open at the sides.
Stay for the prescribed time, breathing slowly.
Bend the knees and roll to one side to come out.
tips: Slide the hips a few centimetres away from the wall if the hamstrings feel pulled.
Place a folded blanket under the pelvis for a gentler, more supported version.
Keep the legs passive; this position is meant to cost no effort.

exercises.name: Нордические сгибания
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a fixed support.
Keep your torso upright and your hips extended.
Slowly lower your body forward by resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands just before hitting the floor.
Push back up and pull yourself to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Lower as slowly as possible — the eccentric is the point.
Keep your hips extended; do not fold at the waist.
Catch yourself with your hands and push off lightly while building strength.

exercises.name: Носки к перекладине
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended and body still.
Engage your lats and core to prevent swinging.
Raise your legs with straight knees, reaching your toes up toward the bar.
Touch the bar with your toes, then lower your legs under control.
Repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Initiate the movement from your core, not by kicking with momentum.
Exhale forcefully as you raise your legs to increase intra-abdominal pressure.
If you cannot reach the bar yet, build up with hanging leg raises first; they are the easier step towards it.

exercises.name: Обратная планка
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Hold the position for the desired duration.
Lower your hips with control to exit.
tips: Don't let your hips sag as the hold progresses.
Keep your gaze up to maintain a neutral neck.
Press evenly through your palms to reduce wrist strain.

exercises.name: Обратные выпады без веса
instructions: Встаньте прямо, стопы на ширине таза.
Шагните одной ногой назад и опускайте колено к полу.
Опускайтесь, пока переднее бедро не станет параллельно полу.
Оттолкнитесь передней пяткой и вернитесь в стойку.
Повторите на обе стороны.
tips: Вес не нужен — сосредоточьтесь на равновесии и подконтрольном опускании.
Корпус вертикально, не наклоняйтесь вперёд.
Шагайте назад достаточно далеко, чтобы переднее колено не выходило за носок.

exercises.name: Обратные выпады в Смите
instructions: Set the bar so it sits across your upper traps when you stand, then unrack it with your feet under your hips.
Step one foot straight back and lower the rear knee toward the floor, keeping the front shin vertical and most of your weight on the front foot.
Stop when the rear knee is just short of the floor and the front thigh is roughly parallel to it.
Push through the front heel and bring the rear foot back to standing under the bar.
Complete all the repetitions on one side, then switch legs, or alternate legs on every repetition.
tips: Step back far enough. A short step puts the front knee well past the toes, which the fixed bar path will not let you correct once you are loaded.
The stepping foot does the travelling; the front foot does not move at all. If it shifts between reps, your step is too long or too short.
The rack removes the balance, not the load -- keep the trunk braced and stand up out of the bottom rather than leaning back into the bar.

exercises.name: Обратные выпады с гантелями
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower your knee toward the floor.
Lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Repeat on both sides.
tips: Keep the front knee tracking in line with your toes.
Stay upright through the torso rather than leaning forward.
Lower the back knee softly instead of dropping it to the floor.

exercises.name: Обратные выпады с гирей
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell held in one hand, arm extended down, on the same side as the leg that will lunge back.
Step one leg straight back, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest upright, ensuring your back knee hovers just above the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Complete all reps per side before switching to the other side.
tips: Maintain a stable core throughout the movement to protect your spine.
Focus on a controlled descent and a powerful ascent.
Keep your front foot flat and distribute weight evenly through the heel and midfoot.
Avoid letting your front knee collapse inward; keep it tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Обратные выпады со штангой
instructions: Положите штангу на верх спины и встаньте прямо.
Сделайте длинный шаг назад одной ногой.
Подконтрольно опустите заднее колено к полу.
Вернитесь в стойку, упираясь пяткой передней ноги.
Сделайте повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Шагайте назад достаточно далеко, чтобы передняя голень была почти вертикальна.
Опускайте заднее колено строго вниз, не наклоняясь вперёд.
Грудь поднята, таз ровный всё время.

exercises.name: Обратные нордические сгибания
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your knees hip-width apart, shins and the tops of your feet on the floor, and your torso upright.
Keep your hips extended and core braced.
Slowly lean your torso backward while keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control with your quadriceps.
Pull yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your hips extended throughout — don't let them fold.
Lower only as far as you can control.
Use a pad under the knees for comfort.

exercises.name: Обратные отжимания в обратной планке
instructions: Sit with the legs straight and the hands on the floor behind the hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into the hands and heels and lift the hips into a straight-leg reverse plank.
Bend the elbows straight back and lower the hips a short way towards the floor.
Push back up until the arms lock out, keeping the hips high.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the hips lifted at the bottom; sitting down between reps removes the load.
Keep the elbows tracking straight back rather than flaring outwards.
Bend the knees if the straight-leg version is too demanding on the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Обратные отжимания в позе краба
instructions: Сядьте, колени согнуты, стопы на полу, руки на полу позади, пальцы к пяткам.
Надавите на ладони и стопы и поднимите таз, пока корпус не окажется примерно на уровне коленей.
Сгибайте локти строго назад, опуская таз к полу, не садясь.
Выжмите себя до прямых рук, таз поднят.
Повторите нужное число раз и опустите таз.
tips: Локти смотрят назад, не разводите их в стороны.
Держите таз высоко весь подход; опустили — это уже отдых.
Отставьте стопы дальше — рычаг длиннее, трицепс работает сильнее.

exercises.name: Обратные отжимания от скамьи
instructions: Сядьте на скамью, руки на краю по бокам от таза.
Сместите таз со скамьи, ноги вытянуты.
Опуститесь, сгибая локти до 90°.
Выжмите себя ладонями в исходное положение.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: При опускании таз близко к скамье.
Не давайте плечам заваливаться вперёд в нижней точке.
Согните колени, чтобы облегчить упражнение.

exercises.name: Обратные разведения в тренажёре
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height, then sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with your arms reaching forward and a slight bend in the elbows.
Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears and brace your trunk.
Sweep the handles out and back in a wide arc, leading with the elbows, until your arms are roughly in line with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly without leaning back off the pad.
Return the handles forward slowly and repeat for the planned repetitions.
tips: Lead with the elbows rather than pulling with the hands, so the rear deltoids do the work and not the biceps.
Keep the chest on the pad and the neck relaxed; leaning back or shrugging moves the load to the upper trapezius.
Choose a weight you can lower under control; a lighter load with a slow return works the rear deltoids better than a heavy swing.

exercises.name: Обратные скручивания
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides.
Raise your legs with knees bent to 90 degrees.
Curl your hips off the floor by contracting your lower abs.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Curl your pelvis rather than swinging your legs for momentum.
Exhale as your hips lift to deepen the abdominal contraction.
Press your arms into the floor for added stability.

exercises.name: Обратный выпад с жимом гири одной рукой
exercises.nameEn: Kettlebell Offset Reverse Lunge and Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at shoulder height on one side.
Step backward into a reverse lunge with the opposite leg.
As you reach the bottom of the lunge, press the kettlebell overhead.
Drive through your front heel to return to standing.
Lower the kettlebell back to shoulder height.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your hips square as you step back into the lunge.
Brace your trunk to resist bending toward the loaded side.
Lower your back knee with control instead of dropping into the bottom.

exercises.name: Отведение бёдер сидя с мини-лентой
instructions: Сядьте на скамью или стул, мини-лента вокруг колен.
Стопы на полу на ширине таза, спина прямая.
Разводите колени против ленты, включая ягодицы.
Коротко задержитесь в пиковом сокращении, затем медленно сведите колени.
Контролируйте движение по всей амплитуде.
tips: Начинайте движение со сжатия ягодиц.
Не откидывайтесь назад и не используйте инерцию; корпус неподвижен.
Выбирайте ленту, с которой движение остаётся подконтрольным.
Держите ленту натянутой даже в исходном положении.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги в сторону на четвереньках
instructions: Set up on hands and knees with the hands under the shoulders, the knees under the hips and the back flat.
Brace the trunk so the hips stay level and square to the floor.
Keeping the knee bent at about 90 degrees, lift one knee out to the side until the thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without rotating the pelvis or leaning away from the working side.
Lower the knee back to the starting position under control.
Complete the repetitions on one side, then switch legs.
tips: Move only at the hip; if the lower back twists or the torso tips, the range is too big.
Keep the knee bent at the same angle for the whole set.
Press the supporting hand and knee into the floor so the standing side does not sag.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги в сторону на четвереньках с мини-лентой
instructions: Наденьте мини-ленту чуть выше колен и встаньте на четвереньки: кисти под плечами, колени под тазом.
Корпус напряжён, спина ровная, позвоночник нейтральный всё упражнение.
Медленно отведите одно колено в сторону, сохраняя угол 90°, пока бедро не станет параллельно полу.
Коротко задержитесь вверху, сжимая ягодицу, затем медленно и подконтрольно опустите ногу.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Двигайтесь подконтрольно, не поднимайте ногу рывком.
Таз неподвижен, корпус не поворачивается и не заваливается.
Лента натянута по всей амплитуде.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги в сторону стоя с мини-лентой
instructions: Наденьте мини-ленту на лодыжки или чуть выше колен.
Встаньте прямо, колени слегка согнуты, корпус напряжён.
Перенесите вес на одну ногу, корпус устойчив.
Медленно отведите свободную ногу в сторону, чувствуя сокращение ягодицы.
Подконтрольно верните ногу в исходное положение.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Корпус вертикально, не заваливайтесь в сторону.
Двигайтесь подконтрольно, без инерции.
Лента натянута по всей амплитуде.
Движение начинается от таза, а не от стопы.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги лёжа на боку
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Keep the bottom leg slightly bent.
Raise the top leg toward the ceiling.
Lower under control.
Repeat on both sides.
tips: Keep hips stacked throughout.
Avoid tilting the pelvis.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги назад на блоке
instructions: Закрепите манжету на нижнем блоке и наденьте её на лодыжку.
Встаньте лицом к тренажёру, слегка держась за раму, и немного наклонитесь вперёд.
Отведите ногу с манжетой назад, полностью разгибая таз, колено почти прямое.
Сожмите ягодицу при полном разгибании, затем медленно верните стопу.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Ведите движение пяткой — так ягодица работает сильнее задней поверхности бедра.
Таз ровный, не разворачивайте его при отведении ноги.
Движение только в тазобедренном — спина и корпус неподвижны.

exercises.name: Отведение ноги назад на четвереньках
instructions: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, drive one heel toward the ceiling.
Squeeze the glute at the top of the movement.
Lower the leg back to the starting position with control.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor — avoid rotating.
Focus on squeezing the glute, not just lifting the leg.
Add a resistance band or cable for progressive overload.

exercises.name: Отведение одной руки в рычажном тренажёре
instructions: Set the seat height so the pad pivot lines up with your shoulder, and load only the side you are about to work.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and place the outside of your working upper arm against its pad.
Hold the handle on the free side or rest that hand in your lap, and keep your torso square to the seat.
Push the working arm out and up against the pad until the upper arm is level with your shoulder, then lower it under control.
Complete all the repetitions on that side, then load and work the other side.
tips: Match the sides on the weaker arm, not the stronger one. Working one side at a time only tells you about an imbalance if you let the weaker side set the number.
Do not let the torso tip toward the working side. With load on one arm only, the machine no longer balances itself and leaning turns the raise into a side bend.
Start with the weaker arm so it sets the target, and give both sides the same rest.

exercises.name: Отведение руки в сторону на блоке
instructions: Встаньте боком к нижнему блоку и возьмите рукоять дальней от тренажёра рукой.
Локоть слегка согнут, трос проходит перед телом.
Поднимите руку в сторону до параллели с полом.
Подконтрольно опустите. Сделайте повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.
Держите напряжение — вес не ложится внизу.
tips: Ведите движение локтем, а не кистью.
Коротко задерживайтесь вверху, не раскачивайтесь.
Вес легче, чем с гантелями: натяжение троса постоянное.

exercises.name: Отведение руки с гантелью лёжа на боку
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your bottom arm supporting your head or gripping the bench edge.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand with your arm resting along your side.
Keeping your elbow slightly bent, raise the dumbbell upward until your arm is perpendicular to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the dumbbell slowly back to your side.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.
tips: Keep your torso still — only the working arm should move.
The lying position removes momentum and isolates the lateral deltoid effectively.
Use a lighter weight than your standing lateral raise — the leverage is more challenging.

exercises.name: Отжимания
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up to the starting position.
Keep your body in a straight line throughout.
Repeat.
tips: Tuck your elbows toward your body rather than flaring them out wide.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to prevent sagging hips.
Keep your neck neutral by gazing slightly ahead of your hands.

exercises.name: Отжимания «алмаз»
instructions: Встаньте в упор лёжа, кисти близко, пальцы образуют «алмаз».
Локти прижаты к бокам.
Опустите грудь к кистям.
Выжмите себя до выпрямления рук.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Локти идут назад вдоль корпуса, не в стороны.
Тело — жёсткая прямая линия от головы до пяток.
Опускайтесь подконтрольно, пока грудь не коснётся кистей.

exercises.name: Отжимания «лучник»
instructions: Встаньте в упор лёжа с широкой постановкой рук, руки прямые.
Опускайтесь к одной руке, держа другую прямой.
Держите корпус напряжённым, тело — в прямую линию.
Выжмите себя в исходное положение.
Чередуйте стороны каждый повтор нужное число раз.
tips: При смещении в сторону таз остаётся параллелен полу.
Прямая рука должна помогать как можно меньше.
Начните с широких отжиманий и каждое занятие смещайтесь чуть дальше.

exercises.name: Отжимания «пайк» (уголком)
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips high and hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet closer to your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Press back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: The higher your hips, the more the shoulders work.
Lower your head toward a spot slightly ahead of your hands.
Walk your feet closer to your hands to progress toward handstand push-ups.

exercises.name: Отжимания «человек-паук»
instructions: Start in a high plank with the hands slightly wider than the shoulders and the body in a straight line.
Begin to lower the chest toward the floor and at the same time lift one foot off the floor.
Draw that knee out and up toward the elbow on the same side, keeping the hips low.
Press back up to the plank while returning the leg to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.
tips: Keep the hips level; letting them pike or sag takes the work off the trunk.
Bring the knee toward the elbow without letting the foot touch the floor.
Lower with control and keep the elbows at about 45 degrees to the body.

exercises.name: Отжимания в псевдопланше
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands turned so fingers point back.
Lean your shoulders forward past your wrists.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up while maintaining the forward lean.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: The further you lean forward, the harder each rep becomes.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lower.
Keep your shoulder blades protracted and your body rigid.

exercises.name: Отжимания в стойке на руках
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Stop just before your head touches the ground.
Press through your hands to return to full handstand.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your elbows at roughly 45 degrees rather than flared wide.
Brace your core so your back does not arch away from the wall.
Build up through pike push-ups and partial ranges first.

exercises.name: Отжимания на брусьях
instructions: Возьмитесь за параллельные брусья и выйдите в упор на прямых руках.
Слегка наклоните корпус вперёд.
Опуститесь, сгибая локти, пока плечи не окажутся ниже локтей.
Выжмите себя в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Плечи опущены, подальше от ушей.
Согните колени и скрестите лодыжки, чтобы меньше раскачиваться.
Прекратите опускание, если чувствуете защемление в плечах.

exercises.name: Отжимания на брусьях в гравитроне
instructions: Встаньте коленями на платформу гравитрона для отжиманий.
Возьмитесь за брусья и удерживайте вес на прямых руках.
Опускайтесь, сгибая локти, пока плечи не окажутся ниже локтей.
Выжмите себя в исходное положение.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Отводите локти назад, а не разводите широко в стороны.
Прекратите опускание, если чувствуете защемление в плечах.
Постепенно уменьшайте помощь по мере роста силы.

exercises.name: Отжимания на брусьях с отягощением
instructions: Attach a plate to a dip belt around your waist so the weight hangs between your legs.
Grip the parallel dip bars and press yourself up to the top position with your arms locked out and your feet off the floor.
Lean your torso slightly forward and lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below them.
Press back up through your palms until your arms are locked out again, keeping the hanging plate from swinging.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Add weight only once you can do clean bodyweight dips through a full range — small jumps of 2.5–5 kg are enough, since the load stacks on top of your own bodyweight.
Keep your legs together and your core braced so the plate does not start swinging; a swinging weight throws off the bottom of the rep.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears and stop the descent if you feel pinching at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Отжимания на кольцах
instructions: Support yourself on the rings with arms locked out.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat.
tips: Keep the rings close to your body.
Turn the rings out at the top for additional chest activation.

exercises.name: Отжимания на кольцах
instructions: Set the rings just above floor height.
Grip the rings and assume a plank position with arms straight.
Lower the chest toward the rings, keeping the elbows close to the body.
Press back up to full arm extension.
Repeat for the prescribed reps.
tips: Keep the rings turned out at the top to engage the chest.
Brace the core — the rings will magnify any wobble.
Drop to knees to scale the difficulty.

exercises.name: Отжимания на прямой перекладине
instructions: Grip a straight bar overhand, slightly wider than shoulder-width, and jump into a straight-arm support on top of it with the bar at your hips.
Lean your chest slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower yourself toward the bar, keeping the elbows pointing back.
Stop when the bar is close to your upper chest or at the deepest point you can control.
Press down through the bar to straighten your arms and return to the support position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Lean the chest forward over the bar as you lower; the bar is in front of you, so staying upright tips you backwards.
Engage your core to keep your body from swinging.
This is a harder wrist and shoulder position than standard dips -- build up volume gradually.

exercises.name: Отжимания от возвышения
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or elevated surface, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you into a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the bench by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat.
tips: Check that the elevated surface is stable before starting.
Keep your elbows tucked rather than flared out wide.
Progress to a lower surface as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Отжимания от стены
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your palms on it at shoulder height.
Step your feet back until your arms are fully extended.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Keep your body in a straight line throughout.
Press back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Avoid flaring your elbows straight out to the sides.
Step your feet farther from the wall to increase the difficulty.
Keep your core engaged so your hips do not sag.

exercises.name: Отжимания с дефицитом
instructions: Поставьте руки на две опоры, например упоры или блоки.
Встаньте в планку, кисти под плечами.
Опустите грудь ниже уровня кистей.
Выжмите себя до выпрямления рук.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Не давайте тазу провисать при глубоком растяжении.
Работайте на безболезненной глубине и увеличивайте её постепенно.
Локти уходят назад, а не широко в стороны.

exercises.name: Отжимания с колен
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your knees on the floor.
Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the ground.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press through your hands to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips from sagging.
Keep your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso.
Lower with control instead of dropping your chest quickly.

exercises.name: Отжимания с ногами на возвышении
instructions: Поставьте стопы на возвышение, руки на пол.
Подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу.
Выжмите себя в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Тело — прямая линия.
Чем выше опора ног, тем сильнее работает верх груди.

exercises.name: Отжимания с ногами на фитболе
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your shins or feet on top of it.
Set the hands on the floor under the shoulders in a high-plank position.
Brace the core hard — the ball will want to roll sideways.
Lower the chest to the floor by bending the elbows.
Press back up to the starting position without letting the ball wobble.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Start with shins on the ball; feet-only is much harder.
If the ball drifts side to side, you're lacking core bracing — slow down.

exercises.name: Отжимания с руками на фитболе
instructions: Place both hands on top of a stability ball and walk your feet back into a straight-arm plank, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and keep the ball steady beneath your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the ball under control.
Press back up to full arm extension without letting the ball roll.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your body in a rigid straight line — do not let your hips sag or pike up.
Move slowly and deliberately; the wobble of the ball is what makes the exercise work, so resist it rather than fight it fast.
Set your hands slightly wider than shoulder width on the ball for a more stable base, and keep your elbows tucked to about 45 degrees.

exercises.name: Отжимания с хлопком
instructions: Встаньте в обычный упор лёжа.
Опустите грудь к полу.
Мощно оттолкнитесь, чтобы руки оторвались от пола.
Хлопните в ладоши и мягко приземлитесь в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Приземляйтесь на мягкие локти, гася удар.
Убедитесь, что верх тела достаточно силён, прежде чем пробовать.

exercises.name: Отжимания сидя в рычажном тренажёре
instructions: Load the plates evenly on the sleeve and adjust the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height when you are seated.
Sit upright with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides with your elbows bent.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up, then press the handles down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom, with your arms straight but not locked out hard.
Let the handles rise back up under control until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Repeat for the planned repetitions, then return the lever to its safety stop before you stand up.
tips: Start light and add plates gradually; if the handles stop short of full extension the load is too heavy.
Keep the elbows close to your sides and your back against the pad so the work stays on the triceps.
Do not let the shoulders roll forward or shrug as the handles rise; stop where the stretch in the chest and shoulders is comfortable.

exercises.name: Отжимания сидя в тренажёре
instructions: Select your weight on the stack and adjust the seat so the handles are at about shoulder height when you are seated.
Sit upright with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides with your elbows bent.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up, then press the handles down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom, with your arms straight but not locked out hard.
Let the handles rise back up under control until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Repeat for the planned repetitions, keeping your back against the pad.
tips: Keep the elbows close to your sides so the work stays on the triceps.
Do not let the shoulders roll forward or shrug as the handles rise; stop where the stretch in the chest and shoulders is comfortable.
Keep your back against the pad; leaning forward shifts the work toward the chest.

exercises.name: Отжимания узкой постановкой рук
instructions: Встаньте в упор лёжа, кисти точно под плечами.
Локти прижаты к рёбрам.
Опустите грудь к полу.
Выжмите себя в исходное положение.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Локти уходят назад, а не в стороны.
Тело — жёсткая планка всё время.
Опускайтесь медленнее, чтобы сильнее включить трицепс.

exercises.name: Отжимания широкой постановкой рук
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Press back up until your arms are extended.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your elbows at roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Lower until your chest is close to the floor.

exercises.name: Передний вис
instructions: Grip the bar with an overhand grip and hang.
Tuck your knees to your chest and pull your straight arms down toward your hips, leaning back until your torso is horizontal and your chest faces up.
Extend your body horizontally with arms straight and chest facing the ceiling.
Keep your body rigid and parallel to the floor.
Hold for the desired duration, then tuck and lower under control.
tips: Progress through tuck and straddle holds before attempting the full extension.
Squeeze your core and glutes to prevent the hips from dropping.
Keep the shoulders actively depressed away from the ears throughout the hold.

exercises.name: Переноска «чемодан»
instructions: Stand beside a single kettlebell or dumbbell with your feet under your hips.
Hinge at the hips, take the handle in one hand and stand up with the weight hanging at your side.
Pull that shoulder down and back, and brace as if you were about to be pushed sideways.
Walk forward with normal, even strides, keeping your torso upright and square rather than leaning away from the weight.
Keep the free arm relaxed at your side instead of sticking it out as a counterweight.
Carry for the desired distance or time, set the weight down under control, then repeat on the other side.
tips: Do the same distance on both sides. The whole value is in the asymmetry, and it only works if you load both directions equally.
If you find yourself tipping toward the weight or hiking the opposite hip, the weight is too heavy — this is a posture drill first.
Grip usually gives out before the trunk does. That is a legitimate training effect, but if it is always the limit, use straps for the heavier sets.

exercises.name: Переноска гантели над головой
instructions: Поднимите гантель взятием или жимом на прямую руку строго над плечом.
Выпрямите руку до конца: локоть прямой, бицепс у уха.
Опустите рёбра и напрягите корпус, а не держите вес прогибом поясницы.
Идите вперёд подконтрольными шагами, гантель над плечом и тазом.
Смотрите вперёд — если запрокинуть голову к весу, за ней уходит осанка.
Пройдите нужную дистанцию, подконтрольно опустите и повторите другой рукой.
tips: Проходите одинаковую дистанцию каждой рукой, чтобы несимметричная нагрузка не дала несимметричный результат.
Прямой локоть обязателен. Мягкий локоть перекладывает вес со скелета на мышцу, и подход кончается раньше.
Если рёбра выпирают и спина прогибается, вес слишком тяжёл для вашей позиции над головой — сначала исправьте позицию.

exercises.name: Переноска гири над головой
instructions: Clean and press a kettlebell to lockout, letting the bell settle on the back of your forearm.
Straighten the elbow fully and turn the arm so the bell sits behind and above your wrist rather than off to the side.
Keep the shoulder active: push the weight up toward the ceiling and let the shoulder blade rotate up with it rather than forcing it down.
Brace your trunk and walk forward with even strides, keeping the bell stacked over your shoulder and hip.
Keep your wrist straight; letting it bend back is what makes an overhead bell feel unstable.
Carry for the desired distance, lower under control, then repeat on the other side.
tips: Go lighter than you would with a dumbbell. The offset mass makes the same weight noticeably harder to keep still.
A bent wrist is the usual failure point. If it keeps collapsing, drop the weight rather than fighting it for the whole distance.
Do both sides for the same distance — the unilateral load is the point of the exercise.

exercises.name: Переноска двух гантелей над головой
instructions: Поднимите взятием или жимом по гантели на прямую руку над каждым плечом.
Полностью выпрямите оба локтя и продолжайте тянуться вверх, чтобы плечи были активны, а гантели не проседали на них.
Сильно напрягите корпус, рёбра опущены — с двумя руками над головой желание прогнуться гораздо сильнее.
Идите вперёд короткими осознанными шагами, обе гантели над плечами.
Дышите неглубоко и ровно, не задерживайте дыхание на всю переноску.
Пройдите нужную дистанцию, затем подконтрольно опустите оба веса.
tips: Начните с веса на руку меньше, чем в переноске одной гантели. Две руки над головой — это вдвое больше стабилизации, а не вдвое легче.
Заранее продумайте, как сбросить вес, и работайте там, где это безопасно.
Короткая дистанция чисто лучше длинной с прогибом. Заканчивайте подход, когда рёбра начинают выпирать, а не когда отказывают плечи.

exercises.name: Переноска двух гирь над головой
instructions: Возьмите две гири на грудь, затем выжмите или вытолкните обе на прямые руки над головой.
Выпрямите оба локтя, гиря лежит позади и над запястьем, запястья прямые.
Опустите рёбра и сильно напрягите корпус до первого шага; с двумя гирями над головой нечем уравновешиваться.
Идите вперёд короткими подконтрольными шагами, обе гири над плечами.
Смотрите прямо и дышите ровно всю переноску.
Пройдите нужную дистанцию, затем подконтрольно опустите гири в стойку и вниз.
tips: Это надо заслужить: сначала уверенно носите одну гирю над головой с обеих сторон.
Работайте только там, где можно безопасно сбросить обе гири, и заранее знайте, куда шагнёте.
Дистанция короткая, осанка идеальная. Прогнулась спина или сломалось запястье — подход окончен.

exercises.name: Пилатес: «пила»
instructions: Sit tall with the legs straight and slightly wider than the hips, arms out to the sides.
Rotate the torso to one side, keeping both sit bones on the floor.
Fold forward over that leg and reach the opposite hand past the little toe.
Roll back up through the spine and return to the centre.
Repeat to the other side and continue alternating.
tips: Anchor both sit bones; lifting one of them turns the twist into a lean.
Rotate first, then fold - the order is what makes the exercise work.
Sit on a folded blanket if the pelvis cannot stay upright.

exercises.name: Пилатес: боковой изгиб
instructions: Sit on one hip with the legs bent to the side and the supporting hand on the floor under the shoulder.
Press into the hand and the lower leg to lift the hips off the floor.
Reach the top arm overhead so the body forms a long arc from the hand to the feet.
Lower the hips under control back towards the mat.
Complete the repetitions and change sides.
tips: Push the floor away so the supporting shoulder stays stacked and stable.
Reach the top arm long rather than collapsing sideways.
Keep the movement smooth; the lift and the lower take the same time.

exercises.name: Пилатес: вытяжение позвоночника вперёд
instructions: Sit tall with the legs straight and slightly wider than the hips, feet flexed.
Reach the arms forward at shoulder height.
Drop the chin and curl the spine forward one vertebra at a time, reaching past the toes.
Restack the spine from the base upwards until you are sitting tall again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the pelvis upright: the curl comes from the spine, not from tipping the hips.
Press the heels away throughout so the legs stay active.
Sit on a folded blanket if sitting upright already rounds the lower back.

exercises.name: Пилатес: мах ногой в сторону стоя на колене
instructions: Kneel on one knee and place the same-side hand on the floor, the other hand behind the head.
Extend the top leg out to the side at hip height with the foot flexed.
Keep the trunk perfectly still and swing the leg forward as far as the pelvis stays square.
Swing the leg back behind the line of the body without arching the lower back.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions and change sides.
tips: The trunk is the exercise: if it rocks with the leg, shorten the swing.
Keep the supporting shoulder pushed away from the ear.
Move at a controlled tempo instead of throwing the leg.

exercises.name: Пилатес: перекат через голову
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs straight and the arms pressed into the mat beside you.
Lift both legs to vertical without letting the lower back arch.
Press the arms down and take the legs overhead until they are parallel to the floor behind you.
Open the legs slightly, flex the feet, and roll the spine down one vertebra at a time.
Return the legs to vertical and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Drive the movement with the abdominals, not by throwing the legs.
Keep the weight off the neck: the roll stops at the shoulder blades.
Skip this exercise if you have neck complaints, and build it up with smaller curls first.

exercises.name: Пилатес: подъём ноги в обратной планке
instructions: Sit with the legs straight and the hands on the floor behind the hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into the hands and heels and lift the hips into a reverse plank.
Keeping the hips level and high, lift one straight leg as far as the pelvis stays still.
Lower the leg under control and repeat with the other one.
Finish the set and lower the hips to the floor.
tips: Stop the leg lift where the hips start to drop; height is not the point.
Keep the chest open and the shoulders away from the ears.
Bend the knees slightly if the straight-leg version pulls at the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Пилатес: подъём ноги в планке
instructions: Set up in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in one line.
Brace the trunk and squeeze the glutes so the hips cannot rotate.
Lift one straight leg a few centimetres above hip height without letting the pelvis tilt.
Lower it under control and repeat with the other leg.
Keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Lift the leg from the glute rather than by arching the lower back.
Keep the weight even in both hands; the tendency is to lean away from the lifted side.
Reduce the lift height until the hips stay perfectly level.

exercises.name: Пилатес: скатывание вниз
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and the arms hanging at the sides.
Drop the chin to the chest and start rolling down one vertebra at a time.
Let the arms and head hang heavy once the spine is fully rolled down.
Roll back up the same way, stacking the vertebrae one by one, head last.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the knees soft so the movement comes from the spine, not the hamstrings.
Move slowly enough to feel each segment; speed defeats the purpose.
Keep the weight in the middle of the feet as you roll down.

exercises.name: Пилатес: скручивание позвоночника
instructions: Sit tall with the legs straight and together, feet flexed, arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Grow tall through the spine and press both sit bones into the floor.
Rotate the trunk to one side as far as the hips stay square, then return to the centre.
Rotate to the other side in the same way.
Keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: The legs are the anchor: if one foot slides forward, the pelvis has moved.
Lengthen upwards before each rotation instead of sinking into it.
Turn the head with the trunk rather than leading with it.

exercises.name: Пистолетик
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward, arms out for balance.
Hinge at the hips and bend the standing knee, keeping the chest up.
Descend slowly until the back of the thigh touches the calf.
Drive through the standing heel to return to standing.
Complete reps per side, then switch legs.
tips: Hold a light counterweight at the chest if balance is hard.
Build the strength with box-assisted pistols first.
Keep the working heel flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Пистолетик с гантелью
instructions: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides.
Lift one leg straight out in front of you, keeping it extended throughout the movement.
Lower your body by bending the knee of your standing leg, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Descend until your glutes are close to your heel or your thigh is parallel to the floor, maintaining balance.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position, extending your standing leg fully.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat for the other side per set.
tips: Start with bodyweight pistol squats to master the movement pattern before adding dumbbells.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down at your sides and keep your chest up to stay balanced over the working foot.
Focus on controlling the eccentric (lowering) phase to improve stability and strength.
Elevate your heel slightly on a small plate if ankle mobility is a limiting factor.

exercises.name: Пистолетик с гирей
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Lower your hips down into a one-legged squat.
Keep your raised leg off the floor throughout.
Drive through your standing heel to return to standing.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your standing heel rooted to the floor throughout.
Descend slowly to stay in control at the bottom.
Push the kettlebell slightly forward to counterbalance as you sit back.

exercises.name: Планка
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs back and rise onto your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the desired duration.
Lower your knees to exit the hold.
tips: Do not let your hips sag or pike up.
Squeeze your glutes and quads.

exercises.name: Планка на кольцах
instructions: Set the rings at about knee height and take hold of them with the arms straight under the shoulders.
Step the feet back into a plank, with the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace the abdominals and glutes and press the rings down and slightly out to keep them steady.
Hold the position without letting the hips sag or the rings drift apart.
Step the feet in and stand up to finish.
tips: Keep the rings close to the sides of the chest; if they swing, place the feet wider.
Push the floor away through the rings so the shoulder blades stay wide.
Raise the rings to make the hold easier and lower them to make it harder.

exercises.name: Планка на прямых руках
instructions: Start in a push-up position with arms fully extended.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and hold the position.
Breathe steadily throughout.
tips: Stack your shoulders directly above your wrists.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips from sagging.
Push the floor away to avoid sinking between your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Планш
instructions: Begin in a push-up position with hands turned outward.
Lean forward until your center of mass is over your hands.
Lift your feet off the ground keeping the body horizontal.
Hold the position.
Return to the floor with control.
tips: Progress through tuck, straddle, and full planche.
Build wrist and shoulder strength before attempting.

exercises.name: Плиометрические отжимания
instructions: Set up in a standard push-up position with hands shoulder-width.
Lower yourself with control until the chest nearly touches the floor.
Drive up explosively so the hands leave the floor.
Land softly with the elbows slightly bent.
Repeat without pausing for the prescribed reps.
tips: Keep the body in a straight line — no piking or sagging.
Land softly with bent elbows to absorb impact.
Drop to knees if you cannot clear the floor cleanly.

exercises.name: Повороты корпуса
instructions: Stand with the feet about shoulder-width apart and the knees softly bent.
Brace lightly and hold the hands together in front of the chest.
Rotate the rib cage to one side without shifting the feet.
Return through centre and rotate to the other side.
Continue alternating smoothly through a comfortable range.
tips: Turn from the upper back rather than wrenching the lower spine.
Keep the hips mostly forward and distribute the weight evenly between the feet.
Use a controlled rhythm; this is mobility work, not a ballistic swing.

exercises.name: Подтягивание колена к груди лёжа
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Pull one knee in and hug it to your chest with both hands.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Relax and keep breathing throughout.

exercises.name: Подтягивание коленей в планке
instructions: Set up in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Press the floor away and brace the trunk so the hips neither sag nor pike.
Draw one knee in towards the chest without letting the hips rise.
Extend the leg back to the starting position under control.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the hips level with the shoulders; letting them lift turns this into a pike.
Pull the knee in with the abdominals rather than by hopping off the supporting foot.
Keep the shoulders stacked over the wrists and push the floor away so the upper body does not sink.

exercises.name: Подтягивание коленей к груди сидя на скамье
instructions: Лягте на спину на горизонтальную скамью и держитесь за её края за головой.
Вытяните ноги, пятки чуть выше скамьи.
Подтяните колени к груди, слегка отрывая таз от скамьи.
Подконтрольно выпрямите ноги, не касаясь пятками скамьи.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Поясница прижата к скамье — так меньше работают сгибатели бедра.
Контролируйте опускание, не бросайте ноги.
Вверху каждого повтора сжимайте пресс.

exercises.name: Подтягивание коленей на фитболе
instructions: Start in a high plank with both shins or the tops of the feet on top of a stability ball.
Hands are under the shoulders, body in a straight line.
Brace the core and pull the ball toward the chest by tucking the knees in.
Roll it back out by extending the legs fully back to the plank position.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Hips do not pike up; keep a level trunk throughout the roll-in.
Shoulders stay over the wrists — don't let them drift forward.

exercises.name: Подтягивания
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself under control to a dead hang.
Repeat.
tips: Avoid swinging or kipping.
Engage your lats by pulling your elbows down.

exercises.name: Подтягивания «коммандос»
instructions: Возьмитесь за перекладину кистями одна перед другой, ладони друг к другу, повисните на прямых руках, тело боком.
Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки, начиная движение.
Подтянитесь, опуская локти, пока голова не окажется над перекладиной с одной стороны.
Коротко задержитесь вверху, грудь близко к перекладине.
Подконтрольно опуститесь в полный вис.
В следующем повторе уводите голову на другую сторону или меняйте положение рук каждый подход.
tips: Ноги и корпус неподвижны; раскачка превращает подтягивание в киппинг.
Чередуйте стороны поровну, чтобы обе руки и широчайшие работали одинаково.
Начните с нескольких повторов: разнесённый хват тяжелее обычного.

exercises.name: Подтягивания «лучник»
instructions: Возьмитесь за перекладину хватом шире плеч, ладони от себя.
Подтягивайтесь, смещая тело к одной руке.
Другую руку держите прямой как опору.
Подконтрольно опуститесь в вис.
Чередуйте стороны каждый повтор или сделайте все повторы сначала на одну сторону.
tips: Прямую руку держите полностью выпрямленной и используйте только как направляющую.
Тяните подбородок к рабочей руке, а не строго вверх.
Освойте подтягивания широким хватом, прежде чем переходить к «лучнику».

exercises.name: Подтягивания в гравитроне
instructions: Встаньте коленями на платформу гравитрона.
Возьмитесь за перекладину чуть шире плеч, ладони от себя.
Тяните грудь к перекладине, опуская локти вниз.
Подконтрольно опуститесь в полный вис.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Опустите лопатки вниз до того, как сгибать руки.
Не раскачивайтесь и не используйте инерцию от платформы.
Со временем уменьшайте помощь, двигаясь к подтягиваниям без помощи.

exercises.name: Подтягивания за голову
instructions: Возьмитесь за перекладину хватом сверху шире плеч, повисните на прямых руках, ноги вместе.
Корпус вертикально, без отклонения назад; тяните локти вниз и в стороны.
Подтягивайтесь, пока перекладина не уйдёт за голову и затылок не окажется на её уровне; не касайтесь перекладины шеей.
Подконтрольно опуститесь в полный вис, не дёргая головой вперёд.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Этот вариант обычно не рекомендуют: финиш за головой нагружает плечо в крайней наружной ротации, где сустав хуже всего защищён, а касание шеи перекладиной передаёт нагрузку на шейный отдел.
Обычные или широкие подтягивания тренируют те же мышцы в той же амплитуде — для спины нет нужды заводить перекладину за голову, так что выигрыша за этот риск нет.
Если всё же выполняете, не доводите до касания шеи и откажитесь совсем при неполной подвижности плеч над головой или проблемах с плечами и шеей.

exercises.name: Подтягивания нейтральным хватом
instructions: Grip parallel bars with palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your lats at the top of the movement.
Lower yourself with control to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Initiate each rep by pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
Drive your elbows down toward your ribs as you pull.
Avoid kipping or swinging your legs for momentum.

exercises.name: Подтягивания обратным хватом
instructions: Повисните на перекладине хватом снизу на ширине плеч.
Подтянитесь, пока подбородок не окажется выше перекладины.
Подконтрольно опуститесь.
Повторите.
tips: Корпус напряжён всё время.
Избегайте лишней раскачки.

exercises.name: Подтягивания с отягощением
instructions: Attach a plate to a dip belt around your waist so the weight hangs between your legs, or hold the load between your feet.
Grip the pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and hang at full arm extension with your legs together.
Pull your elbows down and back to drive your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower yourself under control back to the full dead hang, keeping tension on your lats and letting the weight settle before the next rep.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Add weight only once you can do clean bodyweight pull-ups through a full range — small jumps of 2.5–5 kg are enough, since the load stacks on top of your own bodyweight.
Keep your legs together and your core braced so the hanging plate does not start swinging; a swinging weight turns the rep into a kip.
Do not cut the bottom short — return to a full dead hang each rep, and stop the set when your chin stops clearing the bar rather than grinding out partials.

exercises.name: Подтягивания с паузой
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Pause and hold that top position for a moment.
Lower yourself back down under control to a full hang.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: The pause removes momentum, so the pull is harder than a regular pull-up -- expect fewer reps.
Keep your shoulders engaged during the hold instead of relaxing into the bar.
Lower slowly instead of dropping straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Подтягивания с резиной
instructions: Закрепите резину на перекладине и поставьте в петлю одну ногу.
Возьмитесь за перекладину на ширине плеч, ладони от себя.
Тяните грудь к перекладине, опуская локти вниз.
Подконтрольно опуститесь в полный вис.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Не давайте отдаче резины выбрасывать вас из нижней точки.
Держите ногу в резине неподвижно, чтобы петля не соскользнула.
Переходите на более тонкую резину по мере роста силы.

exercises.name: Подтягивания узким хватом
instructions: Повисните на перекладине, кисти на ширине плеч или уже, ладони от себя.
Подтянитесь, пока подбородок не окажется выше перекладины.
Подконтрольно опуститесь.
Повторите.
tips: Узкий хват сильнее включает бицепс.
Для развития силы не используйте киппинг.

exercises.name: Подтягивания широким хватом
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with arms fully extended and core braced.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Keep your shoulders pulled back as you rise.
Lower yourself under control to full extension.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Initiate each rep by depressing your shoulder blades before bending the arms.
Avoid kipping or swinging your legs for momentum.
Squeeze the bar firmly and keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Подъём гантелей на бицепс
instructions: Встаньте с гантелями в опущенных руках, ладони вперёд.
Поднимите гантели к плечам, сгибая руки.
Сожмите бицепс вверху, затем подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Локти прижаты к бокам.
Не раскачивайте гантели.

exercises.name: Подъём гантелей на бицепс сидя
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders by flexing your biceps.
Squeeze at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your elbows pinned at your sides throughout.
Avoid leaning back to help lift the weight.
Straighten your arms fully at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Подъём гантелей перед собой
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Raise one or both dumbbells forward to shoulder height.
Lower under control.
Repeat.
tips: Avoid using momentum.
Slight elbow bend reduces joint stress.

exercises.name: Подъём гири на бицепс одной рукой
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Keep your elbow pinned to your side.
Curl the kettlebell toward your shoulder by flexing your bicep.
Squeeze at the top of the movement.
Lower the kettlebell with control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your wrist straight as the offset weight shifts through the curl.
Brace your core to resist leaning away from the working side.
Avoid swinging the kettlebell up with your hips.

exercises.name: Подъём двух гирь на бицепс
instructions: Встаньте, держа по гире за дужку, ладони вперёд.
Локти прижаты к бокам, гири висят на прямых руках.
Поднимите обе гири к плечам, сгибая локти.
Сожмите бицепсы вверху, затем подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Не давайте гирям раскачиваться — контролируйте опускание.
Локти прижаты к бокам; плечи не поднимаются вперёд.
Держите хват крепко: гиря тянет запястье в разгибание.

exercises.name: Подъём коленей в висе
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your core and raise your knees toward your chest.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Avoid swinging — initiate the movement from your core.
Exhale as you raise your knees.
Progress to straight-leg raises when this feels easy.

exercises.name: Подъём коленей в упоре на локтях
instructions: Встаньте в упор на локтях, спина прижата к спинке, предплечья на подлокотниках.
Ноги свободно свисают вниз.
Напрягите пресс и поднимите колени к груди.
Коротко задержитесь вверху, затем медленно опустите ноги.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Не раскачивайте ноги для инерции.
Выдыхайте при подъёме коленей.
Спина прижата к спинке всё время.

exercises.name: Подъём ног в висе
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging.
Repeat.
tips: Curl your pelvis up at the top to fully engage your abs.
Keep your shoulders engaged rather than hanging passively.
Bend your knees to make the movement easier if needed.

exercises.name: Подъём ног в упоре на локтях
instructions: Встаньте в упор на локтях, спина прижата к спинке, предплечья на подлокотниках.
Ноги свободно свисают вниз.
Не сгибая ног, поднимите их до параллели с полом или выше.
Коротко задержитесь вверху, затем медленно опустите.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Ноги как можно прямее всё время.
Не раскачивайтесь — контролируйте движение прессом.
Для облегчения слегка согните колени.

exercises.name: Подъём ног лёжа
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and hands under your lower back or gripping a stable surface behind your head.
Keeping your legs together and core braced, raise them to vertical (or as high as flexibility allows).
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly toward the floor without letting them touch.
Repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor throughout to protect the lumbar spine.
Avoid swinging — control the descent to maximize tension.
Bend the knees slightly if hamstring flexibility is a limiting factor.

exercises.name: Подъём носков с гирей
instructions: Sit at the end of a flat bench with one leg extended and the heel resting on the floor.
Hang a kettlebell by its handle from the front of the foot, over the toes.
Pull the toes up toward the shin as far as is comfortable while the heel stays on the floor.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly until the toes point toward the floor.
Complete the repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the movement at the ankle; the knee and thigh stay still.
Start with a light kettlebell and increase gradually; the shin muscles tire quickly.
Lower slowly rather than letting the weight drop.

exercises.name: Подъём прямых ног к перекладине
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Engage the lats and brace the core to create a hollow body.
Keeping the legs perfectly straight, lift them in a smooth arc up to the bar.
Aim to touch the toes to the bar between the hands.
Lower the legs slowly back to the hanging position and repeat.
tips: No swinging — every rep starts from a dead hang with a braced trunk.
If full range is too hard, raise only to horizontal and build up.

exercises.name: Подъём руки перед собой на блоке
instructions: Встаньте спиной к нижнему блоку с одиночной рукоятью.
Держите рукоять у бедра, рука вытянута.
Поднимите прямую руку вперёд до уровня плеча.
Задержитесь вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Не раскачивайтесь и не используйте инерцию.
Корпус вертикально; не отклоняйтесь назад при подъёме.
Корпус напряжён, запястье нейтрально всё время.

exercises.name: Подъём рукояти перед собой на нижнем блоке
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low cable pulley and stand facing away from the machine with the cable running forward past your legs.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart, arms hanging straight down in front of your thighs.
Keep the elbows almost straight and the core braced so the torso does not lean back.
Raise the bar forward in a smooth arc until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it under control back to the thighs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a light weight — swinging the bar up with the legs or leaning back takes the work off the front delts.
Stop at shoulder height; raising the bar higher shifts the load onto the traps.
Keep the wrists neutral rather than letting them bend back under the bar.

exercises.name: Подъём штанги на бицепс
instructions: Встаньте, держа штангу хватом снизу на ширине плеч.
Поднимите штангу к плечам, сгибая руки.
