Keep your chest lifted and your spine long as you twist.
Move at a controlled tempo instead of racing through reps.

exercises.name: Русские скручивания с гирей
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet lifted off the ground.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly to engage your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the kettlebell next to your hip.
Rotate to the opposite side in a controlled motion.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Rotate your whole torso, not just your arms.
Keep your spine tall instead of slumping as you twist.
Keep your legs still as your torso moves side to side.

exercises.name: Рывок
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar wide.
Hinge down, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles to drive the bar up.
Pull yourself under the bar into an overhead squat.
Stand up with the bar locked out overhead.
Return the bar to the floor and repeat.
tips: Keep the bar close to your body as it travels up.
Extend your hips fully before pulling under the bar.
Lock your arms out and stabilize before standing up.

exercises.name: Рывок без подседа
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar wide with a hook grip.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, keeping it close to your body.
Shrug hard and pull the bar overhead without dipping under.
Lock out the bar overhead with straight arms.
Lower the bar under control to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Shrug hard and keep pulling the bar up high.
Stay tall; do not dip under the bar to catch it.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the pull.

exercises.name: Рывок гантели
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge and grip the dumbbell with one hand.
Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles to pull the dumbbell upward.
Punch the dumbbell overhead in one fluid motion.
Lock out your arm and stabilize at the top.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Extend your hips and knees fully before pulling with your arm.
Punch the dumbbell up to a stable overhead lockout.
Keep the dumbbell close to your body as it rises.

exercises.name: Рывок двух гирь с пола в ножницы
instructions: Поставьте две гири на пол между стопами.
Наклонитесь и крепко возьмитесь за обе дужки.
Мощно поднимите гири над головой одним движением.
Уйдите в ножницы, принимая гири на прямые руки.
Встаньте, приставив стопы.
tips: Толкайте кисти сквозь дужки для устойчивой фиксации над головой.
В ножницах переднее колено идёт над стопой.
Корпус прямой, когда уходите под гири.

exercises.name: Рывок двух гирь со свинга
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding two kettlebells.
Hinge at the hips to swing the bells between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to swing the bells up.
Punch through to catch both kettlebells overhead with locked arms.
Lower under control and repeat.
tips: Keep your arms relaxed and let your hips generate the power.
Let the bells roll smoothly around your wrists rather than flipping over.
Maintain a flat back during every backswing.

exercises.name: Рывок с виса
instructions: Stand with a wide snatch grip on a barbell held at the thighs and the feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips to lower the bar to just above the knees, keeping the back flat and the shoulders over the bar.
Explosively extend the hips, knees and ankles, shrugging as the bar rises.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand up fully with the bar overhead and stable.
Lower the bar under control back to the thighs and reset.
tips: Keep the bar close to the body throughout the pull.
Finish the pull with full extension before dropping under the bar.
Learn the movement with a light bar or a dowel; the wide overhead catch needs good shoulder and hip mobility.

exercises.name: Сведение ног в тренажёре
instructions: Sit on the hip adduction machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads with the machine set to a comfortable stretch.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet in the middle.
Hold the squeeze briefly in the fully closed position.
Let your legs open back out under control to the start.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Choose a start width that stretches without straining your groin.
Move through the whole range at an even, controlled speed.
Do not let the weight stack slam down as your legs open back out.

exercises.name: Сведение рук в кроссовере
instructions: Встаньте между стойками кроссовера, рукояти на верхних блоках.
Слегка согнув локти, разведите руки широко.
Сведите кисти перед грудью, как будто обнимаете.
Медленно вернитесь в исходное положение.
Повторите.
tips: Угол в локтях постоянный; не выжимайте вес.
Выставьте одну ногу вперёд для устойчивой стойки.
Контролируйте растяжение — не давайте тросам дёргать руки назад.

exercises.name: Сведение рук в тренажёре
instructions: Sit in the chest fly machine and adjust the seat so the handles align with your chest.
Grip the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a smooth arc.
Squeeze your pectorals at the point of peak contraction.
Return under control to the starting position without slamming the weight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows throughout.
Focus on squeezing the chest rather than pushing with the arms.
Control the return instead of letting the weight stack slam.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястий на блоке
instructions: Закрепите прямую рукоять на нижнем блоке.
Встаньте на колени или сядьте, предплечья на скамье, ладони вверх.
Дайте запястьям свеситься за край скамьи.
Поднимите рукоять, сгибая запястья.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Движение только в запястьях; предплечья прижаты к скамье.
Делайте повторы медленно, чтобы не перегрузить запястья.
Коротко задерживайтесь вверху для сильнее сокращения.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястий с гантелями
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, forearms resting on your thighs, palms up.
Let both dumbbells roll down to your fingertips.
Curl both dumbbells up by flexing your wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your forearms pinned to your thighs throughout -- only the wrists move.
Use a lighter load per hand than you would single-arm, since both sides work simultaneously.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястий с EZ-грифом
instructions: Sit on a bench with forearms resting on the thighs, palms up.
Grip an EZ-bar on the inner bends with hands shoulder-width.
Let the bar roll down to the fingertips.
Curl the bar up by flexing the wrists.
Lower under control.
tips: The EZ-bar's angle is gentler on the wrists than a straight bar.
Move only at the wrist — keep the forearms still.
Roll the bar to the fingertips for full range.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястий со штангой
instructions: Сядьте на скамью, предплечья на бёдрах, ладони вверх.
Держите штангу на ширине плеч, кисти свисают за колени.
Внизу дайте грифу скатиться к кончикам пальцев.
Поднимите штангу, сгибая запястья.
Подконтрольно опустите.
tips: Движение только в запястье — предплечья неподвижны.
Скатывайте гриф к кончикам пальцев для полной амплитуды.
Если так удобнее запястьям, держите гриф без обхвата большим пальцем.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястья с гантелью
instructions: Sit on a bench with the forearm resting on the thigh, palm up.
Hold a dumbbell with the wrist hanging off the knee.
Let the dumbbell roll down to the fingertips.
Curl the dumbbell up by flexing the wrist.
Lower under control. Complete reps per side.
tips: Move only at the wrist — keep the forearm still.
Roll the dumbbell to the fingertips for full range.
Train both arms with the same load and reps.

exercises.name: Сгибание запястья с гирей
instructions: Sit on a bench with the forearm on the thigh, palm up.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the wrist hanging off the knee.
Let the kettlebell rotate down toward the fingertips.
Curl it up by flexing the wrist, controlling the offset weight.
Lower under control. Complete reps per side.
tips: Hold the handle, not the bell, so the offset weight loads the grip.
Move only at the wrist.
Use a lighter load than you would for a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Сгибание на бицепс и жим гантелей
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with the palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to the shoulders, keeping the elbows close to the body.
Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders under control.
Lower them to your sides with a controlled reverse curl, then repeat.
tips: Brace the abdominals and keep the ribs down so the press does not turn into a back bend.
Do not swing the weights up with the legs; use a load you can curl strictly.
Press in a slight arc so the dumbbells finish directly over the shoulders.

exercises.name: Сгибание ног лёжа
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with ankles under the pad.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the bench throughout the set.
Avoid jerking the weight up with your lower back.
Use a full range of motion without letting the stack slam down.

exercises.name: Сгибание ног на фитболе
instructions: Лягте на спину, пятки и низ голеней на фитболе, руки в стороны для равновесия.
Упритесь пятками и поднимите таз, чтобы тело стало прямой линией от плеч до стоп.
Держа таз поднятым, сгибайте колени, подкатывая мяч к ягодицам.
Подконтрольно выпрямите ноги, не опуская таз.
Сделайте все повторы, затем опустите таз и уберите ноги с мяча.
tips: Таз поднят весь подход — это одновременно мост и сгибание.
Начинайте двумя ногами; когда станет легко, переходите на одну.

exercises.name: Сгибание ног сидя
instructions: Adjust the seat back and ankle pad so your knees align with the machine's pivot point.
Sit upright, place the backs of your ankles on top of the pad, and grip the handles.
Curl your lower legs down and back under the seat as far as the machine allows.
Pause at peak contraction, then return the weight slowly to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Keep your back firmly against the backrest throughout the movement.
Point toes slightly toward your shins at peak contraction to increase hamstring activation.
Control the eccentric phase — do not let the weight pull your legs back quickly.

exercises.name: Сгибание ноги стоя с мини-лентой
instructions: Накиньте резину на одну лодыжку, другой конец закрепите под опорной стопой или за опору перед собой.
Встаньте прямо, при необходимости держитесь за опору, опорное колено слегка согнуто.
Сгибайте ногу, ведя пятку вверх и назад к ягодице, бедро неподвижно.
Сожмите заднюю поверхность бедра вверху и подконтрольно опустите ногу до полного растяжения.
Сделайте все повторы на одну ногу, затем смените.
tips: Бедро неподвижно — двигается только голень.
Не раскачивайте таз для инерции.
Если не контролируете опускание, возьмите резину полегче.

exercises.name: Сгибание одной ноги лёжа
instructions: Lie face down on a lying leg curl machine.
Position one ankle under the pad, keeping the other foot off the machine.
Curl the working leg by bringing your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the leg back down under control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your hips pressed into the bench throughout the curl.
Avoid jerking the pad up with momentum.
Start with the weaker leg and match its reps on the other side.

exercises.name: Сгибание одной рукой с гантелью на скамье Скотта
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest the back of one upper arm flat on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in that hand with the palm facing up and the arm almost fully extended.
Curl the dumbbell toward the shoulder without lifting the elbow off the pad.
Squeeze the biceps at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until the arm is almost straight.
Complete the repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Stop just short of lockout at the bottom to keep tension on the biceps and spare the elbow.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and the chest against the pad.
Lower the weight more slowly than you lift it.

exercises.name: Сгибание рук в тренажёре
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad to your arm length.
Grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Lower with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arms pressed into the pad throughout the set.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders as you curl.
Extend your arms fully at the bottom without bouncing.

exercises.name: Сгибания Зоттмана
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, arms extended at your sides, and a dumbbell in each hand with the palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms beside your ribs and curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders without swinging the torso.
At the top, keep the elbows bent and rotate the forearms until the palms face down.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with the pronated grip until the arms are straight.
Turn the palms forward again at the bottom and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use less weight than for a standard dumbbell curl; the palms-down lowering phase is usually the limiting part.
Rotate through the forearms while keeping the wrists straight rather than bending them around the handles.
Keep the elbows close to the ribs and avoid turning the curl into a shoulder swing.

exercises.name: Сгибания на бицепс в тренажёре Скотта
instructions: Sit at a preacher curl machine and adjust the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad.
Place the upper arms flat on the pad and grip the handles.
Start with the arms extended — but not locked — at the bottom.
Curl the handles up by flexing the elbows; squeeze hard at the top.
Lower slowly back to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Do not let the elbows lift off the pad at the top.
Stop just short of full extension at the bottom to protect the elbow tendons.

exercises.name: Сгибания на бицепс на нижнем блоке
instructions: Встаньте лицом к нижнему блоку с прямой или EZ-рукоятью.
Возьмите рукоять хватом снизу, локти у боков.
Поднимите рукоять к плечам, сгибая руки.
Подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Не выводите локти вперёд при подъёме.
Внизу полностью выпрямляйте руки.
Не отклоняйтесь назад, помогая поднять вес.

exercises.name: Сгибания с гантелью на скамье Скотта
instructions: Отрегулируйте сиденье: подмышки на верхнем краю упора, плечи лежат вдоль него.
Возьмите гантели хватом снизу, руки опущены вдоль упора.
Поднимите обе гантели к плечам, не отрывая локтей от упора.
Коротко сожмите бицепсы вверху.
Медленно опустите гантели почти до полного выпрямления рук и повторите.
tips: Внизу останавливайтесь чуть раньше полного выпрямления — бицепс под нагрузкой, локти защищены.
Грудь прижата к упору; отклонитесь назад — работу перехватят плечи.
Опускайте медленно, не роняйте вес.

exercises.name: Сгибания с гантелями обратным хватом
instructions: Держите гантели хватом сверху в опущенных руках.
Поднимите их до уровня плеч.
Подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Запястья нейтральны всё время.
Главное — подконтрольное движение.

exercises.name: Сгибания с гантелями сидя на наклонной скамье
instructions: Sit on an incline bench set to 45 degrees, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Let your arms hang straight down with palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower with control to full extension.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your head and shoulders against the bench throughout.
Don't let your elbows drift forward as you curl.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders forward as you lift the weight.

exercises.name: Сгибания с EZ-грифом на скамье Скотта
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ-bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower with control until arms are nearly straight.
Repeat.
tips: Avoid bouncing at the bottom to protect the biceps tendon.
Keep your wrists neutral rather than letting them bend back.
Don't shrug your shoulders as the bar rises.

exercises.name: Сгибания со штангой на скамье Скотта
instructions: Сядьте на скамью Скотта, грудь к упору, штанга в хвате снизу на ширине плеч.
Плотно прижмите плечи к упору, локти в начале слегка согнуты.
Поднимайте штангу, сокращая бицепсы, плечи остаются на упоре.
Сожмите бицепсы в верхней точке.
Медленно опустите штангу, контролируя обратную фазу.
Опускайте почти до полного выпрямления рук, чтобы растянуть бицепс.
tips: Держите бицепс под нагрузкой по всей амплитуде.
Не отрывайте локти от упора — иначе вес слишком большой или вы используете инерцию.
Опускайте медленно: в растянутом нижнем положении локти наиболее уязвимы.
Запястья прямые, на одной линии с предплечьями.

exercises.name: Складка
instructions: Lie face-up on the floor with arms extended overhead and legs extended straight.
Simultaneously lift the torso and the straight legs off the floor.
Reach the hands up toward the feet as the feet rise — meet above the hips.
Lower the torso and legs back to the floor under control.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Arms and legs move at the same speed — avoid a kick-first cheat.
If the lower back arches on the return, slow down and don't fully touch the floor.

exercises.name: Складка «V»
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously raise your legs and upper body toward each other.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top, forming a V shape.
Keep your legs straight throughout the movement.
Lower both ends under control back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your legs straight as you lift them.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower both ends under control rather than dropping flat.

exercises.name: Складка на фитболе
instructions: Положите голени на фитбол, руки на полу в упоре лёжа на прямых руках.
Напрягите корпус, ноги держите прямыми.
Поднимите таз вверх, подкатывая мяч к груди, пока тело не образует перевёрнутую «V».
Сделайте короткую паузу вверху.
Откатите мяч обратно в планку.
tips: Ноги прямые всё время — колени не сгибаются.
Движение идёт в тазобедренных суставах, а не в пояснице.
Если складка тяжела, начните с подтягивания коленей на мяче.

exercises.name: Скручивание Джефферсона
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with straight arms, feet roughly hip-width.
Tuck your chin and begin rounding the spine from the top, one vertebra at a time.
Curl down slowly, letting the weight hang and keeping the legs mostly straight.
Reach the bottom with the back fully rounded and a stretch through the hamstrings.
Reverse it, restacking the spine from the bottom up back to standing.
tips: Use a very light weight -- this is a controlled mobility drill, not a heavy lift.
Round segment by segment; do not hinge at the hips like a stiff-leg deadlift.
Move slowly and never bounce at the bottom.

exercises.name: Скручивание лёжа на спине
instructions: Lie on your back and bend one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor.
Stretch your arms out wide and turn your head away.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Relax and keep breathing throughout.

exercises.name: Скручивание позвоночника сидя
instructions: Sit with one leg straight and cross the other foot over it.
Brace the opposite elbow against the outside of the bent knee.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee and look over your shoulder.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch sides and repeat.
tips: Sit tall and lengthen your spine before twisting.
Twist from the mid-back, not the lower back.

exercises.name: Скручивания
instructions: Лягте на спину, колени согнуты, руки за головой.
Скручивайте верх тела к коленям, отрывая лопатки от пола.
Сожмите пресс вверху.
Подконтрольно опуститесь.
Повторите.
tips: Не тяните шею руками.
Выдох при подъёме, вдох при опускании.
Поясница прижата к полу всё время.

exercises.name: Скручивания на блоке
instructions: Встаньте на колени перед блочным тренажёром, канат закреплён на верхнем блоке.
Держите канат у лба, локти согнуты.
Скручивайтесь вниз, сгибая позвоночник и ведя локти к бёдрам.
Сильно сожмите пресс внизу.
Вернитесь в исходное положение и повторите.
tips: Не тяните канат вниз руками.
Таз неподвижен — движение идёт за счёт позвоночника.
Полностью выдыхайте при скручивании.

exercises.name: Скручивания на наклонной скамье
instructions: Зафиксируйте ноги вверху скамьи с отрицательным наклоном.
Лягте, руки скрещены на груди или за головой.
Скручивайтесь, сгибая позвоночник к коленям.
Сожмите пресс вверху.
Подконтрольно опуститесь и повторите.
tips: Скручивайтесь позвоночником, а не тяните шею.
Выдыхайте при скручивании и сжимайте пресс вверху.
Опускайтесь медленно, не падайте на скамью.

exercises.name: Скручивания сидя в тренажёре
instructions: Sit in the abdominal crunch machine and grip the handles.
Position the chest pad against your upper body.
Contract your abs to crunch your torso forward and down.
Squeeze at the bottom of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Initiate the movement with your abs, not your arms.
Exhale as you crunch forward.
Avoid using momentum by rocking your body.

exercises.name: Скручивания у стены с блином
instructions: Lie on your back and park your legs so your hips cannot help: brace your feet against a wall or a box, or hold your legs up with the knees bent.
Hold a weight against your chest with both hands -- a plate, a dumbbell, or a kettlebell all work.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower with control.
Repeat.
tips: Exhale as you crunch up and inhale on the way down.
Keep your neck relaxed instead of pulling your head forward.
Press your lower back into the floor throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вверх
instructions: Lie face down with the hands beside the lower ribs and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Press the hands down and straighten the arms, lifting the chest and then the thighs off the mat.
Draw the shoulders back and down and keep the neck long.
Hold the position for the prescribed time with only the hands and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Bend the arms and lower down under control.
tips: Keep the shoulders over the wrists rather than behind them.
Press the tops of the feet down; that is what lifts the thighs.
If the thighs cannot lift, stay in cobra instead of forcing the position.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вниз
instructions: Start on all fours with hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs and press your heels toward the floor.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily.
tips: Bend your knees if your lower back rounds.
Press the floor away to lengthen your spine.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вниз на трёх опорах
instructions: Set up in downward dog with the hands shoulder-width apart and the hips high.
Press both hands evenly into the floor and shift the weight slightly forward.
Lift one leg behind you until it is in line with the spine, keeping both hip points level.
Hold the position for the prescribed time with the standing heel reaching down.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep the lifted hip from opening; a square pelvis matters more than height.
Press the base of the index finger down so the wrists stay comfortable.
Bend the standing knee slightly if the hamstring limits the shape.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вниз с «педалями»
instructions: Set up in downward dog with the hands shoulder-width apart and the hips high.
Bend one knee and let that heel lift while the opposite heel presses down towards the floor.
Switch sides smoothly, as if pedalling, keeping the hips high throughout.
Keep the hands pressing evenly so the shoulders stay stable.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions or time.
tips: Keep the hips high; the point is the calves, not a deeper fold.
Press the whole hand into the floor so the wrists do not take all the load.
Move slowly enough to feel each side lengthen rather than bouncing.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вниз с выносом колена
instructions: Set up in downward dog and lift one leg behind you into three-legged dog.
Press both hands down and shift the weight slightly forward.
Round the upper back and drive that knee forward towards the elbow or the nose.
Extend the leg back up to three-legged dog under control.
Finish the repetitions on that side and repeat on the other.
tips: Let the upper back round as the knee comes in; a flat back stops the knee short.
Keep the shoulders over the wrists as you shift forward rather than collapsing past them.
Lift the leg only as high as the hips stay level on the way back out.

exercises.name: Собака мордой вниз с подтягиванием колена
instructions: Set up in downward dog with the hands shoulder-width apart and the hips high.
Press the floor away and brace the trunk so the lower back stays long.
Draw one knee in towards the chest, rounding the upper back slightly as it comes in.
Extend the leg back to the starting position under control.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the hips high; letting them drop turns this into a mountain climber.
Draw the knee in with the abdominals rather than by hopping off the standing foot.
Push the shoulders away from the ears so the upper body does not sink between the arms.

exercises.name: Сплит-приседания
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot forward and one back.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower your hips straight down by bending both knees.
Stop when the back knee is just above the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return to the start.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Lower straight down rather than lunging forward.
Keep most of your weight over the front foot.
Keep the front heel planted throughout the rep.

exercises.name: Сплит-приседания в Смите
instructions: Set the bar on the hooks just below shoulder height, then step under it and rest it across your upper traps.
Unrack the bar and take a long stride forward with one foot, leaving the rear foot planted on the floor with the heel lifted.
Check that your front shin will stay roughly vertical when you descend; adjust the stride length before you start loading it.
Lower straight down by bending both knees until the rear knee is just above the floor and the front thigh is close to parallel.
Drive through the front heel to return to the start, keeping both feet in place, and repeat for the desired reps before switching sides.
tips: Set the stride length first, unloaded. Once the bar is on your back the fixed path will not let you shuffle forward to fix a stance that is too short.
Go straight down rather than forward. The bar can only travel vertically, so pushing the hips forward just jams your front knee past your toes.
Do the same number of reps on each side and start with the weaker leg, since a machine-guided split squat hides a side-to-side difference that a free bar would expose.

exercises.name: Сплит-приседания с гантелями
instructions: Stand in a split stance holding dumbbells at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending both knees.
Stop when your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to standing.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep most of your weight on your front leg.
Lower your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Track your front knee over your toes without letting it cave inward.

exercises.name: Становая тяга
instructions: Встаньте, стопы на ширине таза, гриф над серединой стопы.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных и возьмитесь за гриф.
Напрягите корпус и поднимите штангу, разгибая таз и колени.
Выпрямитесь вверху, затем подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Штанга близко к телу.
Не округляйте поясницу.

exercises.name: Становая тяга на прямых ногах
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs nearly straight with only a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Go as low as your hamstring flexibility allows with a flat back.
Drive through your heels to return upright.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Push your hips back and keep the bar close to your legs.
Go only as deep as a flat back allows.
Feel the hamstrings load in the stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с гантелями
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Keep the dumbbells close to your shins throughout the descent.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
Extend your hips fully at the top without hyperextending your lower back.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Brace your core before each rep to keep your spine stable.
Balance your weight over midfoot rather than your toes.
Keep your neck in line with your spine rather than looking up.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с гирей
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the handle.
Brace your core and set your back flat.
Drive through your heels to stand up with the kettlebell.
Lock out at the top with shoulders pulled back.
Lower the kettlebell back to the floor with control.
tips: Keep the kettlebell close to your shins as you lift.
Think of pushing the floor away rather than lifting with your back.
Look at a spot on the floor ahead to keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с гирей на одной ноге
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge at the hip and lower the kettlebell toward the floor.
Extend your free leg straight back for balance.
Lower until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your standing heel to return to standing.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor as you hinge.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Fix your eyes on one spot to steady your balance.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с дефицитом
instructions: Встаньте на небольшую платформу, нагруженная штанга над серединой стопы.
Наклонитесь и возьмитесь за гриф чуть шире коленей.
Встаньте, отталкиваясь ногами, штанга близко к телу.
Вверху полностью разогните таз и колени.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Спина ровная; дополнительная глубина повышает риск округления.
Вес меньше, чем в классической тяге, чтобы держать положение.
Выберите слабину грифа перед началом тяги.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с паузой
instructions: Set up for a conventional deadlift.
Pull the bar off the floor and pause when it passes your knees.
Hold for 2–3 seconds, then complete the lift.
Lower under control.
Repeat.
tips: The pause removes momentum and builds strength and control from the knees to lockout.
Keep your back flat during the pause.

exercises.name: Становая тяга с трэп-грифом
instructions: Stand inside a loaded trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and knees to grip the handles.
Brace your core and set your back flat.
Drive through your heels and extend hips and knees to stand up.
Lock out at the top with shoulders pulled back.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control.
tips: Keep your chest up and back flat as you set your grip.
Push the floor away rather than yanking the bar with your back.
Stand fully upright at the top without leaning back.

exercises.name: Становая тяга сумо
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed outward.
Grip the bar between your legs.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to stand.
Lower under control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep the bar close to your body.
Push your knees out in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Становая тяга сумо с гирей
instructions: Stand in a wide stance with toes pointed slightly out, a kettlebell on the floor between the feet.
Hinge down with a flat back, knees tracking over the toes, and grip the handle with both hands.
Drive through the floor and extend the hips and knees together to stand up.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower the bell under control back to the floor by pushing the hips back.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Knees track out over the toes — do not let them cave in.
Shoulders stay above the hips at the bottom; if the shoulders drop, narrow the stance.
Keep the bell close to the body throughout the lift.

exercises.name: Статическое боковое сгибание шеи
instructions: Sit or stand tall. Place the palm of one hand against the side of the head, above the ear.
Press the head into the hand while resisting equally with the hand — the head does not move.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly, then repeat on the same side for the set.
Switch sides and repeat.
tips: Match the pressure; this is 50% effort, not a wrestling match.
Keep the jaw relaxed and the shoulders down.

exercises.name: Степпер-лестница
instructions: Step onto the bottom stair with the machine at its slowest setting and take the rails lightly for balance.
Climb one step at a time, placing the whole foot on each stair rather than just the toes.
Stand upright with your chest open and your hips under your shoulders instead of hunching over the console.
Push the step down through the heel of the front foot, letting the glute of that leg do the work.
Set the pace so you can hold your posture, and keep climbing for the desired time or number of floors.
tips: Do not lean on the rails or hook your forearms over them — supporting your weight there takes the load off the legs and the readout stops meaning anything.
Full foot on the step, heel included. Climbing on the toes shifts the whole session into the calves and burns them out early.
Take one step at a time before you try skipping steps; deliberate, upright climbing beats a fast shuffle at the bottom of the staircase.

exercises.name: Стойка на лопатках с опорой
instructions: Lie on your back, ideally with a folded blanket under the shoulders and the head off it.
Lift the legs overhead and support the lower back with both hands, elbows shoulder-width apart.
Walk the hands up the back and stack the hips over the shoulders until the body is vertical.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, keeping the head and neck completely still.
Lower the legs overhead and roll down slowly with the hands supporting the back.
tips: Keep the weight on the shoulders and upper arms, never on the neck.
Do not turn the head while inverted.
Build up with legs-up-the-wall and plow pose before holding this one for long.

exercises.name: Стойка на руках
instructions: Place the hands about shoulder-width apart on the floor and kick up into an inverted position, one leg after the other.
Press tall through the shoulders and keep the arms locked.
Squeeze the glutes and abdominals so the body forms one straight line from the hands to the toes.
Keep the gaze between the hands and hold the position, making small corrections with the fingers.
Come down under control, one leg at a time, or step out of the hold.
tips: Practise against a wall until you can hold the line without leaning on it.
Push the floor away so the shoulders stay elevated, and pull the ribs in to avoid arching the back.
Warm up the wrists before holding.

exercises.name: Строгий подъём на бицепс
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides and palms facing forward.
Pin your elbows against your sides and brace your core so your torso cannot swing.
Curl both dumbbells up by bending only at the elbows.
Lower them under control until your arms are straight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Standing with your back against a wall or post is a useful self-check — if your shoulders or hips leave it, you are using momentum.
Keep the elbows from drifting forward; the upper arms should stay vertical throughout.
Lower slower than you lift — the strict version lives in the descent.

exercises.name: Стульчик у стены
instructions: Stand with back against a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold the position.
Stand back up when done.
tips: Keep knees at 90 degrees.
Press your back flat against the wall.

exercises.name: Толчковый швунг
instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position at your shoulders.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly.
Drive explosively through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Drop into a quarter-squat under the bar and lock out your arms.
Stand up fully and lower the bar to repeat.
tips: Keep your torso upright during the dip.
Drive with your legs before pressing with your arms.
Lock your arms out as you drop under the bar.

exercises.name: Толчок
instructions: Поднимите нагруженную штангу с пола на плечи, как во взятии на грудь.
Выпрямитесь, штанга лежит на передних дельтах.
Слегка подсядьте и мощно вытолкните штангу над головой.
Уйдите в ножницы, принимая штангу на прямые руки.
Встаньте, приставив стопы друг к другу.
tips: Полностью выпрямитесь и выставьте положение перед толчком.
Выталкивайте штангу ногами, а не только руками.
Руки выпрямлены к моменту, когда стопы приземляются в ножницы.

exercises.name: Толчок в ножницы
instructions: Hold the barbell across your front rack with elbows high.
Dip straight down by bending your knees slightly.
Explosively drive the bar overhead with your legs and arms.
Split your feet forward and back as the bar locks out.
Stand up by bringing your feet back together under the bar.
Lower the bar and repeat.
tips: Dip straight down rather than letting your torso tip forward.
Split your feet front and back as the bar locks out.
Bring your front foot back first when recovering.

exercises.name: Толчок двух гирь
instructions: Начните с двумя гирями в стойке на плечах, локти упираются в таз.
Сделайте короткий подсед в коленях, затем мощно разогните ноги, посылая гири вверх.
Когда гири идут вверх, сделайте второй подсед под ними, снова сгибая колени.
Примите гири над головой на прямые руки и полностью выпрямитесь.
Подконтрольно опустите их в стойку и повторите.
tips: В толчке два подседа, а не один — второй позволяет зафиксировать вес лёгкими руками.
Дышите в каждом повторе, выдыхая на каждом подседе и выталкивании, не задерживайте дыхание на весь подход.

exercises.name: Толчок двух гирь в ножницы
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position at your shoulders.
Dip slightly by bending your knees.
Drive the kettlebells overhead explosively.
Split your legs to catch them with locked arms.
Recover by stepping feet back together.
tips: Keep your heels down during the dip to maintain power.
Time the split so your arms lock as your feet land.
Drive with your legs; your arms mainly guide the bells.

exercises.name: Трастер
instructions: Hold a barbell in a front rack position with elbows high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down to parallel while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up out of the squat and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top with the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to the front rack and repeat.
tips: Use the momentum from the squat drive to launch the press.
Keep your elbows high so the bar rests on your shoulders, not your wrists.
Finish each rep with the bar locked out over your ears.

exercises.name: Турецкий подъём с гирей
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell pressed overhead in one hand.
Bend the knee on the same side and plant the foot flat.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then to your hand.
Drive your hips up and sweep your straight leg back into a lunge.
Stand up fully while keeping the kettlebell locked out overhead.
Reverse the sequence to return to the start.
tips: Keep your eyes on the kettlebell until you are standing, then look forward.
Move slowly through each step — the get-up is a sequence, not one motion.

exercises.name: Тяга блока стоя на коленях
instructions: Set a cable pulley to about chest height and attach a rope or double-D handle.
Kneel upright facing the stack far enough back that the weight stack doesn't bottom out.
Grab the handle with both hands and hold it out in front at chest height.
Row the handle to the sternum by driving the elbows back and squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return under control to the stretched starting position.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Stay tall — no leaning back to finish the rep.
The tall-kneeling stance forces the core to resist rotation on every pull.

exercises.name: Тяга в наклоне в Смите
instructions: Stand inside a Smith machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is roughly 45 degrees.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower the bar under control and repeat.
tips: Hold your hip hinge steady rather than rising as you fatigue.
Keep your neck neutral by looking at the floor slightly ahead.
Brace your core to protect the lower back throughout.

exercises.name: Тяга в наклоне обратным хватом в Смите
exercises.nameEn: Smith Machine Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand inside a Smith machine and grip the bar with an underhand grip.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Pull the bar toward your lower abdomen.
Squeeze your lats and shoulder blades at the top.
Lower the bar under control and repeat.
tips: Keep your wrists straight under the underhand grip.
Drive your elbows back close to your sides.
Avoid rising out of the hinge to cheat the bar up.

exercises.name: Тяга в Смите с упором грудью
instructions: Поставьте наклонную скамью в Смит лицом к грифу и опустите гриф так, чтобы руки висели прямо, когда вы лежите на упоре.
Встаньте над скамьёй, стопы на полу, грудь на верхней части упора.
Возьмитесь хватом сверху чуть шире плеч и снимите гриф с крюков на прямых руках.
Тяните гриф к низу груди, ведя локтями и сводя лопатки вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите до прямых рук и повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Грудь на упоре в каждом повторе. Оттолкнулись от него — это уже тяга в наклоне, и смысл упора потерян.
Ведите локтями и останавливайтесь, когда они прошли корпус. Дальше плечи лишь заваливаются вперёд, а фиксированный гриф не даёт им места.
Поясница здесь не работает, поэтому это тяга на день, когда тяга в наклоне невозможна; подбирайте вес по силе спины, а не ног.

exercises.name: Тяга в тренажёре с упором грудью
instructions: Отрегулируйте сиденье, чтобы рукояти были на уровне низа груди; сядьте, прижавшись грудью к упору, стопы на полу.
Потянитесь вперёд и возьмите рукояти, руки вытянуты, плечи расслаблены.
Напрягите корпус и тяните рукояти назад, уводя локти за спину.
В конце тяги сведите лопатки, не отрывая грудь от упора.
Коротко задержитесь и подконтрольно выпрямите руки.
Повторите запланированное число раз, грудь на упоре всё время.
tips: Тяните локтями, а не кистями — ведут широчайшие и середина спины, бицепс помогает.
Грудь на упоре, плечи опущены; если поднимать плечи или отклоняться, работают верхние трапеции.
В начале каждого повтора давайте лопаткам разойтись вперёд для полного растяжения.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with thighs secured under the pads.
Grip the wide bar with an overhand grip.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat.
tips: Drive your elbows down and back rather than pulling with your hands.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum to move the weight.
Keep your chest lifted and shoulders down away from your ears.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока за голову
instructions: Сядьте в тренажёр верхнего блока, бёдра под валиками.
Возьмитесь за гриф широким хватом сверху — шире плеч.
Корпус вертикально, подбородок слегка подан вперёд.
Тяните гриф за голову, пока он не коснётся основания шеи.
Подконтрольно вернитесь до полного растяжения над головой.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Выполняйте только при полной безболезненной подвижности плеч над головой.
Берите умеренный вес — это не силовое, а вспомогательное упражнение на массу.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока обратным хватом
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a lat pulldown machine.
Grip the bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Sit and secure your thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats and biceps at the bottom.
Return the bar to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid leaning back excessively.
Pull with your elbows, not just your hands.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока одной рукой
instructions: Attach a single-handle to the cable pulldown station and sit with your thighs secured under the pad.
Reach up and grasp the handle with one hand, arm fully extended.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause briefly at full contraction, then return to the starting position with control.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.
tips: Lean slightly away from the cable to increase lat stretch at the top.
Focus on pulling with your elbow, not your hand, to keep the lat engaged.
Control the eccentric to maximize lat tension throughout the range.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока с V-рукоятью
instructions: Attach a V-bar (double-D handle) to a lat pulldown cable.
Sit with the thighs secured under the pad and grip the handle, palms facing each other.
Begin with the arms fully extended overhead.
Pull the handle down to the sternum by driving the elbows down and slightly back.
Squeeze the lats at the bottom, then return slowly under control.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: The neutral grip is easier on the shoulders than pronated or supinated grips.
Imagine pulling your ribs toward your hips — think lats, not arms.

exercises.name: Тяга верхнего блока узким хватом
instructions: Сядьте в тренажёр верхнего блока, бёдра под валиками.
Возьмитесь за узкую рукоять, ладони друг к другу.
Тяните рукоять к верху груди.
Сожмите широчайшие внизу.
Подконтрольно вернитесь и повторите.
tips: Отклоняйтесь назад лишь немного.
Не тяните рукоять рывком.
Ведите локти вниз и назад, а не только кисти.

exercises.name: Тяга гантелей в наклоне
instructions: Встаньте, стопы на ширине таза, гантели в руках по бокам, ладони к себе.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных с ровной спиной примерно на 30–45° к горизонтали, гантели висят под плечами.
Напрягите корпус и тяните обе гантели вверх и слегка назад, проводя локти мимо рёбер.
Сожмите верх спины в верхней точке, локти прижаты.
Подконтрольно опустите гантели до полного выпрямления рук.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Угол корпуса не меняется — не раскачивайтесь, помогая гантелям.
Тяните к низу рёбер или животу, а не к груди: так нагружаются широчайшие.
Если поясница округляется, наклоняйтесь меньше и перестройтесь перед следующим подходом.

exercises.name: Тяга гантелей к лицу
instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended forward.
Bend your elbows and pull the dumbbells toward your face.
Flare your elbows out wide to shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back at the peak.
Lower the dumbbells back under control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Keep your upper arms roughly parallel to the floor.
Use a lighter weight to prioritize form over load.

exercises.name: Тяга гантелей к подбородку
instructions: Stand holding two dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Pull the dumbbells straight up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Raise until the dumbbells reach chin height and elbows are above the wrists.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Keep the dumbbells close to your body throughout.
Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Avoid pulling with a very narrow grip to reduce shoulder impingement risk.

exercises.name: Тяга гантелей лёжа на наклонной скамье
instructions: Лягте лицом вниз на наклонную скамью, гантели висят под вами.
Тяните гантели к бокам.
Сожмите вверху, затем опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Упор грудью снимает усталость спины.
Сосредоточьтесь на сведении лопаток.

exercises.name: Тяга гантелей лёжа на скамье
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your chest glued to the bench throughout the pull.
Drive your elbows up and back rather than curling the weight.
Let your shoulder blades protract fully at the bottom for full range.

exercises.name: Тяга гантели в планке
instructions: Start in a high plank with a hand on each of two dumbbells, shoulder-width apart, and the feet set wide for stability.
Brace the trunk so the body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Row one dumbbell up toward the hip, driving the elbow back along the ribs.
Keep the hips square to the floor and do not let the body twist.
Lower the dumbbell to the floor under control.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.
tips: Use hexagonal dumbbells so they do not roll, and start light.
Set the feet wider to make it easier to keep the hips level.
Do not shrug or twist; pause briefly at the top of each row to prove control.

exercises.name: Тяга гантели одной рукой в наклоне
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with arm extended.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower the dumbbell with control.
Repeat on both sides.
tips: Avoid rotating the torso to hoist the weight higher.
Let your arm extend fully at the bottom for a complete stretch.
Keep your back flat from head to hips throughout the set.

exercises.name: Тяга гантели одной рукой с упором грудью
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging straight down.
Row the dumbbell up to your side, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top, then lower under control.
Complete all reps on one side before switching arms.
tips: Working one side at a time lets you focus on a full contraction without the other arm compensating.
Keep your chest pressed into the bench throughout to avoid using momentum.
Match the rep count on both sides to avoid imbalances.

exercises.name: Тяга гантели с опорой на носок
instructions: Встаньте прямо и отставьте одну ногу назад, касаясь пола только пальцами.
Держите гантель в одной руке на уровне таза.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, опуская гантель к середине голени, спина ровная.
Основной вес на передней ноге всё время.
Вернитесь в стойку, упираясь передней пяткой. Сделайте все повторы, затем смените сторону.
tips: При опускании гантель близко к голени.
Остановитесь, когда почувствуете растяжение задней поверхности передней ноги.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.

exercises.name: Тяга гири одной рукой в наклоне
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a bench for support.
Hold a kettlebell in the opposite hand with your arm extended.
Pull the kettlebell toward your hip by driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your back at the top of the movement.
Lower the kettlebell with control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your torso square to the floor throughout the set.
Pull with your back muscles rather than just your arm.
Keep your neck neutral, eyes on the floor just ahead.

exercises.name: Тяга гири с опорой на носок
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot back so only the toes touch the floor.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand at hip height.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell toward mid-shin while keeping the back flat.
Keep most of your weight on the front foot throughout.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing. Switch sides after all reps.
tips: Keep the kettlebell close to the shin on the descent.
Stop at the point of hamstring stretch in the front leg.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Тяга гирь лёжа на наклонной скамье
instructions: Лягте лицом вниз на наклонную скамью, руки с гирями свободно свисают.
Напрягите корпус и сведите лопатки.
Тяните гири к тазу, сводя лопатки.
Коротко задержитесь вверху, чувствуя сокращение спины.
Медленно и подконтрольно опустите гири.
tips: Корпус неподвижен, не раскачивайтесь.
Начинайте тягу мышцами спины, а не только руками.
Локти близко к телу — так сильнее работают широчайшие.

exercises.name: Тяга двух гантелей с опорой на носок
instructions: Встаньте прямо и отставьте одну ногу назад, касаясь пола только пальцами.
Держите гантели в обеих руках на уровне таза.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, опуская обе гантели к середине голени, спина ровная.
Основной вес на передней ноге всё время.
Вернитесь в стойку, упираясь передней пяткой. После всех повторов смените сторону.
tips: Гантели близко к ногам всё движение.
Остановитесь, когда почувствуете растяжение задней поверхности передней ноги.
Сделайте все повторы на одну сторону, затем смените.

exercises.name: Тяга двух гирь в наклоне
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips.
Let your arms hang straight down from your shoulders.
Row both kettlebells to your hips by driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.
tips: Hold your hinge angle steady; avoid standing up as you pull.
Keep your neck neutral by gazing at the floor ahead.
Brace your core to protect your lower back throughout.

exercises.name: Тяга двух гирь в наклоне на заднюю дельту
instructions: Stand a kettlebell just outside each foot with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, letting your knees bend slightly.
Take both handles with an overhand grip and let your arms hang straight down from your shoulders.
Row both bells up by driving your elbows out to the sides, away from your ribs rather than back along them.
Stop when your upper arms are roughly in line with your shoulders, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bells under control until your arms hang straight again, and repeat for the desired reps.
tips: The wide elbow is the whole exercise. Let it drift in against your ribs and you are doing an ordinary double kettlebell row, training your lats instead of your rear delts.
Use less weight than you would for a normal row. The flared elbow is a long lever and the rear delts are a far smaller engine than the lats.
Hold the hinge angle steady. Standing up as you pull hands the work to the traps and lower back and shortens the range where the rear delts actually work.

exercises.name: Тяга к лицу на кольцах
instructions: Grip the rings and lean back so your body is at an angle.
Pull the rings toward your face, flaring elbows to the sides.
Hold briefly, then return.
Repeat.
tips: Adjust your body angle to control difficulty.
Externally rotate your arms at the top.

exercises.name: Тяга к подбородку в Смите
instructions: Set the bar at hip height, take an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder-width and stand close to it with your arms straight.
Unrack the bar and stand tall with your shoulders back and your core braced.
Pull the bar straight up the front of your body, leading with your elbows and keeping the bar close.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest and your elbows are level with your shoulders, then pause briefly.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are straight again, and repeat for the desired reps.
tips: Stop at chest height. Pulling the bar to the collarbone rotates the shoulder into the position that causes the impingement this exercise is known for.
Lead with the elbows, not the hands. If the wrists come up first the biceps take over and the side deltoids barely work.
Widen the grip if the movement pinches. A narrow grip forces more internal rotation, and the fixed bar path gives you nowhere else to go.

exercises.name: Тяга каната к лицу
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends.
Squeeze your rear deltoids and external rotators.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows high, roughly in line with your shoulders.
Choose a light weight and prioritize control over load.
Avoid leaning back or shrugging your shoulders as you pull.

exercises.name: Тяга на кольцах
instructions: Set the rings at hip to chest height.
Grip the rings with palms facing each other, lean back at an angle with arms straight.
Brace the core and pull the chest toward the rings.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower under control to a full-arm extension.
tips: The lower the body angle, the harder the row.
Keep the body in a straight line — do not let the hips sag.
Pull the elbows back, not flared out, for more lat involvement.

exercises.name: Тяга нижнего блока в наклоне
instructions: Закрепите прямую или V-рукоять на нижнем блоке.
Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, колени слегка согнуты.
Тяните рукоять к низу груди.
Сведите лопатки вверху.
Подконтрольно вернитесь и повторите.
tips: Держите наклон, не выпрямляйтесь во время тяги.
Спина ровная от головы до таза всё время.
Сопротивляйтесь тяге троса на пути к полному растяжению.

exercises.name: Тяга нижнего блока к подбородку
instructions: Встаньте перед блочным тренажёром и возьмите прямую рукоять или канат на уровне бёдер.
Тяните рукоять к подбородку, ведя движение локтями.
Подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Локти выше запястий.
Не поднимайте плечи чрезмерно.

exercises.name: Тяга нижнего блока одной рукой сидя
instructions: Sit at the cable row station and hold one handle with the working arm extended.
Plant the feet, sit tall and brace the trunk without leaning back.
Pull the handle towards the lower ribs while drawing the shoulder blade back.
Pause briefly without rotating the torso or shrugging the shoulder.
Extend the arm under control, finish the set and repeat on the other side.
tips: Keep both shoulders facing forward throughout the repetition.
Drive the elbow back close to the body rather than curling the handle.
Let the shoulder blade reach forward at the start without rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Тяга нижнего блока сидя
instructions: Sit at the cable row station and place your feet on the footrests.
Grip the handle and sit upright with a slight forward lean.
Drive your elbows back and pull the handle toward your lower abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
Extend your arms under control back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your torso upright with minimal rocking.
Drive your elbows straight back, not out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.

exercises.name: Тяга нижнего блока сидя широким хватом
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with feet on the platform.
Grip a wide bar with an overhand grip.
Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid rocking back and forth.
Drive your elbows high and wide to target the upper back.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the set.

exercises.name: Тяга Пендлея
instructions: Load a barbell and set it on the floor.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is parallel to the ground, knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip.
Explosively pull the bar to your lower chest.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and pause before the next rep.
Repeat.
tips: Dead-stop each rep on the floor — no touch-and-go.
Keep your torso locked at roughly 90 degrees; do not use body english.
Drive the elbows up and back, not out to the sides.

exercises.name: Тяга с плинтов
instructions: Set the safety pins in a power rack at knee height and place a loaded barbell on them.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core, retract your shoulder blades, and drive through your legs to lift the bar.
Lock out your hips and knees fully at the top.
Return the bar to the pins under control and reset before the next rep.
tips: Use a hip-hinge pattern — keep the bar close to your body throughout.
Rack pulls allow loads well above your full deadlift max to overload the lockout.
Focus on upper back tightness to prevent rounding at heavy weights.

exercises.name: Тяга саней
instructions: Load a sled and grip its uprights with both hands, one to each post.
Stand facing the sled with the arms extended and the torso leaned back slightly against the load.
Pull the sled toward you by driving the elbows back, and take a short step backwards as you do.
Extend the arms again, step back once more, and repeat the pull.
Continue for distance or time, keeping a steady pull-and-step rhythm.
tips: Keep the chest up and the back flat — let the legs carry you backwards rather than rounding over the sled.
Use a load you can move continuously; the point is a steady drag, not a maximal pull.
Handles or a rope attached to the sled work the same way if your gym has them.

exercises.name: Тяга Т-грифа
instructions: Straddle the loaded T-bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is around 45 degrees.
Grip the handles and keep your back flat.
Pull the bar up toward your chest by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower the bar under control and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips fixed and avoid heaving the torso upright.
Maintain a soft bend in your knees to protect the lower back.
Let the weight stretch your lats fully at the bottom.

exercises.name: Тяга штанги в наклоне
instructions: Наклонитесь в тазобедренных, колени слегка согнуты.
Возьмите гриф чуть шире плеч.
Тяните штангу к низу груди, сводя лопатки.
Подконтрольно опустите штангу.
Повторите.
tips: Корпус примерно под 45°.
Не раскачивайте вес инерцией.

exercises.name: Тяга штанги в наклоне на заднюю дельту
instructions: Наклонитесь в тазобедренных с ровной спиной, корпус почти параллелен полу.
Держите штангу хватом сверху шире плеч, руки висят.
Тяните штангу к верху груди, разводя локти в стороны.
Задержитесь, сжимая задние дельты и верх спины.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Тяните локтями, а не кистями — ведите их вверх и в стороны.
Берите вес легче, чем в обычной тяге: широкий хват уменьшает рычаг.

exercises.name: Тяга штанги в наклоне обратным хватом
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip a barbell underhand.
Hinge forward at the hips with a slight knee bend.
Let the bar hang with your arms extended.
Pull the bar to your lower abdomen by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your back flat and your core braced throughout.
Maintain a fixed torso angle instead of heaving upright as you pull.
Keep the bar close to your legs throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Тяга штанги к подбородку
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull the bar straight up along your body toward your chin.
Lead with your elbows, keeping them above your hands.
Lower the bar with control.
Repeat.
tips: Use a lighter weight if you feel pinching in your shoulders.
Avoid bending your wrists excessively as the bar rises.
Avoid swinging or using your legs to heave the weight up.

exercises.name: Тяга штанги лёжа на скамье
instructions: Лягте лицом вниз на высокую скамью, руки свисают вниз.
Возьмите штангу или гантели под собой.
Тяните вес вверх к нижней стороне скамьи.
Сведите лопатки вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Грудь прижата к скамье — без читинга.
Перед каждым повтором полностью растягивайтесь внизу.
Ведите локти вверх и назад, а не сгибайте руки.

exercises.name: Тяга EZ-грифа в наклоне
instructions: Держите EZ-гриф хватом сверху, наклонитесь в тазобедренных до 45°.
Тяните гриф к низу грудной клетки.
Подконтрольно опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Спина ровная всё время.
Начинайте движение локтями, а не кистями.

exercises.name: Тяга EZ-грифа к подбородку
instructions: Stand holding an EZ-bar with a shoulder-width grip on the angled portions.
Pull the bar straight up along your body toward your chin.
Lead with your elbows, keeping them above your hands.
Lower with control.
Repeat.
tips: Pull only as high as your shoulders allow without pinching.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the movement.
Avoid swinging or using your legs to lift the weight.

exercises.name: Тяга EZ-грифа обратным хватом
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Hinge at your hips, keeping a slight bend in your knees and your back straight, until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let the bar hang directly below your shoulders with arms fully extended.
Pull the bar towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows up.
Control the eccentric phase, slowly lowering the bar back to the starting position with full arm extension.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement to protect your lower back.
Focus on initiating the pull with your lats, not just your biceps.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders; keep them depressed and retracted.
Use a full range of motion, extending your arms completely at the bottom.

exercises.name: Уголок в висе
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and the shoulders pulled down.
Brace the abdominals and lift the straight legs until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep the knees locked and the toes pointed, with the legs together.
Hold the position without swinging, breathing steadily.
Lower the legs under control to a dead hang.
tips: If the legs drop below parallel, bend the knees (a tuck hold) and build up from there.
Keep the shoulders active; do not hang passively from the joints.
Squeeze the legs together and point the toes to keep the line tight.

exercises.name: Уголок на брусьях
instructions: Sit on the floor or press up on parallel bars with arms straight.
Lock your elbows and depress your shoulders.
Lift your legs straight out in front of you parallel to the floor.
Form an L shape with your body.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration.
Lower your legs with control to exit.
tips: Bend your knees into a tuck position if the full hold is too hard.
Point your toes and squeeze your quads to keep legs straight.
Breathe steadily during the hold rather than holding your breath.

exercises.name: Уголок на кольцах
instructions: Set the rings at about hip height and grip them with the arms straight beside the body.
Press down on the rings and lift the body into the support position, with the shoulders pushed down and away from the ears.
Turn the rings out slightly, brace the abdominals and raise the straight legs until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold the position, keeping the rings steady and the knees locked.
Lower the legs, then the body, under control.
tips: Keep the arms locked and the shoulders pushed down; do not sag between the rings.
Build up from tucked holds, and from parallettes or a dip station, before moving to rings.
Point the toes and squeeze the legs together.

exercises.name: Удары канатами двумя руками
instructions: Возьмите по концу каната в каждую руку лицом к креплению; отойдите так, чтобы канаты слегка провисали.
Стопы чуть шире таза, присядьте в четверть приседа, грудь поднята.
Одновременно взмахните обеими руками вверх, канаты поднимаются перед вами, таз разгибается.
Обрушьте оба конца в пол одновременно, сгибаясь в тазобедренных и включая широчайшие.
С отскока сразу переходите в следующий удар; руки двигаются синхронно, не поочерёдно.
Продолжайте заданное время или число повторов.
tips: Обе руки работают вместе — если начали чередовать, это уже обычные волны, другое упражнение.
Бейте за счёт таза и широчайших, а не рук, иначе плечи устанут раньше дыхания.
Стойте на правильном расстоянии: слишком близко — канат провисает, слишком далеко — волна не проходит.

exercises.name: Удержание «лодочки» на скамье
instructions: Лягте на спину на горизонтальную скамью: ягодицы и поясница на скамье, ноги вытянуты.
Вытяните руки за голову вдоль ушей.
Напрягите пресс и прижмите поясницу к скамье.
Приподнимите плечи и прямые ноги на несколько сантиметров — неглубокая «лодочка».
Удерживайте, дыша ровно, затем опуститесь и отдохните.
tips: Если поясница отрывается от скамьи, поднимите ноги выше или слегка согните колени.
Рёбра опущены, шея расслаблена.
Держите только пока поясница прижата.

exercises.name: Удержание «лодочки» на спине
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press the lower back firmly into the floor.
Lift the shoulders, head, and legs slightly off the floor.
Hold the position with arms and legs extended, body in a shallow banana shape.
Hold for the prescribed time.
tips: Keep the lower back glued to the floor — if it lifts, raise the legs higher.
Tuck the chin slightly to engage the upper abs.
Bend the knees to scale if the position breaks.

exercises.name: Удержание «мёртвого жука»
instructions: Лягте на спину, руки к потолку, таз и колени согнуты под 90°.
Прижмите поясницу к полу и держите так весь подход.
Вытяните одну руку за голову и выпрямите противоположную ногу, чтобы обе зависли чуть над полом.
Удерживайте вытянутое положение заданное время, рёбра не выпирают, спина не прогибается.
Вернитесь и повторите другими рукой и ногой.
tips: Если поясница отрывается, держите ногу выше, не тянитесь к полу.
Медленно выдыхайте во время удержания; задержка дыхания обычно и ломает напряжение.
Вытянутая рука у уха, а не в сторону.

exercises.name: Удержание «птица-собака»
instructions: Встаньте на четвереньки: кисти под плечами, колени под тазом.
Вытяните одну руку вперёд, а противоположную ногу назад.
Корпус напряжён, тело ровное.
Удерживайте положение, не поворачивая корпус.
Держите заданное время. Сделайте на одну сторону, затем смените.
tips: Тянитесь кончиками пальцев и пяткой в противоположные стороны.
Отталкивайте пол опорной рукой, чтобы стоять устойчиво.
Дышите ровно, не задерживайте дыхание.

exercises.name: Удержание «ракушки»
instructions: Лягте на бок: таз согнут примерно на 45°, колени на 90°, пятки вместе, колени друг на друге.
Плечи и таз строго один над другим, корпус напряжён, чтобы таз не заваливался назад.
Раскройте верхнее колено максимально без поворота таза, пятки касаются.
Удерживайте раскрытое положение заданное время, дыша обычно.
Подконтрольно опустите колено и повторите на другую сторону.
tips: Остановитесь там, где таз начинает заваливаться назад; амплитуда меньше, чем кажется.
Пятки прижаты друг к другу — движение в тазобедренном, а не в лодыжке.
Добавляйте мини-ленту выше колен, только когда таз абсолютно неподвижен.

exercises.name: Удержание блинов щипковым хватом
instructions: Stand two weight plates on their edges on the floor, pressed together with the smooth sides facing out.
Squat down and pinch both plates together between the fingers and thumb of one hand — no handles, just pinch.
Stand up and hold the plates at the side for time, keeping the arm straight.
Set them back down under control.
Repeat on the other hand.
tips: Start with two 5 kg / 10 lb plates and build up.
Chalk on the hands makes a huge difference; sweaty pinches fail fast.

exercises.name: Удержание глубокого приседа
instructions: Встаньте, стопы чуть шире плеч, носки наружу.
Сцепите кисти перед грудью и опустите таз между пятками.
Опускайтесь, пока таз не окажется ниже коленей, пятки на полу.
Грудь поднята, локтями давите на колени, разводя их.
Удерживайте, дыша ровно, затем встаньте.
tips: Пятки на полу; если отрываются, подложите под них небольшой блин или клин.
Колени разведены по линии носков, позвоночник вытянут.
Увеличивайте время постепенно, вставая между подходами.

exercises.name: Удержание коленей у груди в висе
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and the arms straight.
Brace the abdominals and pull the knees up toward the chest, rounding the lower back slightly.
Keep the knees together and the thighs at or above hip height.
Hold the tucked position without swinging and breathe steadily.
Lower the legs under control to a full hang.
tips: Curl the pelvis up rather than just lifting the knees; the abdominals should do the work.
Keep the shoulders pulled away from the ears.
End the set when the knees start to drop or the body starts to swing.

exercises.name: Удержание медвежьей планки
instructions: Встаньте на четвереньки: кисти под плечами, колени под тазом.
Упритесь носками и напрягите пресс, чтобы спина была ровной.
Надавите на ладони и приподнимите колени на пару сантиметров.
Удерживайте положение: таз ровно, голова на одной линии с позвоночником.
Дышите ровно, затем опустите колени и отдохните.
tips: Колени близко к полу; если поднять их выше, получится складка.
Разведите пальцы и отталкивайте пол, чтобы плечи не проваливались.
Шея вытянута, взгляд в пол чуть впереди кистей.

exercises.name: Удержание ног над полом
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs straight and the arms resting along your sides.
Press the lower back into the floor and brace the abdominals.
Lift the head, shoulders and straight legs about six inches off the floor.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Lower slowly to rest.
tips: Keep the lower back flat; if it arches, raise the legs a little higher or bend the knees.
Keep the neck relaxed and the chin slightly tucked.
Build up with short holds and rest in between.

exercises.name: Удержание отведённой назад ноги
instructions: Start on all fours with the hands under the shoulders and the knees under the hips.
Brace the trunk and keep the pelvis level; do not let the working side rotate upwards.
Extend one leg back and up until the thigh is in line with the torso.
Hold that position for the prescribed time, keeping the neck long and the lower back flat.
Lower the leg under control and repeat on the other side.
tips: Squeeze the glute rather than kicking higher; the height is limited by the pelvis staying square.
Keep the supporting shoulder pushed away from the ear so the upper body does not sag.
A bent knee keeps the tension on the glute, a straight leg shifts more of it to the hamstring.

exercises.name: Удержание отведённой ноги лёжа на боку
instructions: Lie on one side with the legs stacked and straight, and support the head on the lower arm.
Brace the trunk so the torso stays square and does not roll backwards.
Lift the top leg to about 30 to 45 degrees, keeping the toes pointing forward.
Hold the leg there for the prescribed time, breathing normally.
Lower the leg under control and repeat on the other side.
tips: Turning the toes towards the ceiling shifts the work to the hip flexor; keep them facing forward.
Take the leg slightly behind the line of the body to bias the glute medius.
Rest the top hand on the floor in front of you if balance is the limiting factor.

exercises.name: Удержание подбородка втянутым
instructions: Стойте или сидите прямо, плечи расслаблены.
Втяните подбородок строго назад, как будто делаете второй подбородок.
Голова ровно, без наклона.
Удерживайте нужное время.
Расслабьтесь и повторите несколько подходов.
tips: Представьте, что сдвигаете голову назад над позвоночником, а не киваете.
Взгляд ровно, дыхание спокойное.

exercises.name: Удержание позы «стол»
instructions: Sit with the knees bent, the feet flat and the hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing towards the heels.
Press into the hands and feet and lift the hips until the trunk is level with the knees.
Open the chest, draw the shoulders away from the ears and look straight ahead.
Hold the position for the prescribed time with the hips high.
Lower the hips under control to finish.
tips: Push the floor away rather than hanging on the shoulders.
Keep the knees stacked over the ankles and pointing straight ahead.
Let the head follow the line of the spine instead of dropping it back.

exercises.name: Удержание приведённой ноги лёжа на боку
instructions: Lie on one side with the bottom leg straight and the top leg crossed over it, foot flat on the floor.
Support the head on the lower arm and keep the hips stacked vertically.
Lift the bottom leg as high as it will go with the knee straight and the toes pointing forward.
Hold that lifted position for the prescribed time without rolling the hips back.
Lower the leg under control and repeat on the other side.
tips: The range is short; a few centimetres of lift with a still pelvis beats a big swing.
Keep the lifted leg in line with the torso rather than drifting forward.
Press the top foot lightly into the floor if you need to steady the position.

exercises.name: Удержание приседа
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart and the toes turned slightly out.
Reach the arms straight forward to counterbalance.
Squat down until the thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping the chest up and the heels down.
Hold the position, keeping the knees in line with the toes.
Stand up to finish.
tips: Keep the weight through the middle of the feet and the heels on the floor.
Do not let the knees cave in or the back round.
Build the hold time gradually and rest when the thighs begin to shake.

exercises.name: Удержание румынской тяги на одной ноге
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and the arms hanging in front of you.
Hinge at the hip, sending the free leg straight back as the torso tips forward.
Keep the back flat and the hips square to the floor.
Stop when the torso and the free leg are roughly parallel to the floor and hold the position.
Return to standing under control, then switch legs.
tips: Think of a seesaw: the torso and the free leg move together.
Keep the hips level; do not let the free hip rotate upward.
Fix your gaze on a point on the floor ahead to help your balance.

exercises.name: Удержание ягодичного моста
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet flat, about hip-width apart and close enough to brush your fingertips with your heels.
Push through the heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from the knees to the shoulders.
Squeeze the glutes and tuck the ribs down so the lower back does not take over.
Hold the top position for the prescribed time, keeping the weight in the heels.
Lower the hips under control to finish the set.
tips: Push the knees slightly outwards during the hold to keep the glutes engaged.
Stop lifting once the knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line; going higher usually means arching the back.
For extra load, rest a dumbbell or a plate across the hips before the lift.

exercises.name: Удержание ягодичного моста на одной ноге
