instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat, and lift the other leg so the thigh is roughly vertical.
Push through the heel of the planted foot and lift the hips until the body is straight from the knee to the shoulders.
Level the pelvis so the lifted side does not drop, and tuck the ribs down.
Hold the top position for the prescribed time, keeping the lifted knee still.
Lower the hips under control and repeat on the other side.
tips: Watch the pelvis rather than the height: a level hip at a lower position beats a high, twisted one.
Keep the planted heel close to the glute so the hamstring does not cramp.
Extend the free leg straight if the position feels easy, but only while the pelvis stays level.

exercises.name: Удержание V-сида
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the floor.
Reach your arms forward so your body forms a V shape.
Balance on your sit bones with core tight.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Lower your legs and torso to exit.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and spine long rather than rounding the back.
Bend the knees if you cannot hold straight legs yet.

exercises.name: Флаг дракона
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it firmly behind your head.
Raise your body up so only your upper back stays on the bench.
Keep your body rigid in a straight line.
Lower your body under control until nearly horizontal.
Raise back up and repeat.
tips: Keep your body rigid from shoulders to toes and move only at the shoulders.
Lower as slowly as you can — the eccentric is the exercise.
Start with tucked or single-leg progressions before the full flag.

exercises.name: Флажок
instructions: Stand close to a sturdy vertical pole.
Grip the pole high with the top hand (overhand) and lower with the bottom hand (underhand).
Kick the legs up and out while pressing the bottom arm hard against the pole.
Extend the body horizontally so it forms a straight line parallel to the ground.
Hold the position with the body rigid for the target time.
Lower under control.
tips: Build up to the full flag with tucked and straddle progressions first.
The bottom arm pushes; the top arm pulls — they balance the lever.
Engage the lats, obliques, and glutes hard to stay rigid.

exercises.name: Французский жим лёжа со штангой
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest with a narrow grip.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending at the elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat.
tips: Keep upper arms vertical throughout.
Lower slowly to protect the elbows.

exercises.name: Французский жим с гантелями лёжа
instructions: Лягте на горизонтальную скамью, гантели над грудью.
Опустите гантели к бокам головы.
Выпрямите руки обратно.
Повторите.
tips: Локти смотрят в потолок.
Держите подконтрольный темп.

exercises.name: Французский жим с гантелями лёжа
instructions: Lie flat on a bench and hold one dumbbell in both hands straight above your chest.
Keep your upper arms close to vertical, elbows pointing up toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back to the starting position.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing up and tucked in rather than flaring out to the sides.
Move only at the elbows, not the shoulders.
Lower the weight under control rather than dropping it.

exercises.name: Французский жим с гирей лёжа
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands, arms extended above the chest.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bell toward the forehead in a controlled arc.
Keep the upper arms vertical; only the forearms move.
Extend the elbows to press the bell back up.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Grip the horns firmly — the bell tries to rotate forward at the bottom.
Elbows stay narrow — if they flare, the load is too heavy.
Angle the upper arms slightly back toward the head to keep tension on the triceps at lockout.

exercises.name: Французский жим с EZ-грифом из-за головы
instructions: Stand or sit holding an EZ-bar overhead with an overhand grip on the inner bends.
Arms fully extended, bar above the head.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bar behind the head in an arc.
Keep the upper arms vertical and close to the head; only the forearms move.
Extend the elbows to return the bar overhead.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: If the elbows flare out, drop the load — flared elbows mean shoulders are assisting.
The deeper the stretch at the bottom, the better the long-head hypertrophy stimulus.
A seated version is easier on the lower back.

exercises.name: Французский жим с EZ-грифом лёжа
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with a narrow grip.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending at the elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arms vertical throughout so the triceps do the work.
The EZ bar's angled grip is easier on the wrists than a straight bar.
Lower slowly to protect the elbows.

exercises.name: Французский жим штанги стоя
instructions: Возьмите штангу подходящего веса, встаньте или сядьте с нейтральной спиной.
Возьмитесь хватом сверху на ширине плеч и выжмите штангу над головой.
Медленно опускайте штангу за голову, сгибая локти; плечи неподвижны.
Разогните локти, возвращая штангу над головой, и сожмите трицепсы.
Двигайтесь подконтрольно, без инерции.
tips: Локти не разводите, они смотрят вперёд — так трицепс работает сильнее, а плечи защищены.
Контролируйте опускание: это усиливает напряжение мышц.
Не прогибайте сильно поясницу; напрягите корпус для устойчивости.

exercises.name: Фронтальные приседания
instructions: Clean or rack the bar to your front deltoids with elbows high.
Squat down keeping torso upright until thighs are parallel.
Drive back up.
Repeat.
tips: Maintain high elbows to keep the bar stable.
A more upright torso increases quad activation.

exercises.name: Фронтальные приседания в Смите
instructions: Set the bar at upper-chest height and step under it so it rests across the front of your shoulders, against your collarbones.
Cross your arms over the bar or take an open front-rack grip, and drive your elbows up until your upper arms are close to parallel with the floor.
Unrack the bar and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and slightly forward of it.
Sit straight down, keeping your elbows high and your torso upright, until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through the middle of your feet to stand back up, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: High elbows are the whole exercise. As soon as they drop, the bar rolls off your shoulders onto your hands and the rack position collapses.
Set the safety stops just below your deepest squat position before you unrack anything -- on a front squat the fastest way out of a failed rep is to let the bar go.
Standing slightly ahead of the bar lets you keep your torso vertical. Under a fixed path, a stance directly beneath the bar forces you to lean and pushes the bar off the front rack.

exercises.name: Фронтальные приседания с гантелями
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and torso upright.
Lower your hips by bending knees until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your elbows high so the dumbbells stay racked on your shoulders.
Sit down between your hips rather than folding forward.
Drive through the whole foot and keep your heels down.

exercises.name: Фронтальный присед с гирей в одной руке
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the racked position at one shoulder.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips.
Keep your chest up and torso upright throughout.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep the rack position tight against your chest and forearm.
Resist twisting or leaning toward the loaded side.
Spread the floor with your feet to keep your knees tracking outward.

exercises.name: Ходьба
instructions: Stand tall with your weight over the middle of your feet and your shoulders relaxed, not pulled back.
Step forward and land on your heel, then roll through the foot and push off the ball and toes.
Keep at least one foot on the ground at all times — as soon as both leave the floor you are running, not walking.
Let your arms swing naturally from the shoulder, opposite arm to opposite leg, with the elbows softly bent.
Look ahead rather than down at your feet, and breathe through a steady, repeatable rhythm.
Continue for the desired time or distance, picking a pace at which you could still hold a conversation.
tips: Pace is the whole variable here. A stroll and a brisk walk are different training stimuli, so pick one deliberately instead of drifting.
Lengthen the push behind you rather than reaching further in front — overstriding lands you on a straight leg and brakes every step.
This is the one piece of conditioning you can do daily without needing to recover from it, which is what makes it worth programming rather than leaving to chance.

exercises.name: Ходьба на беговой дорожке в гору
instructions: Start the belt at a slow walking speed and step on, then raise the incline to your target gradient.
Walk with a long, deliberate stride, rolling from heel to toe and pushing the belt away behind you with each step.
Stand tall and lean from the ankles with the hill rather than folding forward at the waist.
Keep at least one foot on the belt at all times — walk the hill, do not break into a jog.
Let your arms swing naturally, or rest them lightly on the rails for balance without carrying your weight on them.
Hold the gradient for the desired time, then lower the incline and walk level for a few minutes to finish.
tips: Pick a speed you can still walk at. As soon as you need a flight phase to keep up, drop the speed or the incline — it is a walk, not a run.
Hanging your bodyweight off the handrails removes most of the work the hill is there to create; touch them for balance only.
The steep grade is what moves the effort from the quads into the glutes and hamstrings, so raise the incline before you raise the speed.

exercises.name: Ходьба с пятки на носок
instructions: Pick a straight line on the floor and stand on it with your arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Step forward and place your heel directly in front of — and touching — the toes of the standing foot.
Shift your weight onto the front foot under control, pausing for a moment before the next step.
Bring the back foot through and place it heel to toe again, staying on the line rather than stepping around it.
Look ahead at a fixed point instead of down at your feet, and use your arms to correct any wobble.
Walk the desired number of steps, then turn around and walk back.
tips: Go slowly. Rushing turns it into ordinary walking on a narrow line and removes the balance demand entirely.
If you cannot hold the line, walk beside a wall and touch it only when you need it — that is a regression, not a failure.
Make it harder by folding your arms across your chest, and harder again by doing it with your eyes closed near a wall.

exercises.name: Читинговый подъём штанги на бицепс
instructions: Встаньте, держа вес у бёдер хватом снизу.
Начните подъём с небольшого толчка тазом.
Мощно поднимите вес к плечам.
Медленно и подконтрольно опустите по всей амплитуде.
Повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Толчок тазом небольшой, основную работу делает бицепс.
Не отклоняйтесь сильно назад, берегите поясницу.
Локти близко к корпусу весь подъём.

exercises.name: Шавасана
instructions: Lie on your back with the legs a comfortable distance apart and the feet falling open.
Rest the arms slightly away from the body with the palms facing up.
Let the whole body soften into the floor, including the jaw, the eyes and the hands.
Stay for the prescribed time, breathing naturally without controlling the breath.
Bend the knees and roll to one side before sitting up slowly.
tips: Place a bolster under the knees if the lower back does not settle.
Cover yourself with a blanket; the body cools quickly once it stops moving.
This pose is meant to require no effort at all — resist the urge to adjust constantly.

exercises.name: Шаги в сторону с мини-лентой
instructions: Наденьте мини-ленту на ноги выше колен (или на лодыжки — так тяжелее).
Встаньте в четверть приседа: стопы на ширине плеч, таз назад, грудь поднята, колени над носками.
Шагните одной ногой в сторону против натяжения ленты.
Приставьте другую ногу, не теряя натяжения — стопы не схлопываются.
Продолжайте шагать в одну сторону заданное число шагов или дистанцию, затем в другую.
Оставайтесь внизу — не выпрямляйтесь между шагами.
tips: Носки смотрят вперёд — ведущая стопа не разворачивается наружу.
Таз ровный, не раскачивайтесь из стороны в сторону.
Если колени заваливаются внутрь, лента слишком тугая — возьмите полегче.

exercises.name: Шаги сумо с мини-лентой
instructions: Наденьте мини-ленту на голени чуть выше лодыжек.
Опуститесь в четверть приседа, стопы шире плеч.
Шагайте в сторону широкой постановкой, держа ленту натянутой.
Приставляйте вторую ногу лишь частично, чтобы лента оставалась натянутой; пройдите заданную дистанцию, затем ведите другой ногой.
Оставайтесь внизу — не выпрямляйтесь между шагами.
tips: Лента натянута весь подход.
Держите четверть приседа — не выпрямляйтесь между шагами.
Делайте небольшие подконтрольные шаги, носки слегка наружу.

exercises.name: Швунг гантели одной рукой
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at one shoulder, palm facing inward (neutral).
Feet shoulder-width, core braced, free arm out to the side for balance.
Dip by bending the knees slightly, keeping the torso vertical.
Explosively extend the legs and press the dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lock out overhead, then lower back to the shoulder under control.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Drive from the legs — the arm finishes, it does not start.
The torso must stay upright and square; do not side-bend away from the load.
Lighter weight and cleaner leg drive beat heavy with a leaning torso.

exercises.name: Швунг гири одной рукой
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the racked position at one shoulder.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly.
Drive explosively through your legs and press the kettlebell overhead.
Lock out your arm at the top.
Lower the kettlebell to your shoulder with control.
Complete reps on one side, then switch.
tips: Keep your torso upright during the dip, not tipping forward.
Time the press so your arm extends as your legs finish driving.
Keep the dip shallow and quick rather than a half squat.

exercises.name: Швунг двух гирь
instructions: Stand with two kettlebells racked at the shoulders, elbows down and tucked.
Feet shoulder-width, core braced.
Dip the knees slightly while keeping the torso vertical.
Explosively extend the legs and press both bells overhead in one motion.
Lock out with the bells over the mid-foot.
Lower back to the rack under control.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: Only ONE dip — if you re-bend the knees under the bell, that is a jerk.
Drive from the legs, the arms finish.
The torso stays vertical throughout; no lean.

exercises.name: Швунг жимовой
instructions: Stand with a barbell racked on your front deltoids.
Dip slightly at the knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out fully.
Lower to the start.
Repeat.
tips: Use leg drive only to initiate — finish with the shoulders.
Keep the core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Швунг с гантелями
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Slightly bend your knees into a quarter squat.
Drive through your legs to generate momentum, then press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control.
tips: Use a shallow dip — this is not a full squat.
Drive the heels into the floor to initiate the press.
Keep your core braced to protect the lower back.

exercises.name: Шраги в рычажном тренажёре
instructions: Load the plate horns evenly and stand on the machine platform, facing away from the frame.
Take a handle in each hand with your arms hanging straight down at your sides and your shoulders relaxed.
Stand tall with your chest up, your chin level and your knees soft.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as they will go, and hold for a moment at the top.
Lower under control until your shoulders are fully down, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Shrug straight up. Rolling the shoulders adds travel but no extra trap work, and it takes the shoulder joint through a loaded circle for nothing.
Keep the arms straight and passive. Bending the elbows turns the movement into a short upright row and takes the load off the traps.
The handles hanging at your sides are what this machine is for -- there is no bar to clear your thighs, so you can stand upright and use a full range without shortening the top.

exercises.name: Шраги в Смите
instructions: Stand upright inside a Smith machine with the bar at thigh height.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip.
Unrack the bar and let it hang in front of your thighs.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold the top for a moment, then lower slowly.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
tips: Keep your arms straight so the traps, not the biceps, do the work.
Lift straight up and down rather than rolling the shoulders.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid jutting the chin forward.

exercises.name: Шраги с гантелями
instructions: Встаньте с гантелями в опущенных руках.
Поднимите плечи строго вверх как можно выше.
Коротко задержитесь и опустите.
Повторите.
tips: Не вращайте плечами.
Сосредоточьтесь на сжатии трапеций вверху.

exercises.name: Шраги с гантелями лёжа на наклонной скамье
instructions: Установите наклонную скамью примерно на 30°.
Лягте на скамью лицом вниз, гантели на вытянутых руках.
Поднимайте плечи вверх и назад к ушам.
Сожмите верхние трапеции вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Поднимайте плечи вверх и назад, а не строго вверх.
Грудь прижата к скамье — без помощи корпусом.
Задержитесь и сожмите вверху, затем подконтрольно опустите.

exercises.name: Шраги с гирями
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand with palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders relaxed.
Elevate your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold the contraction briefly.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on moving only your shoulders, keeping your arms straight throughout the movement.
Avoid rolling your shoulders; move them straight up and down.
Maintain a neutral spine and engaged core to prevent lower back strain.
Use a weight that allows for full range of motion and controlled execution.

exercises.name: Шраги с EZ-грифом
instructions: Stand holding an EZ-bar in front of you.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Hold at the top, then lower.
Repeat.
tips: Avoid rolling the shoulders in circles.
Use a full range of motion.

exercises.name: Шраги со штангой
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at arm's length with an overhand grip.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower your shoulders back down with control.
Repeat.
tips: Avoid rolling the shoulders forward or backward at the top.
Keep your arms relaxed and let the traps do the work.
Keep your neck neutral instead of jutting the chin forward.

exercises.name: Шраги со штангой за спиной
instructions: Встаньте, держа штангу за спиной хватом сверху.
Руки прямые, грудь поднята.
Поднимите плечи строго вверх к ушам.
Задержитесь и сожмите трапеции вверху.
Подконтрольно опустите и повторите.
tips: Поднимайте и опускайте строго вертикально, без вращения плечами.
Не сгибайте локти, чтобы подбросить вес выше.
Стойте прямо, шея нейтральна, взгляд вперёд.

exercises.name: Эллиптический тренажёр
instructions: Step onto the foot plates one at a time, holding the fixed centre post until you are steady, then take a moving handle in each hand.
Start the pedals turning forward, keeping your whole foot down on the plate rather than lifting your heel.
Push one handle away as the opposite foot travels forward, and pull the other back, so the arms and legs work in opposition.
Stand tall with your hips over the pedals and your core braced instead of hanging back on the handles.
Set the resistance and ramp so you can hold a smooth stride, and continue for the desired time or distance.
tips: Drive the handles rather than letting the legs push them for you — the arm work is most of what makes the elliptical a full-body machine.
Keep your heels down on the plates. Riding on the toes cramps the calves and cuts the glutes out of the stride.
Pedalling backwards for part of the session shifts the emphasis toward the hamstrings and glutes and breaks up a long steady effort.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Hold briefly at the top with hips fully extended.
Lower your hips back down with control.
Repeat.
tips: Push through your heels rather than your toes.
Avoid arching your lower back at the top.
Don't let your knees cave inward as you lift.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост в рычажном тренажёре
instructions: Load the plate horns evenly and sit into the machine with your upper back against the pad and your feet flat on the platform.
Pull the hip pad or lap bar across your hips and adjust it so it sits on the crease of the hips, not on your stomach.
Set your feet so that your shins will be roughly vertical when your hips are at the top, and take hold of the handles.
Drive your hips up by squeezing the glutes until your thighs are level with your torso, and hold briefly at the top.
Lower under control until your hips are just short of the bottom of the range, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Get the pad on the hip crease. Sitting it up on the stomach is the only genuinely uncomfortable thing this machine does, and it is fixed by moving the pad, not by adding padding.
Finish with the hips, not the lower back. If the ribs flare at the top you have run out of hip extension and started arching, which is where the machine stops training the glutes.
This is the hip thrust to reach for when the bench and barbell are taken -- the back pad and platform are part of the frame, so there is no setup to get wrong.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост в Смите
instructions: Set a flat bench inside the Smith machine, parallel to the bar and positioned so the bar will sit over your hip crease.
Set the bar low enough that you can get under it while seated on the floor, then sit with your upper back against the bench.
Roll the bar over your hips, pad it if you need to, and unhook it with your feet flat and about hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips until your thighs and torso form a straight line, squeezing the glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control until they are just off the floor, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Line the bench up before you load the bar. The bar can only move straight up and down, so if the bench is out of place the bar lands on your stomach or your thighs and there is no adjusting mid-set.
Set the safety stops where the bar sits at the bottom of your range. Getting out from under a loaded Smith bar on the floor is awkward, and the stops make it a non-event.
Look at a point in front of you rather than at the ceiling. Keeping the chin tucked stops the movement turning into a lower-back arch at lockout.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост на одной ноге
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, the other leg extended straight.
Brace the core and squeeze the glute on the working side.
Drive the hips up by pressing through the working heel.
Pause at the top with the body in a straight line from shoulders to knee.
Lower under control. Complete reps per side, then switch.
tips: Keep the extended leg in line with the working thigh.
Squeeze the glute hard at the top — do not push with the lower back.
Slow the lowering phase for more stimulus.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост с гантелью с упором спиной
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, feet flat, and a dumbbell across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels, lifting your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes powerfully at the top of the movement, ensuring full hip extension.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position with control, maintaining tension.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chin tucked towards your chest to maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase to enhance muscle growth.
Use a pad or towel under the dumbbell for comfort.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост с гирей с упором спиной
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat.
Place a kettlebell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Drive through your heels, lifting your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes forcefully at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position with control.
tips: Keep your chin tucked towards your chest to maintain a neutral spine.
Focus on pushing through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Ensure your knees track in line with your toes throughout the movement.
Control the eccentric phase, resisting the weight as you lower your hips.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост с мини-лентой
instructions: Лягте на спину, колени согнуты, стопы на полу на ширине плеч.
Наденьте мини-ленту на обе ноги чуть выше колен.
Прижмите поясницу к полу и напрягите корпус.
Упритесь пятками и, сжимая ягодицы, поднимите таз в мост — держите натяжение ленты, разводя колени.
Вверху тело — прямая линия от плеч до колен. Коротко задержитесь.
Подконтрольно опуститесь и повторите нужное число раз.
tips: Колени стремятся свестись внутрь — лента подсказывает: разводите их.
Останавливайтесь, когда таз на одной линии с плечами и коленями; не переразгибайте поясницу.
Сильно сжимайте ягодицы вверху — быстрый мост на поламплитуды кажется лёгким именно поэтому.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост с ногами на фитболе
instructions: Lie face-up on the floor and place both feet on top of a stability ball.
Arms rest at the sides on the floor for balance.
Squeeze the glutes and press the heels into the ball to raise the hips.
Finish with a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower the hips under control without the ball rolling away.
Repeat for the recommended number of repetitions.
tips: The ball will try to drift — keep the feet pressed straight down.
No hyperextension at the top; stop when the body is in a line.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост с упором спиной с мини-лентой
instructions: Наденьте мини-ленту чуть выше колен и сядьте на пол, упираясь верхом спины в скамью.
Согните колени, стопы на ширине таза; расположите ленту с натяжением.
Упритесь пятками, разогните таз и поднимите ягодицы, пока тело не станет прямой линией от плеч до колен.
Вверху сильно сожмите ягодицы, разводя колени против ленты.
Медленно и подконтрольно опустите таз.
tips: Держите ленту натянутой всё движение.
Сосредоточьтесь на сильном сокращении ягодиц в верхней точке.
Подбородок прижат, взгляд вперёд — позвоночник нейтральный.
Вверху голени должны быть вертикальны.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост со штангой
instructions: Лягте на пол, штанга на тазу, колени согнуты.
Поднимите таз, сжимая ягодицы.
Задержитесь вверху с полностью разогнутым тазом.
Подконтрольно опуститесь.
Повторите.
tips: Упирайтесь пятками, а не носками.
Вверху опустите рёбра, чтобы не прогибать поясницу.
Колени на одной линии со стопами, не заваливаются внутрь.

exercises.name: Ягодичный мост со штангой с упором спиной
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, barbell across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips back down with control.
Repeat.
tips: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down at the top.
Finish with your shins vertical, driving through your heels.
Reach full hip extension without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: TRX: боковая планка
instructions: Place both feet in the TRX foot cradles and lie on your side.
Prop up on your bottom forearm with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Stack your top foot over the bottom foot.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Lower and switch sides after the set.
tips: Brace your obliques before lifting your hips off the floor.
Do not let your hips drop toward the floor.
Press the forearm into the floor to keep the shoulder active.

exercises.name: TRX: выпады
instructions: Stand facing away from the anchor point with the suspension trainer straps behind you, hands on your hips or free for balance.
Place the top of one foot in the foot cradles and extend that leg behind you.
Brace your core and lower your body by bending the front knee, keeping your torso upright.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor or just below, maintaining tension on the suspension trainer.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position, extending the front leg.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat per side.
tips: Keep your front knee tracking over your toes, avoiding inward collapse.
Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement, preventing excessive arching or rounding.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase to maximize muscle engagement.
Adjust your distance from the anchor point to modify difficulty.

exercises.name: TRX: жим от груди
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to mid-calf height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding a handle in each hand, arms extended.
Lean forward into a plank position, keeping your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards your hands by bending your elbows, maintaining tension in the straps.
Press back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms and squeezing your chest.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the movement to maintain a rigid plank.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase for better muscle activation.
Adjust your foot position to modify difficulty: closer to the anchor (more horizontal) is harder, further away (more upright) is easier.
Ensure your elbows track slightly out and back, not flaring wide.

exercises.name: TRX: пистолетик
instructions: Anchor the suspension trainer and hold the handles with both hands, arms extended.
Stand tall, lift one leg straight out in front of you, keeping it off the ground.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending the standing knee, lowering your body as deep as possible.
Keep your chest up, back straight, and use the TRX for balance and support as needed.
Drive through your heel to return to the starting position, extending the standing leg fully.
Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other.
tips: Maintain tension on the TRX straps throughout the movement for stability.
Focus on controlled descent and powerful ascent.
Keep the non-working leg extended and elevated to engage the hip flexors.
Adjust your grip on the TRX to modify the level of assistance.

exercises.name: TRX: планка
instructions: Place both feet in the TRX foot cradles.
Assume a forearm or high plank position on the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for the desired time.
Lower your knees to exit safely.
tips: Do not let your hips sag toward the floor or pike upward.
Stack your shoulders directly over your elbows or hands.
Minimize strap sway by pressing your feet gently into the cradles.

exercises.name: TRX: приседания
instructions: Stand facing the anchor point, holding the handles with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Lean back slightly, keeping your body straight and core engaged, with feet shoulder-width apart.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body as if sitting in a chair.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as deep as comfortable, maintaining tension on the straps.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully.
tips: Keep your chest up and gaze forward throughout the movement to maintain a neutral spine.
Use the suspension trainer for assistance to control your descent and ascent, especially if new to squats.
Focus on pushing your knees out slightly to engage your glutes more effectively.

exercises.name: TRX: разведение «Y»
instructions: Stand facing the anchor point, holding the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean back, extending your arms straight in front of you, maintaining a plank position with your body.
Raise your arms up and out into a 'Y' overhead, pulling your shoulder blades together and down as your body rises toward the anchor.
Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows throughout and squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Slowly control the descent back to the starting position, resisting the pull of the straps.
tips: Adjust your body angle to modify difficulty: leaning further back increases the challenge.
Focus on retracting and depressing your shoulder blades throughout the movement.
Maintain a rigid core and straight body line to prevent sagging hips.

exercises.name: TRX: разгибание рук
instructions: Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding the TRX handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean forward, extending your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, creating tension in the straps.
Keeping your elbows high and fixed, bend them to lower your body by letting your hands move towards your temples.
Extend your elbows forcefully to push your body back to the starting position, squeezing your triceps.
Maintain a rigid plank position throughout the movement, engaging your core and glutes.
tips: Adjust your body angle to increase or decrease difficulty; the more horizontal, the harder the exercise.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and high to maximize triceps isolation and minimize shoulder involvement.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase for better muscle engagement and growth.

exercises.name: TRX: сгибание ног
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the suspension trainer cradles, knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your hips off the floor, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Extend your legs forward, maintaining hip elevation and core tension.
Pull your heels back towards your glutes, contracting your hamstrings forcefully.
Control the movement, avoiding any drop in hip height throughout the set.
tips: Keep your core braced to prevent your hips from sagging.
Focus on a strong hamstring contraction at the peak of the curl.
Control the eccentric phase by slowly extending your legs.

exercises.name: TRX: сгибания на бицепс
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer straps to a medium length.
Stand facing the anchor point, grasp the handles with an underhand grip, and lean back until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your body straight and core engaged, pull your chest towards your hands by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position, controlling the descent.
Maintain tension throughout the set.
tips: Adjust your body angle to increase or decrease difficulty; leaning further back makes it harder.
Keep your elbows high and fixed to isolate the biceps effectively.
Avoid swinging your body or using momentum; focus on a controlled contraction.
Ensure a full range of motion, from full extension to a strong peak contraction.

exercises.name: TRX: тяга
instructions: Grasp the handles of a suspension trainer with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Lean back, extending your arms fully, keeping your body straight from head to heels.
Engage your core and pull your chest towards your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position with control.
Maintain a rigid body throughout the movement, avoiding any sagging in the hips.
tips: Adjust your foot position: the closer your feet are to the anchor point, the harder the exercise.
Keep your elbows close to your body to emphasize the lats, or flare them slightly for more upper back.
Focus on initiating the pull with your back muscles, not just your arms.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase to maximize muscle engagement.

exercises.name: TRX: тяга к лицу
instructions: Grasp the TRX handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean back until your arms are fully extended and your body forms a straight line.
Pull the handles towards your face, driving your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the peak contraction.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
tips: Maintain a rigid torso throughout the movement; avoid arching your lower back.
Focus on initiating the pull with your upper back muscles, not just your arms.
Adjust your body angle to modify difficulty: a more horizontal position is harder.
